Title: Data Analyst Sr - Quality and Safety
Description:
Work Location: Downtown Seattle (Hybrid – 3 days/week on-site)

Supports the Hospital and Enterprise Analytics' vision, mission, and strategic initiatives by using technical expertise to design, create and develop analytical solutions and by providing internal consultation and project management. The incumbent provides leadership in the facilitating and gathering business requirements, and provides knowledge in business/clinical processes, analytical expertise, technical programming skills, and substantial leadership skills in working with key stakeholders, end users and project team members. This position identifies and resolves issues throughout the development of analytical solutions, and is accountable for identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in workflow processes in the implementation of these solutions. Primary responsibility is the design, creation and deployment of analytical solutions for Executive leadership and other key stakeholders within the SCH organization. The incumbent is responsible for frequently taking a formal or an informal lead on project tasks, and leads efforts to design and implement analytic solutions, including reports, dashboards, and views from a wide range of existing data sources, and provides leadership in evaluating and optimizing these solutions. The incumbent also assures integrity of the data for current and future use in strategic initiatives, continuous quality improvement efforts and hospital goals, and for insuring the sustainability and adaptability of all developed solutions.

Required Education And Experience

Bachelor's Degree in Health Science, Computer Science, Math, Business or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience/technical training that demonstrates analytical and technical competency.

Minimum five (5) years experience in progressively more responsible work as a data analyst, developer or equivalent.

Experience in data extraction/integration/aggregation using SQL, R or python.

Expert in use of data visualization for non-technical audiences.

Experience with at least one notable BI reporting tool (e.g., Tableau, QlikView, PowerBI, Business Objects, html/d3).

Experience working with source control tools and version management.

Required Credentials

N/A.

Preferred

Experience working with senior and executive leaders.

Experience with EHR Data (Epic)

Quality and safety related experience.

Experience working as a data analyst within a healthcare setting.

Experience with clinical, hospital and/or financial applications and/or systems.

Experience as a member of a delivery team supporting integrated analytics products and solutions for a wide range of customer groups.

Uses reasonable and basic statistical analyses to make comparisons and detect trends, communicate insights.

Utilizes established data analysis models and tools for analyzing qualitative or quantitative data.

Compensation Range

$121,134.00 - $181,700.00 per year

Salary Information

This compensation range was calculated based on full-time employment (2080 hours worked per calendar year). Offers are determined by multiple factors including equity, skills, experience, and expertise, and may vary within the range provided.

Disclaimer for Out of State Applicants

This compensation range is specific to Seattle, positions located outside of Seattle may be compensated differently depending on various factors.

Benefits Information

Seattle Children’s offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 403(b), life insurance, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more. Additional details on our benefits can be found on our website www.seattlechildrens.org/careers/benefits.

About Us

Hope. Care. Cure. These three simple words capture what we do at Seattle Children’s – to help every child live the healthiest and most fulfilling life possible. Are you ready to engage with a mission-driven organization that is life-changing to many, and touches the hearts of all? #HOPECARECURE

Our founding promise to the community is as valid today as it was over a century ago: we will care for all children in our region, regardless of the families’ ability to pay. Together, we deliver superior patient care, advance new discoveries and treatments through pediatric research, and serve as the pediatric and adolescent, academic medical center for Washington, Alaska, Montana and Idaho – the largest region of any children’s hospital in the country.

U.S. News & World Report consistently ranks Seattle Children’s among the nation’s best children’s hospitals. For more than a decade, Seattle Children’s has been nationally recognized in key specialty areas. We are honored to be one of the nation’s very best places to care for children and the top-ranked pediatric hospital in Washington and the Pacific Northwest.

As a Magnet designated institution, we recognize the importance of hiring and developing great talent to provide best-in-class care to the patients and families we serve. Our organizational DNA takes form in our core values: Compassion, Excellence, Integrity, Collaboration, Equity and Innovation. Whether it’s delivering frontline care to our patients in a kind and caring manner, practicing the highest standards of quality and safety, or being relentlessly curious as we work towards eradicating childhood diseases, these values are the fabric of our culture and community. The future starts here.

Our Commitment

Seattle Children’s welcomes people of all experiences, backgrounds, and thoughts as this is what drives our spirit of inquiry and allows us to better connect with our patients and families. Our organization recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes based on merit without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

The people who work at Seattle Children’s are members of a community that seeks to respect and celebrate all the qualities that make each of us unique. Each of us is empowered to be ourselves.

Seattle Children’s is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Workplace and Affirmative Action Employer.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Overview

Are you passionate about using cutting-edge technologies & capabilities across Microsoft’s Intelligent Data Platform? Do you strive to improve customer experience and business performance? Do you like to affect change at a billion-dollar global user scale company, and deliver improvements that result in material impact? If yes, we want you in Monetization and Business Planning (MBP)! 

Our organization directs the commercial portfolio’s pricing, packaging, licensing, channel, and monetization strategies. As a Senior Data Analyst in the Monetization Strategy and Licensing team, you will act as a strategic partner to functional teams, responsible for improving operational efficiency by delivering insights and data models that impact how go-to-market decisions are made. You will become an integral part of how we scale Microsoft’s monetization strategy. You will develop your career, forge effective cross-functional relationships, take on progressively broader responsibilities, and establish yourself as a strategic advisor. You can expect to have sponsorship for your work, support for your professional development, and encouragement to bring your authentic self to work.      

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  

Responsibilities


Lead AI and Automation systems performance reporting, leveraging telemetry from our automation systems to provide insights to our partners.
Partner with our business and engineering leaders to set up KPIs to measure effectiveness of AI automation
Identify connections across data sources and contribute to the development of analytical frameworks as you develop an understanding of the business.
Leverage your understanding of the business to examine projects through a customer and/or stakeholder-oriented focus.
Identify and leverage appropriate sources of data and contribute to the development of recommendations.
Determine appropriate analytical techniques and critically evaluate assumptions.
Share and simplify relevant findings and insights and ensure presented results are accessible and accurate.
Support and/or consult with other teams and identify relevant data-driven recommendations.
Recommend efficiency improvements for core work and evaluate the viability of automated data collection methods.
Understand linkages between analytical models and contribute to the review process—and, if the model is deemed deficient—seek to determine why.
Work within and across teams to ensure alignment in data sources and processes and engage stakeholders to act on opportunities.
Stay abreast of privacy requirements and ensure data have undergone appropriate reviews.
Embody our culture and values.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications


Master's Degree in Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or related field AND 2+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, data science, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis
OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or related field AND 4+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, data science, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis


OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications


Master's Degree in Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or related field AND 4+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, data science, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis
OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or related field AND 6+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, data science, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis


OR equivalent experience.
4+ years of experience in building PowerBI dashboards and 2+ years of experience in building semantic models on Microsoft Fabric.
Experience building extract transform and load (ETL/ELT) solutions in Azure or any other cloud platform.

There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $137,600 - $222,600 per year.

Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:

Title: Data Analyst (Ads & Sponsorships)
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Data Analyst (Ads & Sponsorships)

Locations: Kirkland, Los Angeles (Hybrid)

Reports to: Director, Advertising & Sponsorships Insights & Innovations

As the Advertising Intelligence Analyst, you will manage monthly reporting deliverables for in-game advertising inventory as well as develop scalable data models and construct essential dashboards for the Ads & Sponsorships (A&S) team. You will partner with AdOps, AdTech, Product Management, and game analytics groups across game studios to ensure reporting data remains precise, documented, and streamlined through automation.

Operating on assignments of moderate complexity, you will independently handle the standard reporting rhythm while collaborating on new projects. You will report directly to the Director of Advertising Intelligence, and collaborate daily with the Data Solutions Analyst. Your contributions will provide foundational insights relied upon by the entire A&S Team.

Responsibilities


Align with the AdOps team each month on which campaigns are included in reporting, then create and consistently publish reports for all custom A&S inventory across EA titles.
Act as the A&S business lead with AdTech on report automation — define requirements, validate output, and cut manual steps out of the monthly cycle.
Collaborate with the Product Management team to ensure new inventory is included in standardized reporting.
Maintain documentation of reporting queries and KPI calculations so results are reproducible and auditable.
Bridge the reporting gap for A&S inventory in mobile titles and work towards automation.
Build and maintain the A&S team dashboards, to support the Sales, AdOps, Product Management, and Revenue Strategy functions.
Manage access and permissions for A&S dashboards.
Apply working knowledge of data engineering concepts to design and maintain internal A&S data models and databases as well as provide inputs and guidance to AdTech partners on data pipeline migration.
Build partnerships with studio analytics teams to understand each team's data taxonomy.
Fulfill ad hoc telemetry and data requests across the A&S team.


Qualifications


1+ years of experience in analytics, reporting, or business intelligence; internship experience counts.
Bachelor, MBA or Master's degree in Statistics or related field with knowledge in the application of statistics using analytics software.
Database knowledge including table structures, views, queries, and SQL statements including window/analytic functions.
Competent with at least one analytics software package (Python, R, SAS, or SPSS) and comfortable working in Excel (can write advanced macros).
Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards in a BI tool (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or Looker), and generating graphs and visuals that make an insight easy to understand.
Summarize data using the right statistical terms and explain those concepts to non-statistical audiences in plain language.
Familiar with core data engineering concepts — pipelines, schemas, ETL, and telemetry — enough to be a useful partner to engineering teams.
Clear documentation habits, and prioritization recommendations, give effort estimates, and flag scheduling conflicts early.
An interest in games: you play EA titles across platforms and follow industry and tech news.
Exposure to digital advertising metrics (impressions, reach and frequency, viewability) or game telemetry data.
Familiar with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


California (depending on location e.g. Los Angeles vs. San Francisco) *$98,200 - $155,200 USD
Washington (depending on location e.g. Seattle vs. Spokane) *$93,800 - $122,000 USD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

In the US, we offer a package of benefits including paid time off (3 weeks per year to start), 80 hours per year of sick time, 16 paid company holidays per year, 10 weeks paid time off to bond with baby, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

Title: Sr. Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a CBRE Sr. Business Intelligence Analyst you will be responsible for conducting advanced research, data mining, reporting and interpretation of company performance metrics.

This job is part of the Data Science & Analytics job function. They are responsible for reviewing data that supports improving effectiveness and predicting outcomes to develop business intelligence.

What You’ll Do


Generate and review reports using aggregate data from multiple sources to assist in creating a complete evaluation, improvement, or recommendation.
Review the accuracy of information provided and respond to escalated requests from management and vendors.
Understand and work with advanced scenario planning tools and models. Investigate new trends in general business conditions.
Identify opportunities for large improvements among the clients and company.
Work with personnel from other departments and information technology groups to facilitate successful project implementations.
Review the maintenance and reporting of benchmarks and performance metrics.
Act as subject matter expert for key systems and processes and day-to-day functions.
Apply general knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish assigned tasks and solve routine problems.
Have a broad knowledge of own job discipline and some knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.
Lead by example and model behaviors consistent with CBRE RISE values. May convince to reach an agreement.
Impact the quality of own work and the work of others on the team.
Work primarily within standardized procedures and practices to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.
Explain complex information to others in straightforward situations.


What You’ll Need


Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
Understanding of existing procedures and standards to solve slightly complex problems.
Ability to analyze possible solutions using technical experience to apply appropriate judgment and precedents.
In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.


Why CBRE

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Our Values in Hiring

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

Disclaimers

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

About CBRE Group, Inc.

CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2024 revenue). The company has more than 140,000 employees (including Turner & Townsend employees) serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves clients through four business segments: Advisory (leasing, sales, debt origination, mortgage serving, valuations); Building Operations & Experience (facilities management, property management, flex space & experience); Project Management (program management, project management, cost consulting); Real Estate Investments (investment management, development). Please visit our website at www.cbre.com.

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The compensation yield to a successful candidate will depend on their skills, qualifications, and experience. Successful candidates will also be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on CBRE’s applicable benefit program. This role will provide the following benefits: 401(K), Dental insurance, Health insurance, Life insurance, and Vision insurance

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Blue Origin corporate functions, providing centralized support across Blue Origin business unit teams, functions, and locations.

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst to join our Human Resources People Analytics team. In this strategic role, you will leverage your analytical expertise and problem-solving skills to transform raw data into actionable insights, enabling HR and business leaders to optimize processes, enhance performance, and drive organizational efficiency. Your work will be pivotal in shaping data-driven HR strategies and fostering organizational success. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design advanced data models and visualizations that contribute to our mission of operational excellence.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Key Responsibilities


Analyze HR data to deeply understand processes, trends, and opportunities, ensuring findings are actionable and aligned with organizational goals.
Design and implement advanced data visualizations and dashboards using tools like Tableau or PowerBI to drive strategic decision-making.
Collaborate with HR and business teams to identify to develop metrics that promote excellence and optimize workflows.
Perform detailed data analysis and validation to ensure accuracy and reliability of insights provided to stakeholders.
Proactively address challenges, offering innovative, data-driven solutions that enhance HR processes and outcomes.
Communicate complex data insights clearly and effectively, ensuring all stakeholders understand implications and actions.
Develop and maintain data documentation, run books, and data dictionaries in collaboration with HR data governance.
Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in people analytics and apply them to enhance our workforce strategies.


Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field or equivalent in years of exp.
8+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or related domains.
Expertise in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI).
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to provide impactful solutions.
Excellent attention to detail, ensuring recommendations are accurate and actionable.
Strong communication skills for effective interaction with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A mindset of ownership and curiosity, with the drive to understand data within its broader business context.


Preferred Qualifications


Solid experience in HR analytics, with a deep understanding of its impact on talent management and policy decisions.
Proficiency in data analysis tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, R, Etc).
Experience with enterprise systems such as Workday and Cornerstone.
Familiarity with big data platforms and cloud technologies.

Relocation assistance provided for qualified candidates.

Job Description

Data Analyst – RFQ, Proposal & Business Performance Analytics

________________________________________

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to support customer’s Program Management and Business Development organization. This role will be responsible for tracking and analyzing the end-to-end opportunity pipeline from RFQ receipt through quote submission, negotiation, contract award, and program kickoff.

The analyst will transform business development, estimating, proposal, and program data into actionable insights that improve bid management, enhance forecasting accuracy, increase win rates, and provide leadership visibility into opportunity conversion performance.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, experience managing large datasets, and the ability to develop executive scorecards, dashboards, and business performance analytics.

Industry Experience


Bachelor’s degree in data Analytics, Statistics, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline, with 3–7 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or performance analytics roles.
Proven experience working with large datasets and developing executive dashboards, scorecards, and business performance reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and SQL.
Prior experience supporting Program Management, Business Development, Estimating, Proposal Management, Sales Operations, or RFQ-to-Award processes is highly desirable.
Preference will be given to candidates with experience in the aerospace, manufacturing, defense, or industrial sectors, including exposure to opportunity pipeline management, win-rate analysis, forecasting, and KPI framework development.
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to transform complex business data into actionable insights and leadership-ready recommendations.


Key Responsibilities: Summary of Responsibilities & Skills


Track and manage the complete RFQ-to-Award lifecycle, including RFQ receipt, quote submission, negotiations, award decisions, and program handoff.
Collect, consolidate, validate, and maintain opportunity, proposal, and award data from multiple business systems.
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and reporting tools that provide visibility into pipeline health and business performance.
Analyze RFQ volumes, proposal activity, quote turnaround times, award rates, win/loss performance, and revenue opportunities.
Perform month-over-month, quarter-over-quarter, and year-over-year trend analysis to identify business growth patterns and performance gaps.
Generate actionable insights on customer activity, opportunity conversion rates, business segment performance, and program trends.
Create executive-level reports and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and PowerPoint for leadership reviews.
Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) such as RFQs received, quotes submitted, proposals pending, awards won, pipeline value, and forecasted revenue.
Conduct comparative analysis across customers, product lines, business sectors, manufacturing sites, and program portfolios.
Support forecasting activities by providing visibility into near-term awards, future revenue potential, and business growth opportunities.
Collaborate closely with Program Management, Estimating, Sales, Engineering, and Business Development teams to improve data quality and reporting effectiveness.
Identify bottlenecks in the proposal and quotation process and recommend process improvements to enhance responsiveness and win rates.
Standardize KPI definitions, reporting methodologies, and dashboard formats to enable consistent reporting across the organization.
Drive continuous improvement through automation of reports, enhancement of analytics capabilities, and development of scalable business intelligence solutions.
Present data-driven insights and recommendations to management to support strategic decision-making and business growth initiatives.


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in Excel (advanced), SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and PowerPoint for data analysis, dashboard development, executive reporting, and business performance monitoring.
Experience working with large, complex datasets, including data extraction, cleansing, transformation, validation, and trend analysis.
Ability to develop and maintain RFQ-to-Award dashboards, KPI scorecards, pipeline reports, and revenue forecasting models.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, conversion drivers, business risks, and growth opportunities.
Experience performing win/loss analysis, opportunity pipeline tracking, proposal performance measurement, and business forecasting.
Effective data storytelling and executive communication skills, capable of translating complex data into actionable insights and leadership recommendations.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across Program Management, Business Development, Estimating, Engineering, and Operations teams.
Continuous improvement mindset with experience standardizing reporting processes, automating analytics, improving data quality, and implementing scalable business intelligence solutions.

Execution Partnership: Serve as the primary builder in partnership with the Sr. Manager - translating measurement frameworks and KPI definitions into working dashboards and reports.


Ad-Hoc & Diagnostic Analysis


Ad-Hoc Analysis: Perform ad-hoc, deep-dive analysis on demand gen performance questions as they come up, using SQL to independently query and join across data sources.
Leading Indicator Tracking: Identify and monitor diagnostic/leading indicators that help flag performance shifts before they show up in lagging KPIs.
Data Navigation: Navigate across Google Analytics (in Snowflake), Salesforce CRM objects (Campaigns, Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities), and paid media platform data to pull, join, and validate data for reporting and analysis.


Cross-Functional Execution


Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with other analysts, data science, and data engineering teams to source data, resolve data quality issues, and align on reporting logic.
Technical Translation: Work with the Sr. Manager to turn metric and measurement designs into concrete queries, data models, and dashboard specs.

Experience & Technical Skills


3+ years of experience in Marketing/Demand Gen Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a highly quantitative field, ideally in B2B SaaS or technology.
Strong proficiency in SQL - able to independently write complex queries and joins across large data sets (Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouse).

Familiarity with digital marketing data sources: Google Analytics/website reporting data, Salesforce CRM objects (Campaign, Lead, Contact, Account, Opportunity), and paid media platform data.
Comfortable performing ad-hoc analysis under time pressure and communicating findings clearly.


Communication & Collaboration


Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly for explaining technical/data findings to non-technical partners.
Effective collaborator who can work cross-functionally with analysts, data science, and data engineering teams to get work done.
Detail-oriented and reliable - comfortable owning always-on reporting that others depend on.


Preferred Qualifications


Working knowledge of additional analytical languages/tools such as Python, R, or dbt.
Exposure to demand gen or digital marketing channels (email, paid, web, ABM) - helpful for context, though deep strategic experience is not required.
Experience partnering with data engineering or data science teams on data quality or pipeline issues.

Description:
Description

In the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WWRR) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.

WWRR includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WWRR, you will partner across these teams to help customers discover great deals on quality used, rentals, and open box items; get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.

Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WWRR, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for leveraging data and analytics to identify gaps, measure effectiveness, and drive decisions to improve the returns experience. You will need to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards. You will own end-to-end project execution for initiatives within your focus area, including influencing partner teams, driving prioritization on the roadmap, and working with tech to resolve issues you surface. You will leverage SQL and analytical tools to support the projects you own. Additionally, you should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impact the bottom line of the business.

Key job responsibilities


Use data and analytics to identify operational gaps, drive business decisions, and own resolution with partner teams.
Employ the appropriate tools and methodologies to discover patterns of risks, abuse, and help reduce bad debt
Analyze customer behavioral patterns and develop policy change recommendations based on findings and drive implementation with partner teams
Leverage data to influence partner teams and drive prioritization to get issues resolved
Write SQL queries and leverage data to surface gaps, track project health, and report on outcomes
Work closely with business, engineering, and partner teams to align on priorities and deliver against your focus area


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of program or project management experience
3+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
2+ years of SQL experience
Experience in advanced SQL & ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams
Experience using data to define metrics, track program health, and drive decisions
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or 2+ years of Amazon experience in an analytical or program management capacity


Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
Experience building automated reporting or dashboards using BI tools (e.g., QuickSight, Tableau, or similar)
Experience managing stakeholder communications and driving alignment across multiple teams

Own product analytics end-to-end — funnels, adoption, retention, and ROI for every major feature launch on the SevenRooms platform.

Communicate closely in support of multiple PM’s with reporting and ad-hoc analysis

A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain

Expert SQL skills and proficiency with a cloud BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or Mode.

The SevenRooms Data & Analytics team is the foundational data hub powering go-to-market, product, finance, and operational decisions across the In-Store business. We design and maintain the pipelines, models, and infrastructure that connect SevenRooms' systems with the broader DoorDash data ecosystem — and we're investing aggressively in making our datasets ready for both human and AI consumption. We're hiring a Data Analyst to be the data partner for our Product Management, Product Marketing, and executive teams at SevenRooms. You will own the building of data products, feature launch analytics, and the PLG instrumentation that connects product usage signals back into Salesforce, Gainsight, and our outbound motions.

You will report into the Manager, Data & Analytics on our Data & Analytics team in our SevenRooms organization.

You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…

  • Own product analytics end-to-end — funnels, adoption, retention, and ROI for every major feature launch on the SevenRooms platform.

Title: Business Data Analyst Senior
Description:
Overview of Position

This position creates and submits required monthly compliance reports to the State's Office of the Superintendent of Public Instruction (OSPI). Ensures the timeliness and accuracy of these reports by frequently interacting with school personnel and other District staff.

Essential Functions

60%


Coordinates with the Business Intelligence team, to coordinate, analyze, reconcile and complete monthly student data compliance reporting required by the State of Washington.
Ensures the accuracy of reported data, compliance with State enrollment reporting standards, and reconciliation and adjustment of enrollment.
Coordinates with other departments (Special Education, Enrollment Planning, Budget, etc.) to ensure District-level consistency of information reported; coordinates with local and State reporting agencies to ensure that reports are submitted to OSPI in a timely manner.


15%


Acts as liaison to appropriate school and district staff to ensure district policies and procedures related to compliance reporting are followed to maintain accuracy and completeness of data entered.
Coordinates with other groups within Department of Technical Services (DoTS) to ensure documentation and procedures used by the central student data system are correct and up to date.
Includes interaction with school staff to ensure accuracy and completeness of data provided as necessary.
Inform and instruct staff on correct procedures, timelines and policies needed for compliance reporting.


10%


Designs and develops quality assurance methods to identify trends, discrepancies and confirm accuracy of data.
Uses appropriate analysis and reporting tools such as SPSS, Microsoft Excel, or SQL to perform quality assurance on key identified metrics and to identify emerging trends.
Ensures approaches are documented, standardized and replicable for consistent results.
Identifies opportunities and recommends changes for process or system improvement to maximize revenue, timeliness, accuracy and compliance in reporting, and helps implement systemic process improvements.
This position requires frequent interaction with school registrars and frequent communication with district and State personnel to ensure accuracy of student data and compliance with reporting requirements.


5%


Designs and creates management reports to help proactively monitor internal performance, productivity and compliance using information from a variety of systems.
Generates ad hoc reports for management to help monitor compliance, accuracy and timeliness of data entry and reporting related to special education.
Under supervision and guidance, prepares response to audit requests for information.
Generates reports of aggregated and/or student-level data for various requesters, including schools, central administrative staff, and other external requesters, including State and Federal auditors.


5%


Works with State personnel and OSPI Educational Data System (EDS) software programs to monitor changes in compliance reporting.
Generates required State student identification data as necessary to integrate into central reporting.


5%


Document and archive processes and data for archival backup and auditing purposes.


Other Functions


Responsible for streamlining, maintaining, and documenting processes that support state reporting including the generation and maintenance of required State data system student IDs and school/principal profiles.
Responsible for submitting reports that hold state and federal funding implications, directs resources district-wide and determination level for the district by OSPI.
Reliability of data submitted is crucial to the district's compliance with government programs.
May perform related duties consistent with the scope and intent of the position.

Works skillfully in difficult situations with both internal and external groups.
Represents his/her own interests while being open-minded to other groups.
Builds respectful and productive relationships internally and externally.

Data structures, complex transactional systems structures and reporting.
Compliance-based reporting methods.

Process documentation and development.

Familiar with legal requirements related to state and federal reporting related to K-12 special education.
Demonstrated experience working with systems, processes or reporting to ensure legal compliance.
Detail oriented.

Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Knowledge of and previous use of additional data analysis and reporting tools such as SPSS statistical software is preferred.

Beginning SQL programming and data extraction skills.


Experience/Education

Six to Eight (6-8) years of data analysis and reporting, data management, computer/programming or business experience working with business applications and reporting/data analysis tools; experience working in a K-12 education environment, experience with business process redesign, systems and compliance reporting preferred; Bachelor's degree in Management Information Systems, Mathematics, Business Administration, or similar field; or an equivalent of education and experience.

Any equivalent combination of education, experience and training that provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities to perform the work will be considered.

The Broadband Business Intelligence team supports business decision-making by delivering commercial, customer, product, and marketing insights that improve business performance and customer experience.

The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst will analyze and communicate quantitative and qualitative data, with a strong focus on marketing analytics, including campaign performance, customer acquisition, retention, segmentation, channel effectiveness, and marketing ROI.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytics with visual storytelling and can translate business questions into dashboards, insights, and executive-ready recommendations. This role will help shape decisions across marketing, product, and broadband business performance.

This is a hybrid position requiring at least 3 days per week in-office.

Analyze data from sources including Databricks, web analytics platforms, customer data, digital engagement data, and third-party datasets.
Evaluate marketing performance across campaigns, channels, audiences, products, and customer segments to identify opportunities for optimization.
Develop insights and recommendations that improve customer acquisition, retention, marketing effectiveness, and business performance.
Partner with Marketing, Product, Data Science, Finance, Sales, and Technology teams to define business questions, KPIs, measurement approaches, and reporting needs.
Translate business and marketing objectives into dashboards, reporting frameworks, and executive-ready presentations.
Use data visualization and storytelling to communicate marketing performance, customer behavior, funnel performance, and business outcomes.
Support the design and development of scalable reporting structures, analytical models, and self-service BI capabilities.
Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed

Ad Hoc Analysis
Business Acumen
Business Intelligence Software
Business Requirements Analysis
Dashboard Development
Data Analysis
Data Mining
Data Visualization
SQL Databases
Stakeholder Management

Bachelor's degree plus 5 years of related work experience, advanced degree with 3 years of related experience.
Acceptable areas of study include Business, Marketing, Economics, Analytics, Data Science, Statistics or similar degree.
4+ years of experience in business intelligence, marketing analytics, customer analytics, or a related analytical role.
4+ years of experience with Tableau and SQL.
Experience analyzing marketing campaigns, customer acquisition, retention, segmentation, funnel performance, channel effectiveness, or marketing ROI.
Strong understanding of marketing KPIs such as conversion, cost per acquisition, churn, retention, lifetime value, campaign lift, and attribution.
Ability to translate complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, including experience presenting to senior leaders.
Experience working with cloud data environments such as Databricks, AWS Redshift, Azure, or similar platforms.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

Customer-level behavioral data, audience segmentation, lifecycle analytics, web analytics, CRM, or digital marketing platforms preferred.

Title: Sr. Business Analyst (Customer Success)
Description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. BUSINESS ANALYST (CUSTOMER SUCCESS)

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, delivers low-latency broadband internet worldwide, connecting consumers in remote and underserved areas. The team drives consumer adoption and expansion by analyzing market trends, optimizing acquisition strategies, and informing pricing and retention initiatives. This role will focus on consumer metrics and insights, conducting research and reporting to support data-driven decisions that accelerate subscriber growth and enhance user value. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with a blend of quantitative skills and curiosity for market dynamics, capable of turning complex data into actionable strategies for consumer growth.

Responsibilities


Perform in-depth analyses of consumer metrics, including Lifetime Value (LTV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), churn rates, and cohort performance, using SQL queries and statistical methods to uncover trends and opportunities
Develop forecasting models for subscriber growth, revenue projections, and market penetration, incorporating external factors like competitive landscapes and economic indicators
Create and maintain reporting dashboards and visualizations (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to track key performance indicators (KPIs) for consumer acquisition, retention, and engagement
Conduct market research and price analysis, evaluating elasticity, competitive pricing, and promotional impacts to recommend optimizations that drive revenue and affordability
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and sales teams to integrate insights into growth strategies, including A/B testing support and scenario planning
Identify data gaps and work with engineering teams to improve data collection for consumer use cases, ensuring robust datasets for ongoing analysis
Deliver presentations and reports to stakeholders, translating technical findings into clear, business-oriented recommendations that influence decision-making
Support ad-hoc research projects, such as regional market assessments or emerging trends in broadband adoption, blending qualitative insights with quantitative rigor


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree
5+ years of professional experience in business analytics, consulting, market research, or growth operations
3+ years of experience with SQL and creating/managing dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
1+ years of experience leading projects


Preferred Skills And Experience


Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
Experience with forecasting, financial metrics (e.g., LTV, CAC), or pricing analysis
Proficiency in statistical modeling and forecasting techniques (e.g., time-series analysis, regression in Python or R)
Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, or automation scripting (e.g., Python, VBA)
Background in high-growth consumer tech environments, startups, or consulting firms with a focus on customer acquisition and retention
Strong research skills, including familiarity with market intelligence tools (e.g., surveys, competitive analysis platforms)
Excellent communication abilities, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
Project management experience, including prioritizing tasks in fast-paced settings and collaborating with diverse stakeholders


Additional Requirements


Position may involve extended hours and weekend work as needed
This position may require travel between various SpaceX sites


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range

Level 3: $120,000.00 - $175,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

Itar Requirements


To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.


SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

Title: Staff Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The People Analytics Team

Our People Analytics team distills insights from our data to drive informed workforce decisions across the organization. We partner with stakeholders throughout the business to transform complex people data into actionable intelligence that optimizes the employee lifecycle and supports better business outcomes.

The Staff Data Analyst People Analytics Opportunity

This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead the design and delivery of people analytics solutions that directly impact workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, and employee experience. You'll develop advanced predictive models, create scalable dashboards, and apply emerging AI technologies to solve complex workforce challenges while partnering closely with cross-functional stakeholders.

What you'll be doing

Analyze and report on the entire employee lifecycle—from hiring and onboarding through development and exit—by designing dashboards and reports that provide insights into hiring, attrition, engagement, performance, promotions, compensation, headcount, and organizational health
Partner with People Team leaders, stakeholders across the business, and data teams to translate business questions into analytical approaches, ensure data quality and governance, and deliver executive-ready insights
Design, build, and maintain predictive analytics models that identify workforce trends, risks, and opportunities, including attrition prediction, workforce forecasting, employee lifecycle analysis, and talent pipeline analytics
Apply advanced statistical techniques—including regression analysis, clustering, forecasting, survival analysis, and segmentation—to solve complex workforce challenges and inform strategic decision-making
Analyze employee feedback from surveys, onboarding, exit interviews, and other listening channels using Natural Language Processing and text analytics to identify emerging themes and actionable insights
Explore and prototype Generative AI use cases that automate narrative reporting, summarize workforce trends, and enhance decision support while maintaining governance and data privacy standards

What you'll bring to the role

7+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Data Science, or a related analytics discipline
Advanced proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools, data warehousing platforms, spreadsheet and SQL querying, and enterprise HR platforms
Having experience with our direct tech stack is highly preferred:
Data visualization and reporting: Tableau
Data warehousing: Snowflake
Spreadsheet and querying: Excel, SQL
Enterprise HR platforms: Workday, ServiceNow, Greenhouse
Demonstrated expertise applying advanced statistical methods including regression, clustering, forecasting, and text analytics
Excellent data visualization and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex findings into clear business recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, influence decisions through data, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Analytics, Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent combination of education and experience)

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!

Strong programming skills in Python and/or R for statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and automation
Familiarity with Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and other emerging AI technologies applied to analytics
Experience implementing sound data management and governance practices across large, complex datasets

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst, Finance
Description:
Get To Know The Pokémon Company International

The Pokémon Company International manages the Pokémon property outside of Asia and is responsible for brand management, licensing and marketing, the Pokémon Trading Card Game, the animated TV series, home entertainment, and the official Pokémon website. Pokémon was launched in Japan in 1996 and today is one of the most popular children’s entertainment properties in the world.

Learn more online at corporate.pokemon.com and pokemon.com.



Get to know the role


Job Title: Business Intelligence Analyst, Finance
Job Summary: This role will be responsible for deep analysis of complex business problems and issues using data from internal and external sources to provide insight to decision-makers.
FLSA Classification (US Only): Exempt
People Manager: No


What you’ll do


Build and maintain automated data pipelines extracting financial data from Oracle Fusion Cloud (GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets)
Transform raw data into clean, reporting-ready datasets; monitor pipelines and resolve data issues
Document data lineage and transformation logic
Design and maintain Tableau dashboards for key financial metrics
Translate Finance/Accounting requirements into technical specs, ensuring consistent metrics across tools
Partner with Finance, Accounting, and Tech teams on reporting needs and priorities
Provide ad hoc analysis for audits, forecasting, and management reporting; train users on self-service tools
Maintain validation checks reconciling source data to reports
Maintain data dictionaries and documentation
Drive automation and data quality improvements


What you’ll bring


Five (5) to seven (7) years of relevant professional experience or a demonstrated equivalent level of expertise
Bachelor's degree in an analytical field or a demonstrated equivalent level of applicable experience
Demonstrated proficient experience using SQL, Python or other coding languages and ETL tools (i.e. data build tool)
Experience using data visualization tools (i.e. Tableau, PowerBI)
Data warehouse architecture and modeling experience
Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle ADW strongly preferred
Familiarity with Databricks and other cloud-based data warehouses
Experience with implementing data quality monitoring and alerting systems
Experience with JIRA, Gitlab and Confluence
Business domain knowledge in accounting, finance, IP & royalty strongly preferred


Base Salary Range: For this role, new hires generally start between $95,000.00 - $127,000.00 per year. The full range is $95,000.00 - $172,000.00 per year. This range is applicable for the labor market where the role is intended to be hired. The final base salary is directly related to the candidate’s qualifications and professional experience uniquely.

How You’ll Be Successful


Passion for Pokémon: Develops an understanding of the Pokémon brand, the impact it has on our people, culture, business, fans, and communities, and applying that knowledge and passion to everything you do.
Challenging the Expected: Approaches challenges with curiosity and creativity, embracing the possibility of failure as an opportunity to learn something new, develop innovative ideas, solve complex problems and identify unique opportunities.
Integrity and Respect: Demonstrates integrity and respect by leading with empathy, listening to others, seeking out different perspectives, and taking personal responsibility for decisions, actions, and results.
Dedicated to Quality: Takes ownership to maintain and promote high standards, looks for new ways to learn and improve, and embraces a growth mindset to seek and apply feedback from others in an effort to continuously improve.
Building Relationships: Develops and strengthens relationships, adopting a “team first” mentality and working collaboratively to solve problems and meet shared goals.
Delighting Customers: Listens and understands the interests and needs of our customers and stakeholders, making them feel heard and important, and embracing these learnings to continue delivering a unique Pokémon experience.


What To Expect


An innovative culture driven by impact, delivering meaningful outcomes.
Company events that celebrate the spirit of Pokémon.
Competitive cash-based compensation programs.
100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for you.
Generous paid family leave.
Employer-paid life insurance.
Employer-paid long and short-term income protection insurance.
US Employees: 401k Employer Matching.
UK/IRE/MX Employees: Pension Employer Contributions.
Fitness reimbursement.
Commuter benefit.
LinkedIn learning.
Comprehensive relocation package for certain roles.
Hybrid work environment.


The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this role. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. For roles in the United Kingdom, candidates will need the right to work. In some cases, and for some roles, the Company may be able to arrange a visa. For roles in Ireland, this role requires candidates to have the right to live and work in the Republic of Ireland. However, we welcome applications from all nationalities and may consider supporting an employment permit application, in appropriate and suitable cases.

The Pokémon Company International is committed to the inclusion of all qualified applicants for consideration in our job application process. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview, or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact the Talent Acquisition team at accommodationrequest_ta@pokemon.com.

Title: data analyst, Loyalty Strategy
Description:
Now Brewing – data analyst, Loyalty Strategy! #tobeapartner

From the beginning, Starbucks set out to be a different kind of company. One that not only celebrated coffee and the rich tradition, but that also brought a feeling of connection. We are known for developing extraordinary leaders who share this passion and are guided by their service to others.

This job contributes to Starbucks success by having an incredible opportunity to make an impact with Starbucks Rewards – an industry-leading loyalty program and key growth driver for one of the world’s most beloved brands.

Our Loyalty Strategy & Performance team is a future-looking, innovation-forward and agile team where digital experiences and general management intersect. We are looking for motivated self-starters whose strong analytical thinking is matched by curiosity, business acumen, and ability to work in a fast paced and dynamic environment.

The Loyalty Strategy Analyst role will help us understand and optimize the loyalty program strategy and define what’s next to drive deeper customer engagement. This role will focus on strategy’s key objectives and needs while building relationships spanning business owners, marketing, technology, and other cross-functional partners to deliver compelling and lasting business impact and superior customer experiences.

As a Loyalty Strategy data analyst, you will…


Explore owned, syndicated and behavioral data for customer insights, trends and business opportunities, directly support our near and long term roadmap and business goals with data-driven insights.
Analyze business performance, looking at past performance and defining future-looking KPIs, methodologies that help drive lifetime value and richer brand engagement.
Proactively identify and propose analytics tools and solutions that increase efficiency, speed to insight, and speed to product feature development.
Lead cross-functional teams in thinking through complex and ambiguous issues: identify and define key issues, develop hypotheses, and design required analyses
Conduct inquiry-driven data discovery, design analytical frameworks and define metrics to answer hypotheses, manage dashboard and data product enhancements
Craft stories for senior management and leadership – support quarterly business performance summary and analysis, key projects, explorations and inquiries


We’d Love To Hear From People With


Strong analytical capabilities and experience
Financial acumen
Ability to navigate and synthesize multiple data sources, business context, draw insights, build logical and compelling storylines, and define recommendations
Ability to simplify and structure complex and ambiguous problems
Ability to present complicated material in a concise and effective way
Tenacious curiosity: ability to provide thought leadership and contribute continuously to the collective knowledge of the team
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
Ability to build strong and effective relationships with cross-functional partners
Business analysis, data analysis and modeling (4+ years)
Experience managing and analyzing business performance (4+ years)
Demonstrated project ownership and cross-functional leadership (2+ years)
Developing and delivering presentations to executive level audiences (2+ years)
Proficiency or better using complex databases (e.g. Tableau), manipulating data, building and assessing models
Advanced skills in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint
MBA, decision science or other quantitative degree/background preferred
Nice to have: Basic understanding data modeling, SQL, experience building dashboards


As a Starbucks partner, you (and your family) will have access to medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, and other voluntary insurance benefits. Partners have access to short-term and long-term disability, paid parental leave, family expansion reimbursement, paid vacation from date of hire*, sick time (accrued at 1 hour for every 25 hours worked), eight paid holidays, and two personal days per year. Starbucks also offers eligible partners participation in a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, a discounted company stock program (S.I.P.), Starbucks equity program (Bean Stock), incentivized emergency savings, and financial well-being tools. Additionally, Starbucks offers 100% upfront tuition coverage for a first-time bachelor’s degree through Arizona State University’s online program via the Starbucks College Achievement Plan, student loan management resources, and access to other educational opportunities. You will also have access to backup care and DACA reimbursement. Starbucks will comply with any applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, and in accordance with its plans and policies. This list is subject to change depending on collective bargaining in locations where partners have a certified bargaining representative. For additional information regarding partner perks and more detailed information about benefits, go to starbucksbenefits.com.

The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will be based on multiple factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge/skills, experience, geographical location, and internal equity. At Starbucks, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the high end of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate.

Join us and inspire with every cup. Apply today!

Title: Revenue Operations Analyst
Description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About The Role

The Revenue Operations team sits at the center of PitchBook’s go-to-market engine, translating data into the insights that power strategic decisions across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. We are a collaborative, detail-oriented team that takes ownership of the full analytical lifecycle, from raw data to executive dashboards, and we hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor and clarity. If you care deeply about getting the numbers right and communicating them well, you will fit right in.

The Revenue Operations Analyst, Analytics & Insights, owns performance reporting, business review cadences, and funnel and lifecycle analytics across PitchBook's go-to-market organization. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to translate data into meaningful insights that inform strategy and accelerate business growth. The ideal candidate is an intellectually curious, insights-driven analyst who enjoys asking questions, challenging assumptions, and uncovering opportunities within complex datasets. Bringing strong SQL skills, experience working with large datasets, and an enthusiasm for leveraging AI and automation to enhance analytics and decision-making.

Primary Job Responsibilities


Own weekly and monthly sales performance reporting covering pipeline, attainment, and pacing; run and maintain the WBR/MBR/QBR process end-to-end, including narrative framing and exec-ready dashboards
Build and maintain executive OKR and revenue dashboards across the full GTM funnel and post-sale lifecycle, ensuring consistent KPI definitions and reporting standards
Conduct marketing funnel analytics, campaign ROI measurement, lead routing and distribution analysis, and territory design and capacity planning analytics across global offices
Partner with Customer Success on customer lifecycle, retention, and expansion analytics; build and interpret reporting from Salesforce, Marketo, and Gong to surface clear, actionable insights
Facilitate the forecasting process across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, owning cadence, inputs, scenario reviews, and translation into the business narrative
Proactively generate insights indexed to business impact, surfacing what the business should be asking before it thinks to ask
Validate hypotheses raised by operational, field, or finance leaders, delivering rigorous analysis that confirms, challenges, or reframes the original question
Champion data quality, governance, and KPI consistency across revenue systems; identify opportunities for automation and advanced analytics in partnership with data science counterparts
Collaborate cross-functionally with RevOps, GTM Operations, Marketing Ops, and business stakeholders to align analytics work to commercial priorities
Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors
Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or Finance
3+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or finance operations
Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future


Preferred Qualifications


Solid understanding of B2B GTM and revenue metrics including pipeline health, funnel conversion, retention, expansion, and forecasting; familiarity with Salesforce reporting required, experience with Marketo or Gong is a plus
Demonstrated ability to build intuitive dashboards and compelling visualizations that help business leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make confident, data-driven decisions across a variety of analytics platforms
Strong command of SQL and hands-on experience querying large datasets in modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery); comfort navigating messy, high-volume data is essential
Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex data into plain language for senior stakeholders, with strong cross-functional instincts and comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and technical teams
Genuine curiosity about AI-assisted analytics and intelligent automation, and willingness to actively adopt emerging tools


Benefits + Compensation at PitchBook:

Physical Health


Comprehensive health benefits
Additional medical wellness incentives
STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance


Emotional Health


Paid sabbatical program after four years
Paid family and paternity leave
Annual educational stipend
Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement
CFA exam stipend
Robust training programs on industry and soft skills
Employee assistance program
Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days


Social Health


Matching gifts program
Employee resource groups
Subsidized emergency childcare
Dependent Care FSA
Company-wide events
Employee referral bonus program
Quarterly team building events


Financial Health


401k match
Shared ownership employee stock program
Monthly transportation stipend
Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.


Compensation


Annual base salary: $115,000-$130,000
Target annual bonus percentage: 10%


Working Conditions

At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can’t be replicated remotely. This role is expected to be in the office 5 days a week.

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

We are excited to get to know you and your background. Concerned that you might not meet every requirement? We encourage you to still apply as you might be the right candidate for the role or other roles at PitchBook.

About The Job

The Google.org Tech for Social Impact (TSI) team accelerates social impact through technology by providing data infrastructure and tools to nonprofits and civic entities. We unify Google.org’s global giving data into a single source of truth, building standardized models and implementing robust metrics to empower leadership to track and maximize our philanthropic impact.

In this role, you will deliver end-to-end business intelligence projects aligned with Google.org’s Research and Evaluation Strategy. Using your expertise in SQL, data modeling, and BI tools, you will design scalable data structures and maintain ETL pipelines to unify funding records with research findings. You will manage ambiguous problems, such as operationalizing counterfactual models, and enhance our BI infrastructure. Ultimately, you will translate complex impact metrics into clear, actionable dashboards that enable teams and leadership to measure program performance.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $116000 - $166000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .


Deliver full pieces of Business Intelligence (BI) work integrated into Google.org’s measurement strategy with minimal assistance, exploring the “why” of problems beyond the surface-level ask.
Design data structures, relational schemas, and data models (across business intelligence platform, CRM tooling, and Google.org's harmonized data infrastructure) to store, link, and retrieve longitudinal funding and other data.
Calculate and automate moderately complex impact metrics for all Google.org’s annual and program-specific reporting initiatives using standardized models, external benchmarks, and counterfactual assumptions.
Operationalize pillar metric calculations across Google.org pillar areas including Knowledge, Skills and Learning (KSL), Scientific Progress (SP), Stronger Communities (SC), and Global Programs (GP).
Review, validate, and profile incoming data to diagnose reporting anomalies, maintain related ETL pipelines, and land self-service BI dashboards.

Description:
Job Title: Decision Support Analyst

Req: 2026-0919

Shift:

Type: Full Time

City State: Renton, WA

Category Professional ( NCNM)
