Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
The Data Analyst turns data into information, information into insight and insight into business decisions that may be best applied to profit. The Data Analyst identifies opportunities and challenges as well as their solutions across multiple departments, to support critical tactical and strategic decisions of CorVel.

This is a remote position.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities


Provides strategic and tactical support to the organization by analyzing and interpreting data to provide creative solutions
Develops and implements data collection systems and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and data quality
Analyzes results of collected data using statistical techniques and provides ongoing reports
Identifies, analyzes and interprets trends or patterns in complex data sets
Supports end-to-end analysis development, management and delivery
Interfaces between various business and technical teams to understand context and business value in data
Works closely with internal customers to build relationships; continuously gaining a deeper understanding of relevant data and processes to build analytic solutions to meet business needs
Produces dynamic, meaningful, clear and informative reports and dashboards using standard business intelligence tools to help executive management solve highly complex problems
Additional projects and duties as assigned


Knowledge & Skills


Mathematics, statistics and data analysis
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to find resources and data both within the organization and external to it
Ability to understand business objectives and passion for gleaning information and insights from data to help the team achieve them
Strong computer proficiency and technical aptitude
Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy
Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
Ability to work both independently and within a team environment


Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree, preferably in a quantitative field
2-5 years of experience with data analysis
Familiarity with standard statistics and business intelligence tools (e.g. Excel, SPSS, SAS, Tableau, Chartio, etc.)
Familiarity with standard reporting packages (i.e. Business Objects), databases (SQL Server, SSIS), programming (SML, JavaScript, or ETL frameworks)
Exposure to data models, database design development, data mining and segmentation techniques


PAY RANGE

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location. Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors: federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions. Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range: $52,999 – $85,473

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

Title: Sr Data Analyst
Description:
Company

Shared Services

Argo and Farm Family are specialty property and casualty insurance brands whose underwriting companies are wholly-owned subsidiaries of Clearbrook Holdings Inc. Argo and Farm Family partner with agents and brokers to provide insurance solutions that enable businesses to manage risks with confidence.

Job Description

Summary:

The Sr Data Analyst partners with stakeholders across P&C Operations (Underwriting, Product, Actuarial, Claims, and Marketing) to deliver advanced analytical insights that inform business strategy and operational decision-making.

This role’s responsibility includes performing data analysis (e.g., conceptualization, mining/modeling, and presentation of data) and developing methods to efficiently capture, manage, and analyze data.

The position serves as a trusted partner to business leaders by translating complex data into clear, actionable insights and identifying opportunities to improve processes and outcomes.

This is a 100% in-office position. Candidates must be able to work on-site at a designated company office during standard business hours.

Essential Responsibilities


Partners with stakeholders to define business problems, translate data needs into analytical solutions, and ensure alignment between business objectives and data outputs.
Develops and maintains methods to distribute management information, as appropriate, throughout P&C Operations using tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Designs, develops, and maintains dashboards (Power BI), reports, and data products for use throughout P&C Operations using the tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Develops and optimizes SQL queries, Python/PySpark scripts, and data pipelines to extract, transform, and validate data for analysis and reporting.
Independently leads analytics initiatives, managing priorities, timelines, and deliverables from intake through deployment.
Responds to support questions promptly, courteously, and accurately, with an analysis of the results and any issues or changes made with minimal guidance.
Synthesizes analytical findings into clear insights and recommendations, tailoring communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure enterprise reporting and analytics adhere to defined data governance standards, business rules, and data quality expectations.
Validates data accuracy and completeness across source systems and downstream reporting layers, identifying trends, anomalies, and data quality issues. Performs quality assurance checks to validate completeness and accuracy of data and/or deliverables for release with minimal guidance.
Supports recurring operational data needs (e.g., month‑end, quarter‑end, and ongoing production reporting cycles) by ensuring timely, accurate delivery of analytics and reports.
Identifies trends, patterns, and opportunities within data to support process improvements and strategic initiatives.

Additional Responsibilities


Document, update, and utilize the policies, procedures, and processes used throughout P&C Operations.
Mentor junior analysts by reviewing policies, procedures, and processes and validating the queries/code, reports, and dashboards for accuracy and quality.
Proactively identify opportunities with the appropriate stakeholders to remedy the errors timely with minimal guidance.
Ensures that the data produced remains secure, respecting corporate privacy and security procedures.
Assists with training for stakeholders in areas such as proper data usage, SQL, or Power BI.
Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to ensure alignment between analytics solutions and enterprise data platforms (e.g., cloud data warehouses, semantic models, and BI environments).


Qualifications / Experience Required


Four to six years of relevant work experience
Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, computer science, data science, data analytics, or a related field. Equivalent work experience in a business or technical environment will be considered in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
Proficient in Python/PySpark, SQL (CTE, window functions) and Power BI using graphs, charts, and map features.
Experience in data quality control/governance, data mining, and modeling
Working knowledge of emerging analytics technology (e.g., Agentic AI/ML concepts)
Strong soft skills with clear, effective oral and written communication.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake Ecosystem, and Visual Studio Code
Strong understanding of Property & Casualty insurance data concepts and operational workflows is preferred.


The base salary range provided below is for hires in those geographic areas only and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.

Omaha & Albany Pay Range $95,000 - $115,000

Chicago Pay Range $103,000 - $133,000

NYC Pay Range $113,000 - $143,000

Please Note

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. At this time, we are not able to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas.

If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar state or local law and you wish to discuss potential reasonable accommodations related to applying for employment with us, please contact our Benefits Department at 210-321-8400.

Benefits And Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation package, performance-based incentives, and a comprehensive benefits program—including health, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Core Values

At Clearbrook our Core Values are Integrity, Collaboration, Pursuit of Excellence and Forward Thinking. These values reflect who we are today and who we aspire to be - guiding how we work, how we lead and how we succeed.

Title: Rural Health Data Analyst
Description:
At the Illinois Primary Health Care Association, we educate, empower and advocate for Illinois’ community health centers so every person across the state can access the cutting-edge, compassionate care they need. We are searching for a Rural Health Data Analyst to support rural healthcare transformation initiatives through data collection, analysis, reporting, and performance measurement.




This position works with rural healthcare providers and internal teams to translate healthcare data into actionable insights that improve quality outcomes, support population health management, strengthen program evaluation efforts, and inform strategic decision-making. The Rural Health Data Analyst assists with developing dashboards, monitoring key performance indicators, identifying trends, and ensuring data integrity across multiple healthcare and grant-funded initiatives.




Duties:

• Collect, validate, clean, and analyze healthcare and programmatic data from multiple sources, including:

o Electronic Health Records (EHRs)

o Practice Management Systems

o Health Information Exchanges (HIEs)

o Claims and billing systems

o Population health platforms

o Surveys and program databases

• Analyze healthcare utilization, quality metrics, and operational performance indicators.

• Identify trends, patterns, disparities, and opportunities for improvement.

• Conduct ad hoc analyses to support program initiatives and organizational decision-making.

• Develop and maintain routine and ad hoc reports for leadership, stakeholders, and participating organizations.

• Create interactive dashboards and visualizations using reporting and business intelligence tools.

• Work with the project evaluation team to ensure data reporting supports programmatic needs.

• Monitor key metrics such as:

o Clinical quality measures

o Preventive screening rates

o Chronic disease outcomes

o Behavioral health integration measures

o Access and utilization metrics

o Value-based performance measures

• Present findings in a clear and understandable manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Support data reporting requirements for state and federal programs.

• Provide comparative analysis using project specific metrics and the Uniform Data System (UDS)

annual reports.

• Support program evaluations and continuous quality improvement initiatives.

• Collaborate with Rural Health Practice Transformation Coach and other program staff to

monitor project progress.

• Provide technical assistance regarding data interpretation and reporting.

• Develop educational materials, toolkits, and resources.

• Build strong relationships with healthcare providers, administrators, and community partners.




Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Health Informatics, Statistics,

Data Science, Computer Science, Epidemiology, or related field. Preference given to graduate

level applications.

• Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in healthcare data analysis, reporting or program

evaluation.

• Experience working with healthcare datasets and reporting systems.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, SQL, Data Visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.




Valued Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Knowledge of healthcare quality improvement and population health concepts.

• Understanding of healthcare data structures and clinical workflows.

• Ability to interpret healthcare regulations and reporting requirements.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

• Ability to communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.

• Knowledge of HIPAA and data privacy requirements.




Other Necessary Skills and Abilities:

• Must be able to work in a fast-paced diverse workplace in a team environment.

• Must be able to present a business image to people who have diverse interests and ideas.

• Must be able to travel and attend meetings as requested, including some overnight stays.

• Must be able to work independently.

• Must have a valid Illinois driver’s license.

• Must be able to use your own automobile and have all liability and other automobile insurance

as required by law.




Physical Requirements and Work Environment:

The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Work is performed in a normal office environment with remote working options available. While performing the duties of this job employee will be sitting at a desk for extended periods of time. May be required to lift up to 15 pounds at times.




Full-time, Exempt

Pay: $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Springfield, IL 62704




Benefits:

Dental insurance
Employee assistance program
Flexible spending account
Health insurance
Health savings account
Life insurance
Paid time off
Parental leave
Professional development assistance
Retirement plan
Vision insurance




Additional Information:

We are a proud participant in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security’s E‑Verify program. All new hires will be required to complete the Form I‑9 and have their employment eligibility confirmed through E‑Verify.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Saturn is a returns-driven Canadian energy company focused on the efficient, responsible and innovative development of high-quality, light oil weighted assets, supported by an acquisition strategy targeting accretive and complementary opportunities. The Company’s portfolio of free-cash flowing, low-decline operated assets in Saskatchewan and Alberta provide a deep inventory of long-term economic drilling opportunities across multiple zones. With an unwavering commitment to building an entrepreneurial focused culture, Saturn’s goal is to increase per share reserves, production and cash flow at an attractive return on invested capital. We proudly integrate the protection of the environment, ethical and fair treatment of our employees and stakeholders, and strive to be at the forefront of what it means to be a good corporate citizen.

Saturn has an opportunity for a full-time Information Services (IS) Data Analyst based in Calgary, Alberta. Reporting to the Team Lead, Business Applications & Data Analytics, the Data Analyst is responsible for transforming enterprise data into meaningful insights that support operational efficiency, strategic decision-making, and business performance. This role will work closely with stakeholders across the organization to develop reporting solutions, maintain data quality, and support the ongoing growth of Saturn's analytics and data platform capabilities.

Some specific duties, and responsibilities of the Data Analyst include, but are not limited to:

Business Intelligence & Reporting


Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI and other reporting tools.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and deliver actionable insights.
Design and support self-service analytics solutions that enable business users to access trusted data.
Analyze business performance trends and identify opportunities for operational improvements.
Create and maintain reporting documentation, data dictionaries, and metric definitions.


Data Analysis & Insights


Collect, validate, and analyze data from multiple enterprise systems.
Perform ad hoc analysis to support operational, financial, land, production, and corporate initiatives.
Identify data trends, anomalies, and opportunities to improve business outcomes.
Support forecasting, planning, and performance measurement activities through analytical reporting.
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.


Data Quality & Governance


Monitor data quality and identify inconsistencies across business systems.
Assist in establishing and maintaining data governance standards and best practices.
Participate in data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance processes.
Collaborate with business teams to improve data accuracy and consistency at the source.
Support data stewardship initiatives and governance processes.


Data Platform & Integration Support


Work with internal and external partners to support data integrations and reporting environments.
Assist with the development and maintenance of data models, semantic layers, and curated datasets.
Support testing and validation activities related to data pipelines and reporting solutions.
Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of Saturn's analytics platform and reporting architecture.


Stakeholder Collaboration


Build strong relationships with business units to understand operational priorities and reporting needs.
Facilitate discussions on reporting requirements, KPI definitions, and data-related challenges.
Provide training and support to end users on reporting tools and analytics solutions.
Promote data-driven decision-making throughout the organization.


Qualifications And Competencies


Post-secondary degree in Computer Science, Information Management, Data Analytics, Business, Commerce, or a related field.
3-7 years of experience in a data analyst, business intelligence, reporting, or analytics role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into business insights.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
Experience in the upstream oil and gas industry.
Familiarity with Qbyte FM, CS Land, Metrix, OpenInvoice, Execute, and WellView.
Understanding of production, finance, land, or operations reporting.


Technical Skills Required


Advanced SQL experience.
Experience developing reports and dashboards in Power BI.
Strong understanding of relational databases and data modeling concepts.
Experience performing data validation, reconciliation, and quality analysis.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.


Preferred


Experience with Python for data analysis and automation.
Familiarity with Databricks, Azure Data Services, or cloud-based analytics platforms.
Understanding of ETL/ELT processes and data integration concepts.
Experience working with large or complex datasets.
Exposure to data governance and master data management practices.


If you are interested in joining our rapidly growing organization, please submit your cover letter and resume.

Saturn’s people drive our success. We offer an inclusive work environment where we embrace a diversity of people, thinking and ideas and a culture that supports personal and professional development. We want to thank all applicants for their interest in this role, however, only those considered for interviews will be contacted .

Title: Data Analyst/Data & Measurement Analyst
Description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Data Analyst/Data & Measurement Analyst to provide sustained, hands-on analytical capacity for Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) modernization initiatives. The role develops baselines, recurring metrics, validated calculations, dashboards, data-quality checks, and outcome evidence that help teams understand performance and make informed decisions.

This position follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation of approximately 25% onsite presence at LMI’s Tysons headquarters or Washington, DC.

The Data Analyst/Data & Measurement Analyst provides the recurring analytical backbone needed to turn agreed definitions into reliable evidence. The role is responsible for making sure metrics can be reproduced, reconciled, explained, and refreshed consistently rather than producing one-time analyses that are difficult to sustain.

The ideal candidate is detail- oriented but outcome focused. The analyst should be able to move from source data through cleaning, transformation, calculation, visualization, and narrative interpretation while maintaining a clear audit trail of definitions, assumptions, filters, denominators, and known data limitations.

The role depends heavily on stakeholder trust. The analyst should be able to explain why numbers changed, where a discrepancy came from, and what a measure actually represents . Strong candidates will not treat dashboard production as the end goal; they will focus on creating measures that stakeholders can understand and use consistently.

The ideal candidate is a strong execution analyst who can turn messy operational data into clear, traceable metrics and communicate what the numbers do - and do not - support.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities


Prepare, clean, combine, transform, and validate data from multiple sources.
Calculate baselines, recurring metrics, before/after measures, denominators, and outcome indicators.
Build analytical tables, visualizations, dashboards, and decision-ready reporting products.
Document metric definitions, data sources, cadence, validation steps, assumptions, and calculation logic.
Perform data-quality checks, reconcile discrepancies, and maintain reproducible analytical workflows.
Support outcome reports with validated findings, concise narrative, and clear limitations.
Respond to recurring and ad-hoc analytical questions for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Escalate data-quality, access, or methodology concerns that could materially affect conclusions.
Develop and maintain metric dictionaries that define business rules, source fields, exclusions, denominators, refresh cadence, validation steps, owners, and interpretation guidance.
Automate repeatable data-preparation, quality-check, calculation, and reporting steps where practical to reduce manual effort and improve consistency over time.
Reconcile discrepancies across source systems, reports, and stakeholder calculations and document the resolution when definitions or authoritative sources differ.
Support ad-hoc analytical questions by quickly profiling data, testing hypotheses, and translating results into concise findings while preserving reproducibility.
Work with stakeholders to translate reporting needs into precise metric definitions, data requirements, calculation rules, validation checks, and acceptance criteria before building recurring products.
Perform periodic quality reviews of dashboards and recurring reports to identify stale logic, broken refreshes, source changes, unexpected trends, or definition drift that could undermine confidence in the results.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, economics, public health, information systems, business analytics, or a related field.
4+ years in data analysis, reporting, performance measurement, business intelligence, or related work.
Strong SQL plus at least one analytical tool such as Python, R, SAS, or advanced Excel.
Experience with data preparation, validation, dashboards, recurring metrics, and documentation of assumptions/limitations.
Recommended certification: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst or comparable BI/data-analytics credential.
Ability to satisfy VA personnel vetting and applicable security, privacy, records, and data-handling requirements.
Demonstrated ability to build reliable recurring analyses from imperfect operational data, including validation, reconciliation, exception handling, and documentation of assumptions.
Strong practical skills with SQL, Excel and/or Python/R plus a visualization tool, with enough technical depth to trace a metric from dashboard output back to source data and calculation logic.
Clear analytical writing and communication skills, including the ability to explain definitions, data-quality concerns, limitations, and changes in results to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience eliciting and documenting reporting requirements, metric definitions, business rules, and acceptance criteria with business or mission stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple recurring and ad-hoc analytical requests, prioritize based on decision need and effort, and communicate realistic timelines when data access or quality is a constraint.


Desired Qualifications


6+ years supporting federal, healthcare, operational, implementation, utilization , or outcome measurement.
Experience with Power BI, Power Query, DAX, SQL Server, Azure data tools, or similar enterprise analytics platforms.
Experience supporting pilot measurement, program evaluation, before/after analysis, or clinical/operational metrics.
Additional SQL, cloud analytics, data visualization, or Lean Six Sigma certification is preferred.
Experience with Power BI semantic models, DAX, Power Query, SQL Server, automated refresh, data quality monitoring, or controlled reporting environments is preferred.
Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst, data analytics, SQL, or comparable business-intelligence certification is valuable.
Experience supporting executive dashboards, operational performance reviews, benefits measurement, or program-evaluation reporting in a federal or healthcare environment is preferred.
Exposure to governed semantic models, certified datasets, data catalogs, lineage tools, or enterprise reporting standards is beneficial.


Target salary range: $135,000-$160,000

Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

Overview

LMI is seeking a Data Analyst to support Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) modernization initiatives. These full-time positions provide scalable, hands-on analytical capacity across operational improvement, digital modernization, workflow analysis, performance measurement, data-quality assessment, reporting, and decision support.

This position follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation of approximately 25% onsite presence at LMI’s Tysons headquarters or Washington, DC.

The analysts will turn business and mission questions into defensible analysis by identifying data needs, assessing source quality, preparing and validating data, performing exploratory and recurring analysis, and presenting results in clear, decision-ready formats. Work may include ad-hoc analysis, dashboards, baselines, trends, cohorts, data profiling, and support to pilots or implementation decisions.

The role works closely with data science, data integration, program evaluation, clinical informatics, delivery, and technical teams. Specialized leads retain responsibility for advanced modeling, formal evaluation methodology , complex integration architecture, and clinical interpretation; these analysts provide the scalable execution needed to move multiple workstreams forward.

Candidates should independently execute well-scoped analyses and manage recurring analytical products. Level IV candidates should bring deeper experience owning complex multi-source analysis, shaping approaches, reviewing work, and advising stakeholders. Strong candidates combine practical SQL and analytical skills with disciplined documentation, data-quality judgment, and concise communication.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities


Profile enterprise, operational, workflow, program, survey, or other approved data for availability, completeness, consistency, quality, and fitness for use.
Extract, query, join, clean, transform, and validate data using SQL and tools such as Python, R, Excel, Power Query, or comparable platforms.
Perform exploratory, descriptive, trend, cohort, segmentation, variance, and before/after analysis appropriate to the decision need and available data.
Build analysis-ready datasets, analytical tables, visualizations, dashboards, and concise decision-support products for technical and non-technical audiences.
Translate stakeholder questions into data requirements, metric definitions, filters, denominators, business rules, validation checks, and analytical outputs.
Document sources, definitions, transformations, assumptions, exclusions, calculation logic, validation steps, and known limitations so results are reproducible and reviewable.
Reconcile discrepancies across systems, reports, dashboards, or stakeholder calculations and identify the source of inconsistent results.
Support data-readiness assessments by identifying authoritative sources, access dependencies, missing fields, sensitivity constraints, and material data-quality risks.
Partner with data integration and engineering resources when analysis depends on new extracts, mappings, pipelines, interfaces, or automated data movement.
Support data science and evaluation work through data preparation, descriptive baselines, validation datasets, quality checks, and interpretation of source limitations.
Automate repeatable preparation, validation, calculation, and reporting steps where practical and maintain organized code, files, dictionaries, and version history.
Perform quality assurance and reasonableness checks before results are released; escalate data or methodology concerns that could materially change conclusions.
Communicate findings in plain language, including what changed, what appears meaningful, what remains uncertain, and what the data cannot support.
Lead higher-complexity analysis, conduct peer review, mentor analysts, and represent the analytical team in stakeholder discussions.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, economics, operations research, computer science, information systems, public health, engineering, or a related quantitative field; equivalent experience may be considered.
4+ years of relevant data analysis, business intelligence, performance analysis, reporting, or operational analytics experience. Level IV placement will generally require 7+ years plus independent ownership of complex analysis.
Strong SQL skills and proficiency with at least one additional analytical tool such as Python, R, SAS, advanced Excel, Power Query, or a comparable platform.
Experience preparing and validating multi-source data, including joins, transformations, duplicate handling, missing-data review, exception analysis, and reconciliation.
Working knowledge of descriptive statistics, trends, distributions, baselines, comparisons, sampling concepts, and appropriate interpretation of observational data.
Experience developing analytical tables, dashboards, visualizations, reports, or decision-support products with traceable source data and calculation logic.
Ability to translate ambiguous stakeholder questions into clear analytical requirements and adjust the approach when available data does not support the original request.
Strong data-quality judgment and clear communication of definitions, assumptions, methods, limitations, and uncertainty to technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience maintaining reproducible analytical work through documented queries/code, data dictionaries, version control, peer review, or comparable quality practices.
Recommended certification: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst, Azure Data Fundamentals, Tableau Certified Data Analyst, or a comparable analytics credential.
Ability to satisfy VA personnel vetting and applicable security, privacy, records-management, and data-handling requirements.


Desired Qualifications


6+ years supporting enterprise, federal, healthcare, operational, program, or mission analytics; 8+ years is especially valuable for Level IV candidates.
Prior VA, VHA, federal health, or other federal analytics experience in a large, governed enterprise environment.
Experience with healthcare, workforce, utilization , productivity, workflow, adoption, service delivery, quality, customer experience, or outcome data.
Advanced experience with Power BI, DAX, Power Query, SQL Server, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Tableau, or comparable enterprise analytics technologies.
Experience with APIs, semantic models, data warehouses/ lakehouses , ETL/ELT outputs, or governed datasets and coordination with data engineering teams.
Experience supporting pilot analysis, implementation measurement, program evaluation, benefits tracking, or AI/ML evaluation under appropriate technical leadership.
Additional certification or training in Power BI, Fabric, Databricks, Tableau, cloud analytics, SQL/data engineering, statistics, or Lean Six Sigma is preferred.

Specialized leads retain responsibility for advanced modeling, formal evaluation methodology , complex integration architecture, and clinical interpretation; these analysts provide the scalable execution needed to move multiple workstreams forward.

Candidates should independently execute well-scoped analyses and manage recurring analytical products. Level IV candidates should bring deeper experience owning complex multi-source analysis, shaping approaches, reviewing work, and advising stakeholders. Strong candidates combine practical SQL and analytical skills with disciplined documentation, data-quality judgment, and concise communication.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Profile enterprise, operational, workflow, program, survey, or other approved data for availability, completeness, consistency, quality, and fitness for use.
  • Extract, query, join, clean, transform, and validate data using SQL and tools such as Python, R, Excel, Power Query, or comparable platforms.
  • Perform exploratory, descriptive, trend, cohort, segmentation, variance, and before/after analysis appropriate to the decision need and available data.
  • Build analysis-ready datasets, analytical tables, visualizations, dashboards, and concise decision-support products for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Translate stakeholder questions into data requirements, metric definitions, filters, denominators, business rules, validation checks, and analytical outputs.
  • Document sources, definitions, transformations, assumptions, exclusions, calculation logic, validation steps, and known limitations so results are reproducible and reviewable.
  • Reconcile discrepancies across systems, reports, dashboards, or stakeholder calculations and identify the source of inconsistent results.
  • Support data-readiness assessments by identifying authoritative sources, access dependencies, missing fields, sensitivity constraints, and material data-quality risks.
  • Partner with data integration and engineering resources when analysis depends on new extracts, mappings, pipelines, interfaces, or automated data movement.
  • Support data science and evaluation work through data preparation, descriptive baselines, validation datasets, quality checks, and interpretation of source limitations.
  • Automate repeatable preparation, validation, calculation, and reporting steps where practical and maintain organized code, files, dictionaries, and version history.
  • Perform quality assurance and reasonableness checks before results are released; escalate data or methodology concerns that could materially change conclusions.
  • Communicate findings in plain language, including what changed, what appears meaningful, what remains uncertain, and what the data cannot support.
  • Lead higher-complexity analysis, conduct peer review, mentor analysts, and represent the analytical team in stakeholder discussions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, economics, operations research, computer science, information systems, public health, engineering, or a related quantitative field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 4+ years of relevant data analysis, business intelligence, performance analysis, reporting, or operational analytics experience. Level IV placement will generally require 7+ years plus independent ownership of complex analysis.
  • Strong SQL skills and proficiency with at least one additional analytical tool such as Python, R, SAS, advanced Excel, Power Query, or a comparable platform.
  • Experience preparing and validating multi-source data, including joins, transformations, duplicate handling, missing-data review, exception analysis, and reconciliation.
  • Working knowledge of descriptive statistics, trends, distributions, baselines, comparisons, sampling concepts, and appropriate interpretation of observational data.
  • Experience developing analytical tables, dashboards, visualizations, reports, or decision-support products with traceable source data and calculation logic.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous stakeholder questions into clear analytical requirements and adjust the approach when available data does not support the original request.
  • Strong data-quality judgment and clear communication of definitions, assumptions, methods, limitations, and uncertainty to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience maintaining reproducible analytical work through documented queries/code, data dictionaries, version control, peer review, or comparable quality practices.
  • Recommended certification: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst, Azure Data Fundamentals, Tableau Certified Data Analyst, or a comparable analytics credential.
  • Ability to satisfy VA personnel vetting and applicable security, privacy, records-management, and data-handling requirements.

Desired Qualifications

  • 6+ years supporting enterprise, federal, healthcare, operational, program, or mission analytics; 8+ years is especially valuable for Level IV candidates.
  • Prior VA, VHA, federal health, or other federal analytics experience in a large, governed enterprise environment.
  • Experience with healthcare, workforce, utilization , productivity, workflow, adoption, service delivery, quality, customer experience, or outcome data.
  • Advanced experience with Power BI, DAX, Power Query, SQL Server, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Tableau, or comparable enterprise analytics technologies.
  • Experience with APIs, semantic models, data warehouses/ lakehouses , ETL/ELT outputs, or governed datasets and coordination with data engineering teams.
  • Experience supporting pilot analysis, implementation measurement, program evaluation, benefits tracking, or AI/ML evaluation under appropriate technical leadership.
  • Additional certification or training in Power BI, Fabric, Databricks, Tableau, cloud analytics, SQL/data engineering, statistics, or Lean Six Sigma is preferred.

In 2023, we rebranded as NovumHealth with the expansion of our services in Arizona, California, and Utah.

Create comprehensive reports that combine storytelling with quantitative insights to drive actionable recommendations.
Identify and communicate opportunities for process improvement or cost optimization through data analysis.
Support ad hoc requests for data analysis, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of results.
Collaborate with crossfunctional teams, including clinicians, IT, and operations, to ensure alignment of data analytics with organizational goals.
Stay updated on industry trends, tools, and best practices in healthcare analytics.

Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics and statistical modeling.
Familiarity with electronic medical records systems.
Advanced proficiency in Power BI for developing dashboards and visualizations.
Strong SQL skills for querying relational databases and preparing datasets for analysis.
Experience with data cleaning and working with large, complex datasets.
Indepth understanding of healthcare performance metrics, including HEDIS, NCQA, and valuebased care frameworks.
Exceptional storytelling skills to present data in a meaningful way to diverse stakeholders.
Strong critical thinking and problemsolving abilities to uncover insights and recommend solutions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to explain complex data findings to nontechnical audiences.

Bachelor’s degree Analytics, Data Analytics, Health Informatics, or a related field.

3+ years of experience with healthcare analytics, with a strong focus on clinical and operational data.
Proven experience with claims data analysis, including familiarity with total cost of care and utilization metrics.
Certified Healthcare Data Analyst (CHDA) certification or similar credentials.
Must pass drug screening and background check in order to start employment with NovumHealth.

Experience in Power BI, SQL, R, and other complex data analysis.

Stays abreast of healthcare trends and market development as context for analyses, and becomes proficient with the health system's decision support and other systems.

Ensures data integrity and data quality, regularly reviews data for accuracy, identifies trends, and communicates changes.
Other duties as assigned.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Allied Health or related required. Master's degree in Public Health, Finance, Epidemiology, Biostatistics or equivalent preferred.
2-5 years related work experience.
Strong experience in data management and analytic tools and techniques; Strong experience in report writing, analytics, visualizations, dashboard creation; Strong experience demonstrating analytical, financial, qualitative and quantitative skills.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
This position can be based in the Washington D.C or Chicago, IL office.




Position Summary

NAR is seeking a Data Analyst to help deliver data-driven insights, analytics solutions, and AI-enabled products that support decision-making across the organization. This role focuses on working directly with business stakeholders to understand analytical requirements, transform complex and fragmented data into actionable information, and build scalable solutions that provide measurable business value.




The Data Analyst will design and implement data preparation processes, perform advanced analysis, and develop applications and visualizations. They will make data and analysis accessible to non-technical audiences. The role works extensively within the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric ecosystems and involves close collaboration with data scientists, and business stakeholders in different parts of the organization.




The successful candidate will contribute to data quality initiatives, AI-assisted analytics workflows, and the development of new solutions that leverage both traditional analytics and AI technologies. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across analytics, visualization, and application development disciplines, with a practical focus on delivering solutions that are reliable, scalable, and widely adopted by the business.




Duties And Responsibilities

Partner with business stakeholders and non-technical teams to gather requirements, identify opportunities, and deliver data-driven solutions
Extract, transform, clean, and validate data from multiple internal and external sources to support analytics, reporting, and operational decision-making
Develop and maintain Python notebooks using SQL, Spark, and related technologies for data analysis, exploration, and reporting
Create dashboards that effectively communicate insights to business audiences using technologies such as Power BI, Streamlit, Django, and other frameworks
Collaborate with Data Scientists on data quality initiatives, statistical analyses, AI-assisted testing frameworks, and machine learning-related projects
Participate in source control, deployment, and project management processes using tools such as Git and Jira
Other duties, as assigned




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.
Minimum of 2+ years of professional experience in data analytics or a related technical role.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including experience writing complex queries.
Strong Python development skills, including working with notebooks, expertise with data analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, SciPy), and use of visualization libraries (e.g., Plotly, Matplotlib).
Experience building dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Streamlit, or Django.
Experience working with cloud-based platforms and services; Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric experience preferred.
Use of Git and use of project management systems such as Jira.
Good grasp of basic statistical concepts.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to non-technical audiences.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
Experience with AI, such as the use of AI-code generation, is a positive.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for data analysis and reporting are preferred




Compensation: $75,000 - $95,000 depending on office location

NAR provides comprehensive benefits including health/dental/vision insurance.

NAR is on a hybrid schedule and in the office 3 days a week.




Organizational Overview

The National Association of REALTORS® (NAR) is a team of professionals dedicated to providing world-class service to approximately 1.5 million REALTORS® working in the United States and around the world. The real estate industry is fast-paced and fast-changing--each year, our members participate in the sale, lease, and management of real estate. As in every industry, our members’ value proposition is constantly being challenged by innovation.




It is our mission to empower REALTORS® as they preserve, protect and advance the right to real property for all. We cannot do that without the ideas, passion, and commitment from our talented employees. As our greatest assets, employees are offered their pick of competitive benefits/perks and flexible work options.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Enterprise Services
Description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation


Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives


Business Intelligence


Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies


Data Management


Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality


Our ideal candidate will have:


Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services


Basic Qualifications:


Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms


Preferred Qualifications:


Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
Summary:

The Sr Data Analyst partners with stakeholders across P&C Operations (Underwriting, Product, Actuarial, Claims, and Marketing) to deliver advanced analytical insights that inform business strategy and operational decision-making.




This role’s responsibility includes performing data analysis (e.g., conceptualization, mining/modeling, and presentation of data) and developing methods to efficiently capture, manage, and analyze data.




The position serves as a trusted partner to business leaders by translating complex data into clear, actionable insights and identifying opportunities to improve processes and outcomes.

This is a 100% in-office position. Candidates must be able to work on-site at a designated company office during standard business hours.




Essential Responsibilities:

Partners with stakeholders to define business problems, translate data needs into analytical solutions, and ensure alignment between business objectives and data outputs.
Develops and maintains methods to distribute management information, as appropriate, throughout P&C Operations using tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Designs, develops, and maintains dashboards (Power BI), reports, and data products for use throughout P&C Operations using the tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Develops and optimizes SQL queries, Python/PySpark scripts, and data pipelines to extract, transform, and validate data for analysis and reporting.
Independently leads analytics initiatives, managing priorities, timelines, and deliverables from intake through deployment.
Responds to support questions promptly, courteously, and accurately, with an analysis of the results and any issues or changes made with minimal guidance.
Synthesizes analytical findings into clear insights and recommendations, tailoring communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure enterprise reporting and analytics adhere to defined data governance standards, business rules, and data quality expectations.
Validates data accuracy and completeness across source systems and downstream reporting layers, identifying trends, anomalies, and data quality issues. Performs quality assurance checks to validate completeness and accuracy of data and/or deliverables for release with minimal guidance.
Supports recurring operational data needs (e.g., month‑end, quarter‑end, and ongoing production reporting cycles) by ensuring timely, accurate delivery of analytics and reports.
Identifies trends, patterns, and opportunities within data to support process improvements and strategic initiatives.




Additional Responsibilities:

Document, update, and utilize the policies, procedures, and processes used throughout P&C Operations.
Mentor junior analysts by reviewing policies, procedures, and processes and validating the queries/code, reports, and dashboards for accuracy and quality.
Proactively identify opportunities with the appropriate stakeholders to remedy the errors timely with minimal guidance.
Ensures that the data produced remains secure, respecting corporate privacy and security procedures.
Assists with training for stakeholders in areas such as proper data usage, SQL, or Power BI.
Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to ensure alignment between analytics solutions and enterprise data platforms (e.g., cloud data warehouses, semantic models, and BI environments).




Qualifications / Experience Required:

Four to six years of relevant work experience
Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, computer science, data science, data analytics, or a related field. Equivalent work experience in a business or technical environment will be considered in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
Proficient in Python/PySpark, SQL (CTE, window functions) and Power BI using graphs, charts, and map features.
Experience in data quality control/governance, data mining, and modeling
Working knowledge of emerging analytics technology (e.g., Agentic AI/ML concepts)
Strong soft skills with clear, effective oral and written communication.




Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake Ecosystem, and Visual Studio Code
Strong understanding of Property & Casualty insurance data concepts and operational workflows is preferred.




The base salary range provided below is for hires in those geographic areas only and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.




$113,000 - $143,000

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will build the analytics layer that helps both Confido and our customers understand their financial and operational data. You’ll design dashboards, develop core metrics, and surface insights that drive decision-making across the platform.

This is a foundational role where you’ll help shape Confido’s data culture and establish how analytics are delivered internally and to customers.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)

What You'll Do


Partner with product, engineering, and customers to understand analytics needs
Design and build dashboards, reports, and analytical tools for internal and external users
Write complex SQL queries to analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets
Define and maintain key business metrics and KPIs
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within retailer and financial data
Drive analytical projects from exploration through delivery
Collaborate with engineers to improve data models and underlying datasets


Example Problems


Building custom dashboards for brands to understand retailer performance
Analyzing deduction and dispute data to identify operational inefficiencies
Designing analytics that help brands forecast sales and demand
Combining and transforming data into clean, analysis-ready datasets that power actionable insights
Turning complex financial data into intuitive visual insights


What We're Looking For

Required


4+ years of experience in data analysis or analytics roles
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Strong experience building dashboards and analytical reports
Ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations
Strong communication skills working with technical and non-technical stakeholders


Nice to Have


Experience with BI tools (Omni, Looker, Mode, etc.)
Experience working with financial, retail, or operational datasets
Comfort working directly with users
Interest in early-stage startups and high-ownership roles
Technical or quantitative degree


🌴 Perks + Benefits

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation


Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives


Business Intelligence


Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies


Data Management


Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality


Our ideal candidate will have:


Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services


Basic Qualifications:


Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms


Preferred Qualifications:


Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)

Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!
