Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead reporting and analytics efforts across operations. This role will focus on building scalable, accurate reporting, identifying insights from operational data, and enabling data-driven decisions across business and technology teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build end-to-end reporting solutions, including dashboards, recurring reports, and ad-hoc analysis aligned to business needs.
  • Partner with stakeholders across Operations, DQAS, OPCC, and Technology teams to define reporting requirements and KPIs.
  • Develop and maintain data models and pipelines to support reliable reporting.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for operational improvement.
  • Own data quality validation and ensure accuracy across reporting outputs.
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for leadership.
  • Drive standardization and automation of reporting processes to reduce manual effort.
  • Support incident analysis by providing data-backed root cause insights.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams on data sourcing, transformations, and performance optimization.

Required Skills

  • Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, performance tuning, and data validation.
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Proficiency in data wrangling and analysis using Python or R.
  • Experience working with large datasets and data warehouse platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, Hadoop, or similar technologies.
  • Understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines and data modeling concepts.
  • Strong Excel skills for ad-hoc analysis and validation work.
  • Experience with data quality frameworks and validation techniques.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with operational or real-time reporting environments.
  • Familiarity with railroad, logistics, or transportation data.
  • Exposure to the Azure data stack, including ADF, Synapse, and Databricks.
  • Understanding of event-driven systems and streaming data.

Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and the ability to translate data into business impact.
  • Ability to work across business and technology teams without formal authority.
  • Highly analytical with a strong problem-solving mindset.
  • Self-driven and able to operate in ambiguous and fast-paced environments.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in data analytics or reporting roles.
  • Proven experience building enterprise-grade reporting solutions.

The base salary for this position is $ 92,250 to $125,000 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do


Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We're Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Python or another coding language.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.


Why You'll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Title: Analyste de données / Data Analyst
Description:
***An English version will follow***




À propos de nous

Fondée en 2015, Data Sciences (DS) n'est pas une agence comme les autres. Nous sommes un groupe d’experts de pointe en analyse de données, en recherche, en marketing numérique et en campagnes d'engagement avec un objectif commun et ambitieux : inspirer des changements de comportement qui ont un impact réel.

Ensemble, nous offrons aux ONG canadiennes et internationales, aux partis politiques et aux grandes entreprises des conseils stratégiques et des analyses fondées sur des bases scientifiques rigoureuses. Notre but ? Les aider à mieux comprendre, mobiliser et approfondir leurs liens avec leurs clients et leurs parties prenantes.

Chez DS, on vit selon la « règle du campeur » : on s’engage à laisser chaque projet, partenariat et communauté dans un meilleur état qu'on l'a trouvé. Puisque notre mission est de comprendre l’humain, nous plaçons l’humain au premier plan. Ici, on valorise une culture de transparence, d’entraide et une bonne dose de memes sur Slack. Que ce soit lors de nos dîners d'été ou de nos pauses café virtuelles mensuelles, on priorise la connexion humaine autant que l'excellence technique.




Ce que nous offrons

** Échelle salariale : 80k - 95k CAD **
Un régime d'assurance médicale et dentaire compétitif, payé à 100 % par l'employeur.
Perkopolis: Un accès gratuit à une foule de rabais et d'économies sur les divertissements, les voyages, le magasinage et les produits de bien-être.
Mode de travail hybride avec un bureau dans le quartier St-Henri, approvisionné en collations et en café.
Une tonne d'activités et de traditions pour créer un environnement inclusif et divertissant.
Un ordinateur MacBook fourni dès ton arrivée.
3 semaines de vacances par année.
5 jours personnels à utiliser à ta discrétion.
Un environnement de travail dynamique où aucune journée ne se ressemble.
Des opportunités de croissance grâce au financement de cours, de conférences et de certifications.
Un bureau moderne avec une ambiance « startup ».
La chance de rejoindre une équipe multidisciplinaire en pleine croissance.




Description du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) analyste de données qui rejoindra notre équipe diversifiée et en pleine croissance à Montréal. La personne retenue sera responsable de l'exploitation des données des clients, afin de produire des rapports automatisés et des analyses personnalisées. Cette personne a de l'expérience dans la manipulation de grands ensembles de données, souvent complexes, autant structurées que non structurées. Nous recherchons des personnes d'horizons divers ayant des compétences démontrées en résolution de problèmes et en méthodes quantitatives. Nous valorisons la créativité, le travail acharné et l’excellence au travail. La personne idéale est très motivée, soucieuse du détail, curieuse et à la recherche de défis. Elle doit pouvoir travailler eﬃcacement avec les membres de nos équipes d'ingénierie des données, de recherche et de numérique.




Responsabilités

Interpréter les objectifs globaux du client et les traduire en exigences visant à fournir des renseignements (« insights ») et/ou à générer des gains d'eﬃcacité.
Accéder, comprendre, interroger et transformer des données provenant d’une grande variété de sources, chacune avec son propre ensemble de subtilités.
Concevoir, développer et déployer des rapports sur mesure et automatisés, dans le but de fournir aux clients des informations rapides et exploitables.
Concevoir et coordonner des protocoles expérimentaux dans divers départements afin d'identifier des gains d'eﬃcacité stratégiques.
Communiquer des idées et des méthodologies de manière claire et succincte, autant à un public technique que non-initié.
Participer à des projets spéciaux et autres tâches connexes selon les besoins.




Exigences

D’excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes.
2+ ans d'expérience en rédaction de requêtes SQL complexes, pour transformer et extraire des données de bases de données relationnelles ou d'entrepôts de données.
Expérience en Python et/ou R afin de manipuler et analyser de grands ensembles de données.
Connaissance de techniques et de concepts statistiques.
Excellentes aptitudes de communication écrite et orale.
Bilinguisme français et anglais.
Capacité à collaborer avec les membres d’autres équipes.




La connaissance de la langue anglaise est exigée pour ce poste, car les fonctions de la personne titulaire nécessiteront des communications quotidiennes avec une clientèle majoritairement anglophone située à l'extérieur du Québec.




--




About Us

Established in 2015, Data Sciences (DS) isn’t your typical agency. We are a group of leading experts in the fields of data analytics, research, digital marketing and engagement campaigns that have a common, ambitious goal: driving meaningful behaviour change.

Together, we provide Canadian and international NGOs, political parties, and major companies with well-designed, scientifically sound guidance, research, analytics, and marketing, in order to help them understand, engage and deepen their relationships with their customers and stakeholders.

Our culture is built on the Campsite Rule: we are committed to leaving every project, partnership, and community better than we found it. Because our mission is to understand people, we put people first. We value a culture of transparency, mutual support, and a healthy dose of Slack memes. Whether we’re enjoying summer lunches, or connecting during monthly virtual coffee breaks, we prioritize human connection as much as technical excellence.




What We Offer

** Salary range: 80k - 95k CAD **
100% employer-paid competitive health package including Medical & Dental benefit.
Perkopolis: a free program with discounts and savings on entertainment, hotels, travel, shopping and health and wellness products.
Hybrid work model with a snacks-and-coffee-stocked office in Montreal’s St-Henri neighbourhood.
Many internal traditions to create an inclusive and fun environment.
A MacBook computer on your first day.
3 weeks vacation.
5 personal days to use at your discretion.
A fast-paced work environment where every day is different.
The opportunity for professional development through funded courses, conferences and certifications.
A startup office space and the opportunity to join a growing, multi-disciplinary team.




About The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.




Key Responsibilities

Translate a client’s overarching business objectives into requirements and then into discrete projects that aim to provide insight and/or generate eﬃciencies.
Access, understand, query, and transform data from a large variety of data sources, each with its own set of intricacies.
Design, develop, and deploy custom automated reporting solutions with the goal of providing clients with rapid, actionable insights.
Design and coordinate experimental protocols in various departments to identify strategic eﬃciencies.
Communicate insights and methodologies clearly and succinctly to both technical and lay audiences.
Special projects, and other duties as required.




Candidate Qualifications

Strong problem solving skills.
2+ years experience writing complex SQL queries to transform and extract data from relational databases or data warehouses.
Experience writing R and/or Python code aimed at manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
Understanding of statistical principles.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Fully bilingual in English and French.
Ability to coordinate across teams.




Knowledge of English is required for this position as the incumbent will be required to interact daily with a predominantly English-speaking clientele located outside of Quebec.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Benefits: matching retirement program, and competitive salaries commensurate with skills and experience. Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Brief Description

About the Role:

The Junior Data Analyst will join the Data & Analytics team and support stakeholders across Operations, Sales, Finance, Purchasing, Business Development, and Engineering. The role centers on turning data into clear, reliable answers. That means working with business teams to understand their questions, analyzing data from across the company, keeping reporting accurate, and communicating findings in a way that supports decision-making. The role offers high visibility into company-wide processes. It's highly collaborative and suits someone who is curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of their work. This is an entry-level role for recent graduates or candidates with up to one year of experience.

What You Will Do


Write SQL queries against SQL Server to answer business questions and generate insights for Operations, Finance, Sales, and Business Development.
Use Python to clean, analyze, and automate work with data.
Handle ad hoc analysis requests from start to finish: clarify the question, pull and analyze the data, and present a clear answer.
Validate data accuracy across reports and source systems, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
Use AI coding assistants and help build AI agents that automate recurring analysis and reporting.
Organize and reconcile data in Excel, mapping and merging data from multiple sources.
Support finance-related analysis such as inventory, cost, and margin reporting.
Monitor Power BI dashboards for data accuracy and refresh issues, escalating to the BI development team as needed.
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within datasets and flag them proactively.
Prepare data and visuals for internal and external-facing decks and reports.
Document data definitions, query logic, and recurring processes.
Manage and prioritize requests from multiple teams.


Requirements

We are Seeking People Who:


Have a bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related computational or quantitative field.
Have up to one year of professional experience. Recent graduates are welcome.
Have hands-on experience from a data-related internship or personal projects, with work they can share, such as a GitHub repository or portfolio.
Are knowledgeable in SQL and can write queries, including joins and aggregations, to answer business questions.
Can write Python code for data analysis, using libraries such as pandas.
Understand at least one BI tool, such as Power BI or Tableau.
Are proficient in Excel.
Have a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Are eager to learn new tools and technologies in a fast-paced environment.
Have high attention to detail and are comfortable working with large datasets.
Have exposure to Microsoft Fabric through coursework or personal projects, which is a plus.
Understand data flows and architecture, which is a plus.
Have completed coursework in data analysis, statistics, or business intelligence, which is a plus.
Have an interest in the wireless, electronics, distribution, or supply chain industry, which is a plus.


What's In It For You


Salary Range: $65,000 to $75,000 per year
Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A supportive and collaborative work environment.
Comprehensive benefits package.
A supportive, diverse and global team with a growth mindset.
A scaling company with great industry professionals.
Amazing opportunities to get involved with exciting projects at significant scale with some of the leading global companies.


Work Location / Type:


This role is on-site, and the candidate needs to be within commuting distance of Florham Park, NJ.
Hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, ancestry, age, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Summary

About PCS Wireless:

Founded in 2001, by two visionary traders, PCS Wireless, affectionately known as “PCS”, is not your average mobile distributor. Led by fearless entrepreneurs, PCS has completely transformed the landscape of the device resell market, both from a business and a consumer perspective.

Today, PCS is a recognized global leader, powering the secondary market. At PCS, we buy and sell mobile devices and products worldwide through partners and programs by breathing new life into old devices effectively extending the device lifecycle up to 5X and beyond. We collaborate with industry giants in consumer electronic manufacturing, wholesalers, big box retailers and small businesses alike, catering to a diverse clientele of more than 1,500 clients. Our operations span major markets worldwide with offices and warehouses in the Americas, APAC, UK & EMEA.

Our go-getting spirit valuing flexibility, a "me for we approach" and curiosity, continues to be the foundation of our success. We are looking for doers and thinkers who get things done and have fun while doing it!

Title: Business Intelligence - Health Data Analyst 133-2023
Description:
Job Summary

The Analyst provides analytical support for all departments, including analysis, pricing, capitation, network and provider specific reporting. Analytical support includes creating and executing beginner and intermediate level reports and programs and programming modifications to previously written reports. The Analyst will collaborate with key stakeholders and determine the needed result including any special specifications. The Analyst will work with several databases to pull and integrate data, statistical analysis and data modeling.

Key Responsibilities


Execute, write, test, validate, analyze and distribute reports. Determine appropriate approach and tools needed to complete project in an efficient and timely manner. Collaborate with key stakeholders and senior analysts.
Determine, write and present report results with key findings and trends to appropriate stakeholders.
Complete multiple concurrent ad-hoc analyses, provide corresponding reports based on customer specifications, determine and communicate analytical conclusions and recommendations.
Develop beginner to intermediate level reports and ad-hoc analysis based on specifications outlined by department management. Automate such reports and ensure that they are performed and delivered on schedule.
Perform tasks related to maintenance of Departmental Data Warehouse and its documentation.
Perform other job-related duties as assigned.


Qualifications


Ability to apply advanced mathematical and statistical techniques and principles into the analysis of health-related data.
Possess strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate results in a clear and concise manner.
Ability to converse and write fluently in English.
Successful completion of Health Care Sanctions background check.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.


Education/Experience


Bachelor’s degree Required. Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Actuarial Science or other quantitative discipline preferred.
Demonstrated use of analytical software. SAS or SQL preferred.
Experience in Power BI, Tableau or similar software preferred.1-2 years of related experience preferred.


CommunityCare is an equal opportunity at will employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, religion, color, disability, sex, sexual orientation or national origin

Title: Sr Business Data Analyst
Description:
The Sr Business Data Analyst role has a national salary range of $70,000 - $115,000.

For roles within California the range is $70,304 - $115,000 and Washington is $80,169 - $115,000.

DHL Supply Chain offers multiple benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Discounted Stock Purchase General Bonus Plan and a generous PTO policy.

Are you ready to launch your analytics career in the fast-paced world of supply chain? At DHL Supply Chain, we’re looking for a Senior Business Data Analyst who is eager to apply data-driven thinking, build impactful visualizations, and support operational excellence. This is your opportunity to grow your skills, collaborate with warehouse leaders, and become a go-to resource for data tools and insights. If you're curious, analytical, and ready to lead, this role is for you.

Job Description

As a Senior Business Data Analyst, you will support warehouse operations by transforming data into actionable insights that improve performance and efficiency. You’ll collaborate with site leadership and key stakeholders to build dashboards, implement standard tools, and support data-driven decision-making. In addition to core analytics work, you’ll have the opportunity to lead projects across multiple sites, support site startups, and act as a point of contact for analytics community initiatives.



Develop and maintain Power BI reports to support operational and strategic decisions
Full development of Power BI including data visualization and back-end data model design
Clean, model, and analyze data using SQL, DAX, and statistical techniques to uncover trends and drive improvements
Implement and maintain standard reporting tools for the site or sector
Assist various functional teams (HR, Finance, etc.) with customized analytical solutions to meet evolving business needs
Serve as a point of contact for Power BI-related questions and analytics community initiatives
Lead knowledge-sharing sessions to promote data literacy and tool adoption
Manage analytics projects independently and across multiple sites
Design and implement data pipelines (ETL) from structured, semi-structured, and unstructured sources
Apply Python, R, or other analytics tools to enhance reporting and automation
Stay current with modern data analytics trends and apply best practices to improve processes
Support site startups as needed by implementing analytics tools and reporting frameworks



Required Experience



Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or 4 years of equivalent professional experience, required
3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, required
Extensive experience using SQL or other scripting languages (such as Python or R) to query, clean, and transform data, required
Proficiency in Power BI, including building dashboards and reports from scratch, required
Proficiency in writing DAX expressions to automate and enhance Power BI reports, required
Experience designing and managing data pipelines and working with diverse data sources, required
Strong understanding of statistical concepts, data modeling techniques, and modern analytics trends, required
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, required
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and lead cross-functional projects, required
Must be able to work fully onsite if role based out of a warehouse, required



Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clair

If you can send your friends money in seconds, why does it still take your employer two weeks to send your paycheck?

At Clair, we are on a mission to create financial freedom for America's workers by giving them a digital banking platform that allows them to get paid as soon as they clock out of work. But we're not just another digital bank or on-demand pay provider. We meet Americans at their place of work by embedding our products within the scheduling, workforce management, and payroll apps they already use every day.

Learn more about us at getclair.com/about

About The Role

We’re looking for a top-tier analytics professional to deliver insights that drive growth. As a Senior Data Analyst at Clair, you’ll join a growing team of data practitioners who are passionate about bringing financial security to underserved communities by giving workers access to their earnings right when they need them. As a trusted thought partner to product and business teams, you’ll surface impactful insights supporting their goals. Through experimentation, analysis, modeling, and dashboard development, you’ll surface recommendations to enable Clair to reach millions of hourly workers and help them get paid on demand.

The ideal candidate will consider themselves a “full stack” data analyst with experience across the entire data pipeline, including data ingestion, processing, modeling, and visualization. This person will be comfortable with the analytics engineering workflow, mixing technical proficiency with the ability to engage stakeholders across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Leverage data to drive user growth, identify trends, and influence product and business decisions
Collaborate with cross-functional business partners to address key analytical questions and evaluate hypotheses, leveraging data to drive innovation and novel solutions.
Define and manage key metrics that inform strategic product, growth, and operational decisions, ensuring alignment with business goals
Put data at the fingertips of stakeholders and enable them to independently explore and utilize data
Build efficient data ingestion and transformation pipelines using tools like dbt
Develop intuitive dashboards, memos, slides, and other visualizations that tell stories and inspire action
Collaborate to brainstorm ideas, verify analyses, and review the work of your peers to ensure accuracy and quality


Qualifications


4–5 years of professional experience in the data analytics field
Fluent in SQL (translating business questions to queries, understanding joins and functions, and building data pipelines)
Experience with experimentation and statistical analysis to guide decision-making
Passionate about building the best version of whatever you’re working on


Things We Consider a Plus


Experience with the modern data stack, including Snowflake, dbt, Tableau
Experience with a scripting language like Python or R
Interest in financial systems and consumer behavior
Experience with machine learning or statistical modeling
Experience in a high-growth start-up environment


Additional Details

Location: This is a hybrid position based out of New York City, you will be expected to come into the office at least three days a week (Tuesdays, Wednesdays, & Thursdays) with additional days on occasion for client meetings.

Compensation: The annual base salary for this role is $150,000-$160,000. The base pay for this role is determined using many factors, such as education, skills and experience and is reflective of Clair Series stage and size. Base pay is only one part of Clair’s competitive total compensation package which includes equity, benefits and additional perks. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Clair will only contact candidates from @getclair.com email addresses. We will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you happen to receive anything suspicious, please ignore it.

Need more convincing?

Benefits

Apart from getting to work with our incredible team, here are some of the benefits you can expect when you join Clair:


Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage, with option to extend to your family
Fully-paid parental leave
Company-sponsored 401k, HSA, and FSA
Unlimited vacation for salaried roles, generous PTO for hourly roles
Work from home setup allowance
Access to your earnings every day on Clair
Company-sponsored short-term and long-term disability insurance


Equal Opportunity Employer Information

Clair is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For questions, please email us at careers@getclair.com

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description & Responsibilities

Persistent Systems is seeking a Data Analyst to join our team in our New York City headquarters. The Data Analyst will transform complex operational, financial, customer, product, and program data into accurate, timely, and actionable insights. This role will build trusted datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and analyses that help leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, manage risk, and make evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate is a disciplined problem solver and an effective "data translator" who can move comfortably between business questions and technical details. They combine strong SQL, data preparation, visualization, statistical reasoning, and stakeholder communication skills with a sharp eye for data quality and user experience.

Position Responsibilities


Own analytical work from requirements discovery and source-data assessment through transformation, modeling, validation, visualization, delivery, and ongoing support
Partner with leaders and subject-matter experts across Finance, Operations, Marketing, Sales, Product, and other functions to define key performance indicators (KPIs), reporting logic, and success measures
Develop reliable, reusable analytics assets and clear documentation so that metrics, assumptions, transformations, and data lineage can be understood and maintained
Apply statistical and analytical methods appropriate to the business question, communicate uncertainty and limitations, and distinguish correlation from evidence of causation
Promote secure, governed, accessible, and responsible use of data while improving self-service analytics across the organization
Design, build, and maintain intuitive dashboards, scorecards, semantic models, and recurring reports using Power BI as the primary platform and Tableau where appropriate
Write, review, and optimize complex SQL queries across relational databases, cloud warehouses, and Lakehouse platforms; reconcile results to source systems and explain query logic
Clean, profile, map, join, and transform structured and semi-structured data using Power Query, Python/pandas, spreadsheets, and related tools; design fact and dimension models using star-schema principles
Build or contribute to repeatable extraction, transformation, and loading workflows using frameworks and platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, and Databricks; monitor failures and document lineage
Analyze historical and current data to identify trends, drivers, anomalies, risks, and opportunities; perform segmentation, variance analysis, forecasting, cohort analysis, and experiment analysis when relevant
Create validation rules, reconciliations, exception reporting, and quality checks; investigate discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate durable fixes with data owners and engineering teams
Translate open-ended questions into measurable definitions, source-to-target mappings, acceptance criteria, and analytics plans; establish consistent KPI definitions and a shared business glossary
Reduce manual reporting through scheduled refreshes, parameterized workflows, Power Automate, reusable templates, and governed self-service datasets
Present concise findings and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences, using accessible visual design and clear narrative rather than relying on charts alone
Support embedded or custom analytics experiences using JavaScript visualization libraries and component-based charting tools such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, Chart.js, and shadcn/ui chart components
Explore responsible uses of Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and generative AI frameworks to accelerate discovery, natural-language analytics, documentation, and workflow assistance while validating outputs against trusted data


Job Qualifications & Experience

Minimum Qualifications


2–5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a closely related role
Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, finance, computer science, information systems, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
Advanced proficiency in SQL, including joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregation, query validation, and performance-aware analysis
Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, semantic modeling, interactive report design, refresh strategies, workspace management, and row-level security; comparable Tableau depth is also valued
Advanced spreadsheet skills and practical experience reconciling, cleaning, and validating data from multiple sources
Working knowledge of dimensional data modeling, KPI design, data dictionaries, ETL/ELT concepts, and source-to-target mapping
Experience using Python with pandas and/or R for data manipulation, exploratory analysis, or statistical work
Understanding of descriptive statistics, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, and common analytical pitfalls
Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, manage multiple priorities, communicate findings clearly, and influence decisions with evidence
Must have a United States Security Clearance or be able to obtain a United States Security Clearance


Relevant Certifications Or Credentials, Such As


Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600)
Tableau Certified Data Analyst
Tableau Desktop Specialist certification
Experience operating in a regulated, security-sensitive, government, or defense-adjacent environment


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with ETL/ELT frameworks and orchestration platforms such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric Data Factory, AWS Glue, Databricks, or comparable tools
Experience building solutions with Power Platform, Power Apps, and Power Automate, including governed connections to enterprise data
Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry for secure AI-assisted analytics, agent experiences, or workflow augmentation
Familiarity with generative AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex and the ability to identify appropriate, verifiable analytics use cases
Experience with JavaScript visualization libraries such as Recharts, D3.js, Plotly.js, or Chart.js, including shadcn/ui chart components built on Recharts
Experience with cloud data warehouses or Lakehouse platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift
Experience with Git, analytics testing, version-controlled SQL or semantic models, CI/CD, and collaborative development practices
Experience with data catalogs, lineage, access controls, sensitivity labels, or governance platforms such as Microsoft Purview
Experience designing experiments, performing A/B test analysis, building forecasts, or applying regression and other classical statistical methods


The total compensation for this role can vary from $133,000 to $166,000 a year based on individual qualifications. Eligibility for yearly discretionary bonus. Persistent Systems, LLC offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; paid time off (sick time and vacation time); flexible spending accounts; 401(k) plan with company match; fitness membership reimbursement; tuition assistance; mental health benefits; and pet discounts.

Company Overview

Headquartered in New York City since 2007, Persistent Systems, LLC is a global communications technology company which develops, manufactures, and integrates a patented and secure Mobile Ad Hoc Networking (MANET) system: Wave Relay®. The company’s industry leading R&D team has designed wireless networking protocols to support their cutting-edge Wave Relay® system and technology. Wave Relay® is capable of running data, video, voice and other applications under the most difficult and unpredictable conditions. Their suite of products is field proven and utilized in Commercial, Military, Government, Industrial, Agriculture, Robotics, and Unmanned System markets.

About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Program Overview

Encompasses technical, engineering, data analytics, cyber security, management, operational, logistical, and administrative support for Bureau of Diplomatic Security, Cyber and Technology Security Directorate in three key offices/functional areas: Cyber Monitoring and Operations, Cyber Threat and Investigations, and Technology Innovation and Engineering State.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking an experienced Data Analyst- Cyber Analytics professional to support our Federal Strategic Cyber (FSC) Program within the Cyber & Intelligence Sector.

Location: On-site in Arlington, VA.Hybrid schedule.1 day per week after a 90-day probationary period.

In this role, you'll work with large-scale cybersecurity and operational datasets to uncover trends, identify emerging threats, and deliver actionable insights that support mission-critical decisions. You'll collaborate with cybersecurity engineers, threat analysts, and program leadership to transform complex and often imperfect data into meaningful intelligence that strengthens national security operations.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced data professional who enjoys combining data analytics, Python/SQL development, automation, visualization, and applied data science to solve real-world challenges in a high-impact federal environment.

What You'll Do


Analyze large-scale cybersecurity and operational datasets, including network logs, authentication data, phishing activity, and threat telemetry, to identify trends, anomalies, patterns, and emerging risks.
Independently explore, clean, transform, validate, and prepare complex or imperfect datasets for analysis based on project and analytical requirements.
Perform data extraction, validation, cleansing, transformation, aggregation, and enrichment using Python/Pandas and SQL.
Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) to support operational monitoring, situational awareness, and decision-making.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Develop automated data pipelines, reporting processes, and analytical workflows to reduce repetitive manual tasks and improve data quality and repeatability.
Apply statistical and machine learning techniques, where appropriate, to support anomaly detection, classification, pattern identification, and predictive analytics.
Develop and maintain metrics related to cyber activity, authentication trends, phishing events, network activity, and external threats.
Collaborate with cybersecurity analysts, engineers, and stakeholders to translate business and operational requirements into analytical solutions and data-driven insights.
Identify data-quality issues, reporting gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for process improvement.
Document data sources, transformation logic, analytical methodologies, business rules, and reporting processes to support transparency and repeatability.
Support ad hoc analytical requests and emerging operational requirements.


Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

SSCPPreferred Qualifications


Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 9 years of relevant experience; 7 years with a master's degree; or 4 years with a PhD.
An additional four years of relevant experience may be substituted in lieu of the bachelor's degree requirement.
Minimum 2 years of hands-on programming experience, preferably using Python and/or SQL.
Demonstrated experience performing data analysis, including data preparation, validation, transformation, and exploratory analysis.
Demonstrated ability to independently work with complex or imperfect datasets and determine appropriate preparation methods based on the analytical objective.
Experience developing dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization platforms.
Foundational knowledge of cybersecurity concepts and/or network and host telemetry.
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
U.S. citizenship required.
Active Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI.
Must possess or be able to obtain one of the following certifications before the start date and maintain it as a condition of employment:
CASP+/SecurityX CCNP Security CEH CFR CHFI CISA CISSP (or Associate) Cloud+ CND CySA+ GCED GCIH GICSP
Strong hands-on experience with Python, Pandas, and SQL for data transformation, automation, and analytics.
Security+ certification
Experience supporting cybersecurity operations, threat analysis, security monitoring, or cyber-related analytics.
Experience working with large-scale operational, security, or telemetry datasets.
Experience developing automated reporting pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, or reusable analytical workflows.
Experience using data visualization to support leadership reporting and operational decision-making.
Experience with statistical analysis and supervised or unsupervised machine learning.
Experience developing and evaluating machine learning models using Python libraries such as scikit-learn, including feature engineering, model validation, and performance evaluation.
Experience working in collaborative analytical environments where requirements evolve based on operational needs.

Details

Target Salary Range: $104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

EEO:Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
At SimPL Freight Solutions, we simplify transportation for companies that move a lot of freight but don’t want the headache of managing it all themselves. We step in as their transportation team - coordinating shipments, managing carrier relationships, tracking performance, and improving how everything runs behind the scenes.

Our customers range from large manufacturers to high-volume distributors across industries like automotive, building materials, food, and packaging. No matter the industry, the goal is the same: keep freight moving smoothly, efficiently, and without surprises.

We pride ourselves on being proactive, responsive, and accountable - anticipating issues, communicating clearly, and continuously finding better ways to deliver results.

Position Overview

Are you naturally curious, comfortable working with numbers, and always asking why? SimPL Freight Solutions is looking for a Junior Data Analyst who is excited to turn data into meaningful business insights.

This is an early-career opportunity designed for a recent graduate or someone beginning their analytics career. You will join a growing analytics department within a fast-growing logistics company, where your work will support real decisions involving clients, pricing, operations, and company strategy.

You will not be expected to know everything on day one. We are looking for someone with strong analytical foundations, attention to detail, and the drive to learn. You will receive guidance from experienced team members while gradually taking ownership of dashboards, reports, models, and improvement projects.

What You'll Do


Collect, clean, and validate client, prospect, pricing, and operational data
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Excel, Power BI, Salesforce, and other tools
Analyze freight patterns, pricing, service performance, and business trends
Turn complex data into clear insights and recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences
Support pricing projects, client strategy reviews, sales presentations, and operational decisions
Partner with operations, sales, pricing, technology, and leadership on cross-functional projects
Identify data quality issues and help improve the accuracy and consistency of information across systems
Document and improve recurring reporting and analytical processes
Explore opportunities to automate workflows and use approved AI tools more effectively
Present findings and explain how they may affect clients or the business


What You'll Have The Opportunity To Learn


How analytics supports pricing, transportation, customer service, and business strategy
How to work with large, real-world datasets that may not always be perfectly organized
How to design dashboards and reports that business leaders actually use
How to translate a business question into a structured analysis
How to communicate findings to clients, managers, and company leadership
How to take an analytics project from an initial question through a final recommendation
How a growing analytics department develops its tools, processes, and standards


Required Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
0-2 years of relevant experience; internships, co-ops, academic projects, and related coursework are welcome
Coursework or project experience involving data cleaning, analysis, visualization, or reporting


Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities


Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and charts
Exposure to Power BI or another data visualization tool preferred; Salesforce experience is a plus
Exposure to SQL, data modeling, or database concepts through coursework or practical experience preferred
Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving skills
Foundational data analysis and critical-thinking skills, with a willingness to learn
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Ability to explain findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Collaborative, dependable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities


We Offer


A competitive salary + bonus opportunities
Career growth, development, and advancement opportunities
Excellent benefits including:
Medical, Dental and Vision Insurances
Life and Disability Insurances
Company 401K plan with a company match
15 PTO days and 9 paid holidays

Core Values


Figure it out, Make it happen
Passion & Grit
Results Matter
Integrity
Teamwork


Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.

SimPL Freight Solutions is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment, welcoming and valuing our differences. Employment is based on individual merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. We value a diverse workforce that encompasses a wide range of perspectives, skills, and abilities.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0250817

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to empower our clients.

As a client-facing data analyst on our National Security team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on their workforce.

Work with us to drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

What You’ll Work On:


Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships.
Research, develop, and test data methodologies and generate cross-functional solutions of large data sets.
Contribute to impactful work and guide decision-making across multiple organizations.
Apply your skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements and trends, based on audience.
Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, scripting languages such as Python, R, SQL, or Tableau, and Microsoft Office suite.
Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive technical outcomes.
Apply data visualization through different formats such as graphs, tables, or PowerPoint slides.
Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions.



Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


5+ years of experience working in data analysis
Experience with Python, including building user interfaces
Experience with data wrangling and preprocessing, including techniques to clean, organize, and transform raw data into usable formats using tools such as Pandas or ETL processes
Experience with data visualization, including Tableau or Matplotlib to create compelling visual representations of data
Experience with protected data such as PII and use of ethical AI practices
Ability to present findings effectively and collaborate with cross-functional teams
TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
Bachelor’s degree



Nice If You Have:


Experience with R
Experience with SQL
Experience with HR data and training development
Experience with mathematics and statistics, including probability, regression analysis, and hypothesis testing to create and validate data models
Knowledge of the military or Intelligence Community
Possession of excellent communication skills



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $62,000.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.


Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.



Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Title: Analyste principal de données / Senior Data Analyst - CX
Description:
Aperçu du poste :

In this role, the candidate will support the CX Shared Services (CXSS) team as a key contributor to the entire lifecycle of reporting and analytics efforts—from gathering requirements and extracting data to creating and delivering automated reports. This role will help Genetec's CX organization distinguish itself by providing its team members with detailed metrics, in-depth and accurate data analysis and calculations, and clear presentations that drive decision-making. These reports, analyses, and presentations will be closely related to the performance of our CX operations, with data sourced from databases across different systems (CRM, ERP, Web Portal, IVR, Chat, etc.). This role requires strong skills in data integration, validation, and interpretation. 



Your day at a glance:

Gather requirements for analysis, reports, and presentations from various stakeholders within the CX organization and translate them into technical specifications
Design and deliver reports, KPIs, and visualizations, ensuring data integrity across multiple sources
Extract, compile, and aggregate data from multiple data sources to be presented in an easy and intuitive format, which will be displayed in reports and presentations
Compile the requirements of recurring reports for their automation in Power BI and assist with their testing once developed
Develop and execute test plans, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve BI reports and dashboards
Collaborate with stakeholders and internal technical teams (e.g., Digital Information) to ensure timely delivery of data models, clear communication, and resolution of blockers
Support the generation of timely and ad-hoc reports based on data from different sources
Work in collaboration with different departments to ensure accuracy of the reports
Work on multiple initiatives at once and prioritize tasks according to the upcoming deliverables

This position requires great attention to detail, the ability to harmonize information and transform it into a simple and easy-to-understand format in terms of both layout and presentation, while also being able to communicate it clearly and concisely. 



What makes you a great fit:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Finance, or Business with an operational analysis background, or equivalent experience  
5+ years of relevant working experience  
3+ years of experience working in reporting or analytics  
Excellent analytical and presentation skills 
Strong organizational skills 
Possess good time management and prioritization skills 
Customer-oriented  
Be able to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines  
Motivated to work in a fast-paced environment  
Be able to work in a team environment as well as independently  
Fluent in French and English, both verbal and written



Your technical expertise:

 Advanced Power BI Desktop and intermediate Power BI Service knowledge 
Strong proficiency in DAX (Data Analytics Expressions) 
Experience with data extraction and manipulation with the use of SQL queries, CRM Advanced Find, and existing Power BI reports 
Familiar with database and data warehousing concepts 
Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft suite (Word, Excel & PowerPoint) 
Knowledge of CRM and Finance & Operations systems (MS Dynamics 365) is an asset

Title: Data Analyst (Remote Opportunity in Knoxville, TN)
Description:
Description

University Health Network (UHN) is hiring a Data Analyst to work in the growing field of Healthcare Value Based Care. This position offers a hybrid work from home option for employees who meet performance requirements. Candidate must reside in the Knoxville, Tennessee metropolitan area and be able to commute to the corporate office located in Knoxville, TN when needed. Candidate must be able to maintain HIPAA privacy requirements when working in a home office setting.

University Health Network is a clinically integrated network and manages University Health ACO, LLC (an accountable care organization). We work in partnership with the University of Tennessee Medical Center, University Physicians’ Association (UPA), area physicians, and commercial and Medicare insurance companies. We strive to deliver the healthcare triple aim: Better care for individuals, better health for populations, and lowering growth in expenditures.

Benefits Include


Remote Work Opportunity
Medical (including HDHP options), Dental, Vision, Life Insurance
FSA and HSA with employer contribution
Paid Time Off (PTO) and Sick Leave
Onsite Fitness Center
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
401K Match with Immediate Vesting


Essential Duties And Responsibilities

The Data Analyst is a full-time position that is responsible for analyzing large sets of data from multiple sources. The Data Analyst creates and validates multiple weekly and monthly end user reports. They will also monitor process performance, satisfaction of our customers, and identify improvements in data collection that will better meet the needs of the department. Experience with SQL, Python, Power BI, and ETL processes is highly desired. This position reports to the Manager of Data Analytics.

Requirements


BS in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Management, Statistics, or relevant field desired.
Proven working experience as a data analyst or similar role required. Will consider education in lieu of work experience.
Proficiency in programming languages including SQL and Python.
Proficiency using data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Familiarity with ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes desired.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Introduction

The Loudoun County Department of Mental Health, Substance Abuse and Developmental Services is seeking a talented and motivated individual to serve as an Data Analyst in the Quality Assurance Program. In this role, you will work with a trusted and reputable team that has a history of success connecting individuals and their families with person-centered, recovery-oriented services and support.

We welcome new teammates who approach their professional careers with enthusiasm and dedication to our diverse and fast-growing county. Come be a part of something that matters.

Job Summary

Under the supervision of the O&E Program Manager, the Data Analyst will perform duties including data collection, analysis, reporting, outcomes measurement, trend analysis, technical support, program evaluation and quality improvement functions.

This person will analyze, prepare, and present data for recurring and ad hoc data requests. This person will create reports, dashboards, and presentations to support data-driven decision making for both internal and external stakeholders. The Data Analyst will be responsible for maintaining reporting manuals and will be committed to best practices in data analysis processes. This person will assist in program evaluation through outcomes development, assistance in Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) projects, and process and outcome evaluations. The Data Analyst will use data to make recommendations for improvement initiatives, Department goals, and increasing the quality of care.

The Data Analyst will serve as a data consultant and technical expert, collaborating with Department management and staff to provide support related to data collection, analysis, data interpretation, outcomes measurement, and software utilization.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess


Strong analytical skills, knowledge of statistics, and experience conducting analyses and evaluating program outcomes.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; Power BI or similar reporting tools and relational databases and query tools such as SQL.
The ability to clean and transform data and create clear, organized reports and dashboards.
Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present ideas and findings clearly.
Strong organizational skills, flexibility, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively.
Knowledge of, or the ability to learn and apply, applicable federal and state laws and regulations.


Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Public Health, Business, Data Analytics, Program Evaluation or a related field, and at least two (2) years of related work experience preferably in conducting data analysis or program evaluation and managing outcomes for community-based programs or social sciences or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Qualifications


Master’s degree in Public Health, Business, Data Analytics, Program Evaluation or a related field.
Experience evaluating program outcomes.
Experience using Power BI for data cleaning and transformation.
Familiarity with navigating electronic health record systems.
Knowledge of or practical experience in community behavioral health settings.


Job Contingencies And Special Requirements

Employment is contingent upon successfully passing pre-employment background check to include fingerprinting, credit, NCIC, DMV, and TB test. Must have a good driving record and a valid driver's license in Virginia or regional state of residence.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation


Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives


Business Intelligence


Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies


Data Management


Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality


Our ideal candidate will have:


Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services


Basic Qualifications:


Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms


Preferred Qualifications:


Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)
