Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere — and outsized ownership while you build — we'd love to meet you.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will build the analytics layer that helps both Confido and our customers understand their financial and operational data. You’ll design dashboards, develop core metrics, and surface insights that drive decision-making across the platform.

This is a foundational role where you’ll help shape Confido’s data culture and establish how analytics are delivered internally and to customers.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)

What You'll Do


Partner with product, engineering, and customers to understand analytics needs
Design and build dashboards, reports, and analytical tools for internal and external users
Write complex SQL queries to analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets
Define and maintain key business metrics and KPIs
Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities within retailer and financial data
Drive analytical projects from exploration through delivery
Collaborate with engineers to improve data models and underlying datasets


Example Problems


Building custom dashboards for brands to understand retailer performance
Analyzing deduction and dispute data to identify operational inefficiencies
Designing analytics that help brands forecast sales and demand
Combining and transforming data into clean, analysis-ready datasets that power actionable insights
Turning complex financial data into intuitive visual insights


What We're Looking For

Required


4+ years of experience in data analysis or analytics roles
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Strong experience building dashboards and analytical reports
Ability to translate data into clear insights and recommendations
Strong communication skills working with technical and non-technical stakeholders


Nice to Have


Experience with BI tools (Omni, Looker, Mode, etc.)
Experience working with financial, retail, or operational datasets
Comfort working directly with users
Interest in early-stage startups and high-ownership roles
Technical or quantitative degree


🌴 Perks + Benefits


Equity — own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build
Fully paid health coverage through Aetna — we cover 100% of employee premiums
Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian
Carrot Fertility Pro — comprehensive fertility and family-forming support
12 weeks of paid parental leave
Unlimited PTO — plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take
401(k) through Vestwell
Paid relocation support — we’ll help you make the move to NYC
Fully equipped workspace from day one — laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup
Team perks — catered Friday lunches, team dinners, and unlimited coffee + snacks featuring products from the brands we work with

Title: Data Analyst - Winnipeg Office
Description:
The Data Analyst is a question-first, shared analytical resource supporting all of Bison's lines of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL — across our North American operations. The role takes ambiguous commercial and operational questions — why a lane is losing money, where empty mileage is concentrating, what has changed in a customer's freight — and turns them into defensible, data-backed answers using our governed data environment.

This role is distinct from recurring report development and from statistical modelling. Your main purpose will be to translate a vague business question into a scoped analysis and a clear answer. Priorities shift between lines of business month to month, so breadth and the ability to get up to speed quickly on an unfamiliar corner of the business are central to the role. Outputs inform decisions made by operations, commercial, and senior leadership.

Specific Responsibilities include:


Translate open-ended questions from operations, commercial, and leadership into scoped, answerable analyses without requiring the question to be fully formed.
Write and validate SQL against a governed data warehouse to pull and join the data an analysis requires.
Use Python for analysis, transformation, and investigative work beyond what SQL alone supports.
Build focused Power BI views where a visual answer serves the audience better than a written one.
Support any of Bison's lines of business as priorities dictate, ramping quickly on unfamiliar economics and operational context.
Surface data-quality issues explicitly rather than analyzing around them.
Scope claims to what the data supports, using ranges over false precision and stating caveats where warranted.
Communicate findings clearly to non-technical commercial and operational audiences.



Our Ideal Candidate will possess:


2-5 years in an analytics or data role producing decision-grade work.
Strong SQL, including multi-table joins and validating data of uncertain quality.
Working Python for data analysis (pandas or equivalent), including scripting one-off investigations.
Sufficient Power BI to build and maintain a clean, accurate view.
Analytical judgment: distinguishing a rate problem from a mix problem from a data artifact, and stating where certainty is limited.
Willingness to learn the distinct economics of each line of business — Asset, Logistics, Intermodal, and LTL.
Clear written communication for a commercial and operational audience.
Proficiency scripting in Python or R for analysis—clean, correct code, without an expectation of shipping production systems.
Fluency with data manipulation (SQL, pandas/dplyr, or equivalent).
Ability to reason about uncertainty and clearly state assumptions and their consequences.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences.
Freight, logistics, or transportation domain experience is considered an asset.
Exposure to network, profitability, or margin analysis is considered an asset.



What this role is not:


Not a BI/dashboard-development role (that's our Reporting function).
Not a data science / statistical-modeling role (that’s our Data Science function).
Not data engineering — you consume the warehouse, you don't build the pipelines.



NOTE: This position is only available to candidates based in Winnipeg, MB.

This job is classified under NOC Code: 21211.

Thrive in a supportive team that provides coaching and training to help develop your skills and progress your career
Dispersed work environments that promote a healthy work-life balance
Meaningful and impactful work and projects with an essential service provider
Join our engaging Wellness Program & extracurricular sports teams



About Bison:


Celebrating over 50 years in Business
Active in giving back through Corporate Social Responsibility and Charitable Giving
Committed to environmental sustainability

Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.


This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.


A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.


What You’ll Be Doing


This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

  • Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
  • Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
  • Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
  • Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
  • Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
  • Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
  • Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
  • Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
  • Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
  • Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
  • Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency


About You


You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.


Technical Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
  • 5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
  • Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
  • Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
  • Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
  • Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
  • Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
  • Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.


Core Capabilities:

  • Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
  • Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
  • Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
  • Clear communication of insights and recommendations
  • Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
  • Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
  • A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
  • Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.


What Success Looks Like


  • You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
  • You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
  • You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
  • You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
  • You translate data into clear, actionable insights
  • You build trust with both internal teams and clients
  • You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
  • You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
  • You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
  • You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity


Let’s Talk Pay


We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.


At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:


  • 100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
  • Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
  • Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
  • Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
  • Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership

Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.

We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling

3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field

Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

Are you ready to launch your analytics career in the fast-paced world of supply chain? At DHL Supply Chain, we’re looking for a Senior Business Data Analyst who is eager to apply data-driven thinking, build impactful visualizations, and support operational excellence. This is your opportunity to grow your skills, collaborate with warehouse leaders, and become a go-to resource for data tools and insights. If you're curious, analytical, and ready to lead, this role is for you.

Job Description

As a Senior Business Data Analyst, you will support warehouse operations by transforming data into actionable insights that improve performance and efficiency. You’ll collaborate with site leadership and key stakeholders to build dashboards, implement standard tools, and support data-driven decision-making. In addition to core analytics work, you’ll have the opportunity to lead projects across multiple sites, support site startups, and act as a point of contact for analytics community initiatives.



Develop and maintain Power BI reports to support operational and strategic decisions
Full development of Power BI including data visualization and back-end data model design
Clean, model, and analyze data using SQL, DAX, and statistical techniques to uncover trends and drive improvements
Implement and maintain standard reporting tools for the site or sector
Assist various functional teams (HR, Finance, etc.) with customized analytical solutions to meet evolving business needs
Serve as a point of contact for Power BI-related questions and analytics community initiatives
Lead knowledge-sharing sessions to promote data literacy and tool adoption
Manage analytics projects independently and across multiple sites
Design and implement data pipelines (ETL) from structured, semi-structured, and unstructured sources
Apply Python, R, or other analytics tools to enhance reporting and automation
Stay current with modern data analytics trends and apply best practices to improve processes
Support site startups as needed by implementing analytics tools and reporting frameworks

Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, required
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and lead cross-functional projects, required
Must be able to work fully onsite if role based out of a warehouse, required

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0250817

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to empower our clients.

As a client-facing data analyst on our National Security team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on their workforce.

Work with us to drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

What You’ll Work On:


Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships.
Research, develop, and test data methodologies and generate cross-functional solutions of large data sets.
Contribute to impactful work and guide decision-making across multiple organizations.
Apply your skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements and trends, based on audience.
Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, scripting languages such as Python, R, SQL, or Tableau, and Microsoft Office suite.
Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive technical outcomes.
Apply data visualization through different formats such as graphs, tables, or PowerPoint slides.
Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions.



Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


5+ years of experience working in data analysis
Experience with Python, including building user interfaces
Experience with data wrangling and preprocessing, including techniques to clean, organize, and transform raw data into usable formats using tools such as Pandas or ETL processes
Experience with data visualization, including Tableau or Matplotlib to create compelling visual representations of data
Experience with protected data such as PII and use of ethical AI practices
Ability to present findings effectively and collaborate with cross-functional teams
TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
Bachelor’s degree



Nice If You Have:


Experience with R
Experience with SQL
Experience with HR data and training development
Experience with mathematics and statistics, including probability, regression analysis, and hypothesis testing to create and validate data models
Knowledge of the military or Intelligence Community
Possession of excellent communication skills



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $62,000.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

As a client-facing data analyst on our National Security team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on their workforce.

Work with us to drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

  • Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships.
  • Research, develop, and test data methodologies and generate cross-functional solutions of large data sets.
  • Contribute to impactful work and guide decision-making across multiple organizations.
  • Apply your skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements and trends, based on audience.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).

Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).

Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Amplitude, Gainsight).

Introduction

The Loudoun County Department of Mental Health, Substance Abuse and Developmental Services is seeking a talented and motivated individual to serve as an Data Analyst in the Quality Assurance Program. In this role, you will work with a trusted and reputable team that has a history of success connecting individuals and their families with person-centered, recovery-oriented services and support.

We welcome new teammates who approach their professional careers with enthusiasm and dedication to our diverse and fast-growing county. Come be a part of something that matters.

Job Summary

Under the supervision of the O&E Program Manager, the Data Analyst will perform duties including data collection, analysis, reporting, outcomes measurement, trend analysis, technical support, program evaluation and quality improvement functions.

This person will analyze, prepare, and present data for recurring and ad hoc data requests. This person will create reports, dashboards, and presentations to support data-driven decision making for both internal and external stakeholders. The Data Analyst will be responsible for maintaining reporting manuals and will be committed to best practices in data analysis processes. This person will assist in program evaluation through outcomes development, assistance in Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) projects, and process and outcome evaluations. The Data Analyst will use data to make recommendations for improvement initiatives, Department goals, and increasing the quality of care.

The Data Analyst will serve as a data consultant and technical expert, collaborating with Department management and staff to provide support related to data collection, analysis, data interpretation, outcomes measurement, and software utilization.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess


Strong analytical skills, knowledge of statistics, and experience conducting analyses and evaluating program outcomes.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; Power BI or similar reporting tools and relational databases and query tools such as SQL.
The ability to clean and transform data and create clear, organized reports and dashboards.
Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present ideas and findings clearly.
Strong organizational skills, flexibility, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively.
Knowledge of, or the ability to learn and apply, applicable federal and state laws and regulations.


Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Public Health, Business, Data Analytics, Program Evaluation or a related field, and at least two (2) years of related work experience preferably in conducting data analysis or program evaluation and managing outcomes for community-based programs or social sciences or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Qualifications


Master’s degree in Public Health, Business, Data Analytics, Program Evaluation or a related field.
Experience evaluating program outcomes.
Experience using Power BI for data cleaning and transformation.
Familiarity with navigating electronic health record systems.
Knowledge of or practical experience in community behavioral health settings.


Job Contingencies And Special Requirements

Employment is contingent upon successfully passing pre-employment background check to include fingerprinting, credit, NCIC, DMV, and TB test. Must have a good driving record and a valid driver's license in Virginia or regional state of residence.

NEXTON recrute un Data Analyst Power BI / GCP H/F, en CDI, à Paris !



Ton futur environnement de travail :



Tu intègres l'équipe en tant que Data Analyst pour l'un de nos clients grands comptes du secteur bancaire.



Tes missions :



Identifier, extraire et collecter des données provenant de différentes sources (bases de données, systèmes internes, API externes, etc.).
Effectuer des analyses statistiques et quantitatives pour comprendre les tendances et identifier les opportunités d'optimisation.

Tu as une excellente capacité à développer et documenter tes analyses (data sourcing, hypothèses et méthodes analytiques) dans une logique Lean & Agile.

Tu maîtrises les statistiques et les visualisations de données.

Nous te proposons des avantages et des opportunités pour enrichir ton expérience professionnelle et personnelle tout au long de l'année :

▶ Un téléphone de dernière génération pour rester connecté.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job title: DATA ANALYST

Location: Paris, France

Job reference #: 33732

Contract type: Permanent

Language requirements: Fluent in French and English




At Eni, we are looking for a Data Analyst to join Eni Plenitude France. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Finance, Sales, Operations and Customer Service, to transform data into actionable insights that drive business performance. You will play a key role in analysing, interpreting and enhancing data to support commercial growth, optimise the customer experience, address business needs and enable strategic decision-making, ultimately contributing to the company’s operational efficiency and long-term success.




About Plenitude




Plenitude is an energy company that integrates the retail business and renewable generation with self-consumption and electric mobility solutions, providing energy and gas to more than 10 million homes and businesses across Europe, which offers a range of great professional opportunities for the whole team. This partnership represents a major European project integrating the renewable energy business with the retail business, which will enable us to progressively increase our offering of services, infrastructure, and green energy for our customers, providing our team with greater visibility and professional growth.




Main Responsibilities




Data Collection and Processing: Extract, transform and structure data from a variety of internal and external sources.
Data Analysis: Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses to identify trends, customer behaviours and performance drivers.
Data Visualisation and Reporting: Develop and maintain interactive dashboards (Power BI) and establish and monitor business KPIs.
Advanced Analytics: Contribute to the development of models, forecasts and predictive analyses.
Optimisation and Recommendations: Provide actionable insights to improve processes, marketing campaigns and the customer experience.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with technical teams, including IT, developers and data scientists, while partnering with business departments to understand analytical needs and business objectives.
Data Culture: Promote data-driven decision-making and support internal teams in the effective use of data and KPI management.




Skills And Experience Required




Bachelor's or Master's degree (BSc/MSc) in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
Proficiency in data visualisation tools, particularly Power BI.
Good knowledge of data analysis languages and tools, including SQL, Python and R.
Experience with Big Data and/or Cloud environments (Azure, Google Cloud Platform or AWS) would be an advantage.
Significant experience in data analysis.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and intellectual curiosity.
Ability to translate complex analyses into clear, meaningful and impactful insights for different audiences.
Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across multiple functions.
Well-organised, self-motivated and capable of managing priorities independently.
Results-oriented, with strong influencing and communication skills.
Fluent in English.




How To Apply




Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
Please upload your CV in English.




About Eni




Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil & gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. In addition, the company is exploring game-changing technologies such as fusion energy – a technology based on the physical processes that power stars and that could generate safe, virtually limitless energy with zero emissions.




Working at Eni




At Eni we believe in enterprising people, capable of making a difference and making their contribution with passion and innovation, to respond to the global challenges of the energy transition. For us, the skills and attitudes of each individual, continuous training, and diversity and inclusion are fundamental. We promote flexible ways of working with particular attention to well-being, welfare and work life-balance. Eni will evaluate applications considering plurality and diversity as sources of enrichment. If your application is assessed to be among those most in line with the required profile, you will be contacted to continue the selection process. Whatever your ambition, at Eni you can find the tools to make it happen.

At Eni, we are looking for a Data Analyst to join Eni Plenitude France. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Finance, Sales, Operations and Customer Service, to transform data into actionable insights that drive business performance. You will play a key role in analysing, interpreting and enhancing data to support commercial growth, optimise the customer experience, address business needs and enable strategic decision-making, ultimately contributing to the company’s operational efficiency and long-term success.


About Plenitude


Plenitude is an energy company that integrates the retail business and renewable generation with self-consumption and electric mobility solutions, providing energy and gas to more than 10 million homes and businesses across Europe, which offers a range of great professional opportunities for the whole team. This partnership represents a major European project integrating the renewable energy business with the retail business, which will enable us to progressively increase our offering of services, infrastructure, and green energy for our customers, providing our team with greater visibility and professional growth.


Main Responsibilities


  • Data Collection and Processing: Extract, transform and structure data from a variety of internal and external sources.
  • Data Analysis: Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses to identify trends, customer behaviours and performance drivers.
  • Data Visualisation and Reporting: Develop and maintain interactive dashboards (Power BI) and establish and monitor business KPIs.
  • Advanced Analytics: Contribute to the development of models, forecasts and predictive analyses.
  • Optimisation and Recommendations: Provide actionable insights to improve processes, marketing campaigns and the customer experience.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with technical teams, including IT, developers and data scientists, while partnering with business departments to understand analytical needs and business objectives.
  • Data Culture: Promote data-driven decision-making and support internal teams in the effective use of data and KPI management.


Skills And Experience Required


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree (BSc/MSc) in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in data visualisation tools, particularly Power BI.
  • Good knowledge of data analysis languages and tools, including SQL, Python and R.
  • Experience with Big Data and/or Cloud environments (Azure, Google Cloud Platform or AWS) would be an advantage.
  • Significant experience in data analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and intellectual curiosity.
  • Ability to translate complex analyses into clear, meaningful and impactful insights for different audiences.
  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across multiple functions.
  • Well-organised, self-motivated and capable of managing priorities independently.
  • Results-oriented, with strong influencing and communication skills.
  • Fluent in English.


How To Apply


  • Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
  • Please upload your CV in English.


About Eni


Eni is a global energy company operating in 61 Countries, with over 30,000 employees. Originally an oil & gas company, it has evolved into an integrated energy company, playing a key role in ensuring energy security and leading the energy transition. Eni's goal is to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050 through the decarbonization of its processes and of the products it sells to its customers. In line with this goal, Eni invests in the research and development of technologies that can accelerate the transition to increasingly sustainable energy. Renewable energy sources, bio-refining, carbon capture and storage are only some examples of Eni's areas of activity and research. In addition, the company is exploring game-changing technologies such as fusion energy – a technology based on the physical processes that power stars and that could generate safe, virtually limitless energy with zero emissions.


Working at Eni


At Eni we believe in enterprising people, capable of making a difference and making their contribution with passion and innovation, to respond to the global challenges of the energy transition. Whatever your ambition, at Eni you can find the tools to make it happen.

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About Us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience.By joining us as a Senior Data Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in large projects, bringing your business sense and analytical thinking to help us meet our high delivery standards.

HOW You Will Contribute To The Company

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Acquisition (5+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people).


You will proactively use data to identify opportunities to grow our business or improve our processes.
You will be a real sparring partner for Sales & Operation leaders, feed their strategy by anticipating the most important business questions, and leverage your data & statistical skills to answer them.
You will steer decision‑making in your business area through rigorous analyses, navigating ambiguity and collaborating across domains when needed.
You will drive our self-service approach to analytics, by understanding our colleague’s needs in their use of data, and promoting a data driven culture. The Science & Analytics team is also fully in charge of creating data models in the Data Warehouse (using dbt).
You will contribute to shaping the Data Engineering roadmap to deliver the best experience for your colleagues on the data platform.


WHAT You Can Expect From Your Life At Pennylane

Within one month:


You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.
You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.
You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of our product and operations.


Within 3 months:


You will be fully in charge of supporting your area of the business, prioritizing your tasks with decision makers.
You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT).
You will contribute to larger cross-company projects.


Within 6 months:


You will proactively contribute to the team’s roadmap.
You will work with engineers and data practitioners on improving our stack and data platform.
You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.


And beyond: the data team will continue growing with the company

Which means:


Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members
Increased accountability in project leadership
Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.


Who are we looking for?

You’re the right candidate if you:


Have had previous experiences as Data Analyst, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years)
Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools
Are comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders beyond the data team
You have a strong business acumen and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders
Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly
Are Fluent in French & English


What does the recruitment process look like?


A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager
A case study interview to discuss a topic closely related to one of our priorities (60 min)
A past project interview to hear about your experience (60 min)
An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (45 min)

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :


To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)
To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment
To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)
Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity


We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com

We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : dpo@pennylane.com.

Notre data policy

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to dpo@pennylane.com. Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an dpo@pennylane.com schreiben. Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a dpo@pennylane.com. Más información

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

  • You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Growth
Description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile industry. The team plays a key role in Voodoo’s long-term strategy by accelerating product diversification and providing a state of the art growth-engine to distribute and scale our games.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who thrives on transforming data into actionable insights, supporting strategic decisions, and collaborating closely with stakeholders to fuel growth. By joining this team, you will directly shape Voodoo’s marketing and monetization strategies, helping our apps reach and engage hundreds of millions of users worldwide.

Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team.

The objective of this team is to accelerate the growth of the company by serving as the on-demand prediction provider for all Voodoo BUs. This involves addressing critical needs such as predicting campaign LTV for User Acquisition optimization, determining optimal monetization offers for millions of players or constructing confidence intervals for time series data prediction.

We want to onboard a passionate data analyst with significant experience in a similar environment to allow us to go one step further. This is an opportunity to have a strategic and critical impact on Voodoo’s success.

This position is hybrid and requires 3 days per week in the office based in Paris.


Design, build and monitor data models & dashboards to track business metrics
Work with cross-functional teams to identify key business needs and solve them using adequate statistical models
Thoroughly document your results and offer onboarding and continuous training to help teams effectively utilize data and insights.
Establish data quality processes to ensure the reliability and accuracy of our machine learning models.
Promote data literacy within the organization and serve as the primary point of contact for all data-related inquiries and support.
Demonstrate excellent communication skills to efficiently manage senior stakeholders within a fast-paced scale-up environment.
Work closely with the central data team to source additional data and enhance data management practices


Profile


At least 4 years' experience in Data Analysis
Proficient with SQL and/or Python, with a proven experience working with large and complex data sets.
Autonomous person with a strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail.
Experience with statistical modeling & predictive analytics
Excellent verbal & written communication abilities
Experience building dashboards with Tableau.
Experience in gaming industry or mobile marketing is a plus
Any personal or professional experience with machine learning will be valued


Our Stack

SQL; Python; DBT; AWS; Tableau

Benefits


Competitive salary based on experience
Swile Lunch voucher
Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)
Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family
Wellness activities in our Paris office
Remote Fridays

🧑 💻 Pourquoi ce rôle est clé ?

En tant que Data Analyst, vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au niveau de la data, de la business intelligence et de l'intelligence artificielle. Votre mission principale sera de transformer la donnée en leviers d'action concrets pour les équipes métiers, en consolidant le pilotage analytique et en intégrant des solutions d'IA pour affiner la prise de décision.




🎯 Vos missions au quotidien :

Pilotage de la performance :

Assurer un rôle de pilotage data et analytique complet, en définissant et en suivant les indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) pour le business.




Définition de stratégies :

Contribuer activement à la définition des stratégies, notamment en matière de merchandising et de négociation, en fournissant des analyses et des recommandations basées sur les données.




Optimisation de l'écosystème de reporting :

Gérer et rationaliser l'ensemble des tableaux de bord existants. L'objectif est de réduire le nombre de dashboards pour aboutir à une constellation d'outils plus efficaces et pertinents.




Développement d'outils analytiques :

Concevoir et mettre en place des outils de reporting stratégiques, tels qu'un Revenue Performance Dashboard, pour offrir une vision claire et consolidée de la performance financière.




Analyse avancée assistée par l'IA :

Mener des analyses complexes et des raisonnements "au cas d'usage" en exploitant des technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle. Utiliser l'IA comme un levier pour explorer les données et formuler des hypothèses d'action.




🧩 Stack technique :

Langages : Python, SQL
Bases de données : BigQuery
Outils de Business Intelligence & Visualisation : Looker, Tableau
Formats de données : CSV, JSON, Avro
Outils de gestion projet : Jira, Confluence




🧩 Vous êtes la personne idéale si :

5 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst.
Diplômé d'un master ou d'une école d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en Data Analyse, intelligence artificielle ou data science.
Aisance relationnelle, esprit collaboratif et appétence pour l'amélioration continue.




🌟 Pourquoi rejoindre OVENTI ?

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
We’re Hiring!

Senior Data Analyst




At Envu, we partner with our customers to design world-class, forward-thinking innovations that protect and enhance the health of environments around the world. We offer dedicated services in: Professional Pest Management, Forestry, Ornamentals, Golf, Industrial Vegetation Management, Lawn & Landscape, Mosquito Management, and Range & Pasture.




Envu brings together a broad range of perspectives to look beyond chemistry and dare to explore new paths forward. Guided by our inclusive culture, we embrace change and flexibility, tackling our customers’ toughest challenges proactively, passionately and with an entrepreneurial spirit.




We pursue our ambitions collaboratively because we know that a unified and empowered team is an unstoppable force, allowing us to achieve our vision of healthy environments for everyone, everywhere. Join Us.




Envu is proud to be certified as a Top Employer 2026 in France and the United States




FUNCTION: CFO

LOCATION: Lyon, France

JOB TYPE: Permanent

JOB GRADE: 6




GET TO KNOW YOUR AREA:

Join the Finance Data Analytics team to enhance data analysis and visualization tools to drive financial strategy, enhance forecasting accuracy, and provide critical insights that support key business decisions.
Focus on leveraging the capabilities of our Azure Data lake, Databricks and the Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, PowerApps, and Power Automate) to enhance our reports, process automation, and custom business applications.
Provide dedicated support to the Marketing team by developing and maintaining reporting solutions, translating business needs into data-driven insights, and acting as a strategic business partner to support decision-making and performance management.




YOUR MISSION WILL BE TO:

Design, develop and maintain complex Power BI dashboards for decision-making while taking into account the needs from the different stakeholders (Finance, Business, Marketing…).
Build and maintain data pipelines and transformation workflows using Python, SQL and Databricks (notebooks, workflows, applications…) to industrialize data processing.
Perform data modeling, transformation and analytics using Python, SQL and DAX.
Continuously evaluate and improve existing processes and systems using insights derived from data analysis and automation projects.
Develop custom business applications using Databricks, integrating with various data sources and APIs to fulfill unique business requirements.
Actively contributing to the expertise level and competencies of the Finance Data & Analytics team
Collaborate with other departments to identify opportunities for process improvement and automation in reporting workflows.




ARE YOU READY FOR THE ROLE?

Main requirements:

Master's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Statistics, or Data Analytics. Experience in Finance or Marketing is a strong plus.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in a data analyst role, with a proven experience in data modelling and data visualization.
Experience in writing scripts, and queries using Python and SQL.
Expertise in Databricks is a strong plus.
Experience leveraging GenAI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot in Fabric/Power BI, Databricks AI/BI Genie, Claude) to accelerate data exploration and reporting is a plus
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.

Envu is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, regardless of ethnicity, color, race, religion, origin, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other conditions. And all opportunities are open to people with disabilities.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d)

Engineered in Berlin. Driving the Future of Europe.



At AUTODOC, we are proud to be a homegrown European success story. Founded in Berlin in 2008 and still headquartered in the heart of the continent today, we have evolved from a local specialist into Europe’s leading online platform for the automotive aftermarket.

Our strength lies in our unique identity: we are a digital-first, e-commerce powerhouse with strong German roots and an expansive reach across 27 European countries. This continental focus allows us to blend our heritage with high-tech innovation, staying agile and closely connected to the markets we serve.



Today, our team of more than 5,500 professionals from over 50 different countries is redefining mobility through cutting-edge technology. Bring your talent and expertise to a company that is building a sustainable, tech-driven future for drivers everywhere.



Come join us and impact the future of AUTODOC!





Job Description



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who will be responsible for identifying opportunities for growth and improvement, as well as gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data to help the organization make better decisions. The Data Analyst will also work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that we meet customer needs and drive sales and profitability.



Responsibilities:



Gather and understand business needs and objectives.
Identify and interpret patterns, trends, insights, business metrics from data
Create data-complex dashboards with an optimized data structure and scaling perspective
Assist in planning, forecasting and AB testing processes.
Work with various product and business stakeholders to develop data-driven insights.
Partner with the Data Engineering team to define and build reliable data sources.
Identify new opportunities for the use of data across the company.


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, Power BI / Tableau, and other data analysis tools
4+ years of experience in data, product analytics, data science or business intelligence, e-commerce experience is a plus
University degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related field
Proficiency in statistical analysis methods, data modeling, hypothesis testing, AB testing
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Fluent English
Good communication skills, ability to communicate to both technical and non-technical audiences
Applying expertise in analysis to see beyond the numbers and provide clear insights


Additional Information



What do we offer?



Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
Fast growing international company with stable employment

Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)

Flexible working hours and hybrid work





The position is available for candidates based in Portugal, Poland, the Czech Republic, Moldova or Kazakhstan.



Join us today and let’s create a success story together!

Title: (Senior) Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Barcelona
Description:
Location: Come and join us in Hamburg, Berlin or Barcelona!

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions helping people to move freely and cities to thrive.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d) to collaborate with our operational squads. In this role you will be able to become an expert in our business and data analysis systems and environment to allow you to champion data-driven decisions as part of the Data Operations team.

Be ready to work in a multinational, diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team of passionate analysts who strive for excellence and like to have fun. Are you ready for your next ride?

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:


Focus on analysing and presenting recommendations/process changes/new initiatives to management using insights derived from data.
Use your technical skills such as actively engaging in configuration and programming in the data environment, querying data via SQL from the data lake, automating data processes, deep dive analysis in Python and adjusting ETL tasks.
Bringing new insights and championing them using your analyses, dashboards, and good storytelling! We value ideas over hierarchy, and there's always a new path to follow if your idea is convincing and well-backed with data.
Develop monitoring tools to measure performance and help the business achieve its objectives.
Create queries to answer operational and business questions across our many operational teams to support decisions.
Communicate results in a clear and impactful manner.


TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:


Educated to Degree Level or higher in an analytical discipline such as Engineering, Computer Science or Economics
5+ years of experience in an analytical role
You have curiosity in your essence, which motivates you to answer WHY things happened, not only scratching the surface, but aiming for well-founded actionable results
Curiosity about AI and its practical applications in analytics, experience using LLMs or AI-powered tools in a data context
Excellent technical skills including SQL knowledge, familiarity with visualisation tools (Metabase in particular is a plus) and python/R
Enthusiastic, outgoing and personable - you have the ability to think on your feet, work independently and also proactively with others to find solutions to issues
You understand how to engage and influence decision makers and have excellent communication skills
Driven - you are motivated to find solutions to problems and constantly go the extra mile
Strong communication and interpersonal skills as well as excellent written and spoken English


BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:


Flexible working arrangements
LinkedIn Learning
Sabbatical & special leave policies
WeRoad partnership
Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
Short term EU work policy
Mobility Credit
Health Insurance
Employee assistance program


DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

FREE NOW is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.

We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work.

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Trabajamos con clientes líderes, desarrollando soluciones tecnológicas en Infraestructura, Cloud, Software, Project Management y muchas otras áreas.

Funciones

  • Recopilar, limpiar y estructurar datos de diferentes fuentes.
  • Elaborar reporting operativo y ejecutivo y análisis de KPIs.

  • Realizar consultas y transformación de datos mediante SQL.
  • Desarrollar análisis y automatizaciones con Python (Pandas, NumPy).
  • Identificar oportunidades de automatización utilizando Power Automate / Power Apps.
  • Participar en iniciativas de IA y Machine Learning aplicadas al negocio.

  • Tendrás horario flexible.
  • Te integrarás en un equipo internacional.
  • Trabajarás en modelo híbrido acudiendo 2 días/semana a la oficina de Sant Cugat del Vallès. Buena accesibilidad tanto en transporte público como aparcamiento.

🏥 Seguro médico: cobertura médica privada para empleados.

📚 Formación y desarrollo: acceso a formación a cargo de la empresa.

🤝 Acompañamiento personalizado: apoyo continuo del equipo de Talento y seguimientos mensuales.

💳 Retribución flexible: ventajas fiscales aplicables a restauración, transporte y guardería.

🏋️ Bienestar y actividad física: acceso a la aplicación Wellhub.

💸 Descuentos exclusivos: acceso al Club Inspiring Benefits.

🌐 Networking y comunidad: participación en BETWEEN Nights, torneos deportivos y otros eventos.

🎁 Programa de recomendación: incentivos económicos por referir talento a la compañía.

Requisitos

Mínimos

  • Formación en Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Data Analytics, Informática o similar.
  • Dominio del inglés (avanzado/bilingüe) y español.
  • 5+ años de experiencia en Data Analytics / BI.
  • Experiencia con:
  • Power BI, DAX y Power Query
  • SQL
  • Excel avanzado
  • Python (Pandas, NumPy)
  • Conocimientos básicos de IA / Machine Learning.
  • Capacidad analítica, atención al detalle y orientación a mejora continua.
  • Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.

Valorables

  • Power Automate / Power Apps.
  • Microsoft Azure / Fabric, Azure Data Factory o Azure SQL.
  • Scikit-learn, modelos predictivos o forecasting.
  • Experiencia con otros entornos cloud (AWS / GCP).

We are looking for

We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d) , who desires to contribute to the growth and success of our Data & Analytics Team.

Your role in BizAway


You tackle complex business problems end to end, translating ambiguous questions into analysis, and analysis into recommendations the business can act on.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
As an F&B Data Analyst, you are at the center of complex challenges within the food and beverage industry. You translate large volumes of raw data, such as sales figures, inventory movements, consumer trends and production data, into clear strategic insights and concrete action points for our clients and internal teams.

Our company is based out of Vianen, Utrecht (NL). We are unable to offer work sponsorship for this role.

Who we are:

At Real Result, we are the independent purchasing experts for the dynamic foodservice industry. We help our clients maximize their procurement, whether it's through volume discounts, purchasing optimization, real-time cost price insights, or the realization of commercial kitchens and bars. We are looking for talent that helps our clients achieve their ambitions. Since 2025, Real Result has been part of Buyers Edge Platform, a digital procurement network/software platform for the foodservice industry that connects operators, distributors, and manufacturers. The platform offers group purchasing services, SaaS-based technology solutions, and supply chain consulting and procurement-related services to foodservice parties with the aim of reducing costs and improving supply chain decisions through data-driven technology. As a Buyer at Real Result, you are the linchpin in strategic purchasing processes. You work closely with various leading players in the sector, from hospitality to catering and from Leisure to on-the-move. Our client base is diverse and impressive. Think of names like Ron Blaauw, Perfect Serve, Albron, Beerze Bulten, Vue Cinemas, Koninklijk Theater Carré, and many others.

Your impact:


Data Analysis & Reporting: Develop, maintain and automate dashboards, KPI reports and analyses tailored to the food and beverage market.
Trend & Market Analysis: Identify consumption trends, seasonal effects and cost fluctuations within the F&B sector.
Advisory: Proactively advise clients and management based on data-driven insights to improve operational efficiency and profitability.
Data Quality Management: Safeguard the quality, integrity and reliability of supplied and processed data sources.
Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders to implement client-specific data solutions.
Accuracy and timeliness of delivered dashboards and analyses.
Measurable cost savings or efficiency gains realized for clients based on your recommendations.
Successful adoption and use of data tools by end users.


About you:


Education: Vocational (MBO) or bachelor's (HBO) degree in (Business) Mathematics, Data Science, Econometrics, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
Experience: 2 to 5 years of relevant work experience as a data analyst or in a similar role, preferably within the Food & Beverage, FMCG or retail sector.
Technical skills:
Excellent command of SQL and Excel.
Experience with visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Competencies: Strong analytical skills, results-oriented, communicative (able to translate complex data into understandable language for non-technical stakeholders) and commercially aware.


What We Offer:


A market-based salary aligned with your knowledge and experience, plus an attractive benefits package, including 25 vacation days, holiday allowance and flexible working hours.
Laptop and mobile phone.
Company car or mobility allowance
Excellent benefits and development opportunities.
Room for initiative and personal growth within an innovative and ambitious organization.
An inspiring work environment with passionate colleagues from the industry.
