Title: Data Analyst BI confirmé (H/F)
Description:
Depuis sa création, KLANIK s'est donnée pour mission de conjuguer expertise technologique et authenticité.

Ce pari audacieux, né à Marseille en 2011, en France, s'est transformé en une aventure internationale qui compte aujourd'hui plus de 800 collaborateurs, des implantations dans 10 pays et des filiales innovantes. Nous rejoignons en 2026 le groupe ALTEN, acteur mondial de l'ingénierie et des services numériques.

Notre rôle : recruter les meilleurs talents & les connecter à nos clients pour les accompagner dans leurs projets digitaux. KLANIK est une société de conseil en informatique structurée autour de 5 pôles d'expertises : Data & IA, DevOps Cloud Infra, Cybersécurité, Software, Produit Agilité Pilotage.

Nos 800 talents ont des profils variés : tech (nos pôles d'expertises), opérationnels (fonctions commerciales et recrutement) et support.

Au‑delà des métiers, KLANIK cultive un modèle profondément humain, qui dépasse les frontières : de la Belgique à la Colombie, nos valeurs résonnent. Une culture fondée sur le partage, l'exigence et la bienveillance - un collectif où chacun peut trouver sa place. En témoignent nos filiales :

Klanik Esport : club Esport & agence de gamification;

Korner : incubateur de startups tech;

Kampus : organisme de formation certifié Qualiopi

l'Act'In Klanik, rôles qui permettent à nos collaborateurs de faire vivre leurs passions au-delà de leurs missions.

Notre culture est résumée par cette phrase, souvent apposée sous notre logo : Human-Made Technology. La tech oui, mais une tech humaine, qui diffuse un modèle où l'authenticité de chacun est la priorité.

KLANIK, en tant que société à mission, croit en la force de la diversité et de l'inclusion. Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d'origine, d'âge ou de genre, et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force qui contribue à notre succès.

Le Poste

Rejoignez un acteur majeur du secteur de la banque et contribuez à des projets à fort impact !

Vous avez envie de rejoindre une ESN moderne, avec un business model participatif, tournée vers l'humain et la formation de ses collaborateurs ?

Alors nous avons besoin de vous pour répondre aux différents besoins de nos clients !

Si vous faites le pari de nous rejoindre, vous évoluerez chez différents clients au fil de votre expérience chez Klanik.

Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Data d'un de nos clients dans le secteur bancaire , nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst BI pour intervenir auprès d'une ou plusieurs équipes produit .

Vous rejoindrez un environnement Data structuré, au sein duquel vous contribuerez directement à la valorisation des données, à la production d'analyses et de tableaux de bord, ainsi qu'à l'accompagnement des métiers dans leurs problématiques décisionnelles.

Vous évoluerez dans un contexte Agile, en étroite collaboration avec les Product Owners, Business Analysts, équipes de développement et interlocuteurs métiers.

L'environnement technique s'articule notamment autour de SQL, MicroStrategy et Teradata.

Vos principales missions

En tant que Data Analyst BI, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :


Collaborer avec les Business Analysts afin de comprendre les besoins métiers et les traduire en indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) pertinents.
Explorer, analyser et valoriser les données disponibles afin de produire des analyses descriptives, reporting et tableaux de bord BI.
Concevoir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord MicroStrategy, en veillant à leur pertinence fonctionnelle et à leur qualité.
Requêter et extraire les données via des scripts SQL, à des fins d'analyse ou pour répondre à des besoins opérationnels.
Conduire des analyses Data en lien direct avec les problématiques et enjeux métiers.
Présenter les résultats des analyses auprès d'un public métier varié, animer des réunions et faciliter la compréhension des données.
Interpréter les résultats et formuler des insights et recommandations business auprès des parties prenantes.
Accompagner les métiers dans l'application des principes de gouvernance et de protection de la donnée : Data Management, Data Privacy, conformité, etc.
Documenter les analyses, méthodologies et bonnes pratiques ainsi que les guides utilisateurs des tableaux de bord.
Assurer la maintenance et l'amélioration continue des livrables existants : évolution des rapports, optimisation des dashboards et amélioration des processus analytiques.
Être force de proposition sur les solutions permettant d'améliorer la qualité, la pertinence et l'efficacité des analyses BI.


Déroulement Des Entretiens

Chez Klanik, nous souhaitons apporter la meilleure expérience candidat possible. Ainsi, nous privilégions les processus de recrutements les plus courts possibles, et encadrés par des valeurs de partage, de bienveillance et d'exigence.

Vous serez amené à échanger tout au long du processus avec :


Nos HR Partner
Nos Validateurs Techniques
Nos Business Managers


Profil

Formation et expérience


Formation supérieure Bac +3 minimum en informatique ou domaine équivalent.
5 ans d'expérience minimum sur un poste équivalent
Expérience significative dans le secteur bancaire


Compétences techniques indispensables


Maîtrise des requêtes et de l'extraction de données pour les besoins d'analyse
Expertise indispensable en SQL.
Maîtrise des environnements de bases de données SQL
Expertise sur un outil de Data Visualisation / Business Intelligence
Une expertise sur Power BI ou Tableau peut également être considérée


Qualités attendues


Excellente communication & pédagogie
Esprit d'équipe
Esprit critique : savoir challenger le besoin métier et proposer des solutions adaptées
Autonomie & adaptabilité

Title: Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d)
Description:
Spannend, aufstrebend und verdammt schnell – wir sind flaschenpost!

Wir liefern den Wocheneinkauf innerhalb von 120 Minuten zu unseren Kund:innen.

Gemeinsam mit über 20.000 Kolleg:innen schaffen wir es, eine komplette Branche neu zu erfinden. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2016 sind wir mittlerweile als Sofortlieferdienst für Getränke und Lebensmittel in nahezu allen Metropolregionen Deutschlands vertreten.

Seit 2020 ist die flaschenpost Teil der Oetker-Gruppe.




Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d)




Um unsere Mission zu erfüllen, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d) für den Bereich Operative Logistik. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für unternehmensweite KPI- und Monitoring Systeme, die täglich vom Senior Management und operativen Stakeholdern genutzt werden und gestaltest die datengetriebene Entscheidungskultur in der operativen Logistik aktiv mit. Du bist nah an den Prozessen und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen zusammen.

Ce développement s'appuie sur la qualité et la pérennité des missions réalisées.

La satisfaction client est ainsi liée à l'épanouissement des consultants !

Alors, n'hésitez pas à postuler !

POSTE / MISSIONS

Polyvalent.e, vous travaillerez sur des problématiques d'analyse de données, de traitements d'informations pour l'ensemble des directions métiers

Vous participerez à la mise en place de solutions innovantes et pérennes en utilisant vos compétences en Data.

En charge d'exploiter et d'analyser les données du groupe afin de suivre les performances business, de parfaire la connaissance de nos données et de contribuer aux actions métier.

Missions Principales

Développer des indicateurs de pilotage à destination de différentes directions du groupe,
En lien avec le métier, analyser les données et spécifier aux développeurs les données et règles de gestion à appliquer

Accompagner les projets transverses afin d'anticiper les impacts et enjeux à venir,
Accompagner les projets d'architecture Data/ couche sémantique sur Look ML
Réaliser des analyses et restituer les enseignements via des dashboards et supports clairs,
Être force de proposition pour déployer des suivis d'indicateurs pertinents,
Participer au développement de la culture Data du groupe


PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Maîtrise de Looker / Looker ML
Maîtrise du pack office (Excel niveau expert indispensable),
Parfaite connaissance du langage SQL Connaissances des langages de programmation (R ; Pyton…)
Pratique des logiciels du type QlikView, Microstrategy serait un plus


Qualités Attendues


Capacité à faire des analyses, des synthèses à valeur ajoutée pour le métier,
Capacité d'organisation et d'adaptabilité,
Rigoureux.se, vous êtes à l'aise pour travailler sur un projet de bout en bout,
Être autonome tout en gardant le sens du travail en équipe,
Faire preuve d'initiative, de curiosité, être bon(ne) communicant(e).


Formations/ Expériences


Formation Bac + 3 / 5 : formation scientifique, Université/écoles d'ingénieurs.
Vous justifiez idéalement d'une expérience de 6- 10 ans dans le domaine de traitement de la donnée de masse.
Une certification Looker ML


AVANTAGES

SELON PROFIL

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Department

WDTech - R&D

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is W&D’s in-house technology team – a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.

WDTech Engineering builds solutions that impact not only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in delivering trusted data insights and analytics that support business and product decision-making across the organization. This role is responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reporting solutions and dashboards, and translating data into actionable insights that improve operational effectiveness and support strategic initiatives.

Working closely with Data Analysts, BI Analysts, Data Engineers, Data QA Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers, you will help ensure data products are accurate, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs as Walker & Dunlop continues to grow as a data-driven organization.

Primary Responsibilities


Analyze and curate data sources to support business and product stakeholders in making informed decisions.
Lead key components of the analytical lifecycle, including data exploration, analysis, reporting, and insight delivery.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.
Perform data wrangling, transformation, and analysis using SQL and enterprise analytical databases.
Define and document datasets, business logic, and reporting definitions to support consistent data usage.
Partner with data and product teams to support data governance, data quality, and data management processes.
Analyze user engagement, operational, and product data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics, visualization, and stakeholder collaboration.
Perform other duties as assigned


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree preferred, preferably in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics roles with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end analytical projects.
Strong experience working with enterprise analytical databases such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar technologies.
Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
Experience with SQL, data transformation, and analytical reporting workflows.
Experience with Python and geospatial analysis preferred.
Real estate, financial services, or related industry experience preferred.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Deep expertise in SQL and data analysis techniques.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and analytical best practices.
Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to business and technical audiences.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively across technical and business teams in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools that support reporting, documentation, and analysis workflows preferred.
High level of accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement.
Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders


What We Offer 


You will have the opportunity to accelerate in our rapidly growing organization.
Agile working environment with flexible working hours and location, career advancement, and competitive compensation package.
We are a family friendly company.
We arrange social activities to help our employees and families become familiar with each other and our culture.
In addition to other benefits, we offer a pension scheme and 100% complimentary and confidential mental health services.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

We are committed to equity in all steps of the recruitment and employment experience. We believe in equal access to opportunities in our workplace. We do not tolerate discrimination, including harassment, based on any characteristic protected by applicable law, such as race, color, national origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, sex, age, disability, veteran or military status, and genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We strive to be a safe place to ask questions, build professional relationships, and develop careers.

SPAM

Please be wary of recruitment scams. An indication of a scam might be a request for sensitive or bank information at the time of application or emails coming from a non walkerdunlop.com email address. Please call us at 301.215.5500, if you have any concerns about information requested during or after the application process.

Description:
In ProMach cerchiamo persone pronte a mettere in risalto il proprio talento.

Qui hai occasione di sviluppare la tua carriera, condividere idee ambiziose e avere un impatto concreto.

Ti abbiamo incuriosito? Continua a leggere.

Job Summary

ProMach is seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative Data Analyst to help transform our complex data landscape into actionable business insights. You’ll work with data from multiple ERP, CRM, and operational systems, supporting key business decisions in finance, operations, and supply chain. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on data work, cross-functional collaboration, and building impactful reports and dashboards. Fluency in Italian and English required

Why This Role Matters

As a Data Analyst at ProMach, you’ll play a critical role in shaping business strategy by collecting, analyzing, and visualizing data from dozens of systems and databases. Your insights will help drive efficiency, identify opportunities, and support growth across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Collect, clean, and analyze data from ERP, CRM, and other business systems to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
Develop and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and reports for business users and leadership.
Write SQL queries and use analytics tools to extract, transform, and analyze large datasets.
Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to understand business needs and translate them into data requirements.
Present findings and recommendations through clear visualizations and presentations.
Support data migration, integration, and quality initiatives to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Document data processes, definitions, and methodologies for transparency and repeatability.
Stay current with best practices in data analysis, visualization, and reporting.


Qualifications

Required:


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or analytical area, or demonstrated equivalent experience in data analysis or a related field
2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
Proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
Experience building dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and data kccuracy.
Ability to communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience gathering requirements and working with cross-functional teams.
Deep Knowledge of data flows within ERP/CRM systems (e.g., SAP, Infor LN, Salesforce) in a manufacturing environment
Candidate must be fluent in both Italian and English.


Preferred


Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Delta Lake).
Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and metadata documentation.
Experience with Python or R for data analysis is a plus.
Exposure to Agile project environments and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Git).


Cosa significa per te?

Con noi non ci sono vincoli sulle idee innovative né limiti per la tua crescita professionale. Offriamo un ambiente aperto e comunicativo che valorizza l’iniziativa personale. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un’azienda in cui le persone si trovano a proprio agio e scelgono di costruire la propria carriera.

Oltre alle opportunità di sviluppo, come dipendente ProMach riceverai molto più del tuo compenso. Il pacchetto retributivo include la tua retribuzione, programmi di assistenza medica, un generoso programma di ferie retribuite e la possibilità di aderire a un piano di risparmio pensionistico con contributo aziendale. E poiché sappiamo quanto sia importante sentirsi tutelati, i benefici sono attivi fin dal primo giorno di lavoro: nessun periodo di attesa.

Pro Mach, Inc. è stata inserita sette volte nella lista Inc. 5000 delle aziende private a più rapida crescita negli Stati Uniti.

Continuiamo a introdurre prodotti innovativi, entrare in nuovi mercati, espandere la nostra presenza globale e acquisire nuove competenze.

Title: Data Analyst maîtrisant
Description:
Descriptif du poste

Notre entreprise accompagne plusieurs clients dans la structuration, l’analyse et la valorisation de leurs données. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst pour intervenir auprès de différentes organisations sur des enjeux de reporting, data visualisation et modélisation BI.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe data avec pour objectif de collecter, explorer et interpréter les données, puis de mettre à disposition des reportings clairs et utiles pour les équipes produits et métiers.

Vos missions


Accompagner les équipes produits dans l’analyse de leurs données
Concevoir des dashboards et reports lisibles pour le suivi des KPI
Produire des analyses ponctuelles sous forme de présentations ou notes de synthèse
Participer à la modélisation BI et à la conception des flux de données
Définir des bonnes pratiques et guidelines pour fiabiliser la production des indicateurs et tableaux de bord


Profil recherché


Formation : Bac+4/5 en data, statistiques, BI, informatique ou équivalent
Expérience : 4 ans d’expérience minimum en tant que data analyst
Compétences obligatoires :
SQL confirmé
Expérience en analyse de données
Bon niveau sur la conception de reporting et KPI
Compétences importantes :
Outil de data visualisation type Power BI, Looker ou équivalent
Modélisation BI confirmée
Qualités personnelles :
Esprit d’analyse
Rigueur
Capacité à travailler avec des données imparfaites
Bon relationnel
Capacité d’adaptation à différents environnements clients
Langues : anglais courant


Déroulement des entretiens


Un premier entretien avec un(e) Digital Sales Manager pour se découvrir mutuellement
Un second entretien avec un(e) associé(e) co-fondateur.rice pour aller plus loin dans les problématiques abordées en mission et les enjeux maîtrisés
Un dernier entretien avec un(e) Consultant(e) Senior, pour faire le point sur votre positionnement et vos compétences


Nous sommes agiles ! Ces entretiens peuvent se faire en visio et/ou en présentiel, dans cet ordre ou un autre.

Qui sont-ils ?

En entreprise, comme en musique, tout est une question de tempo. Depuis 2018, nous réunissons des consultant·e·s passionné·e·s, curieux·ses et ambitieux·ses, uni·e·s par une même conviction : mettre leur expertise au service des défis numériques, sectoriels et industriels de nos clients.

Notre mission ? Accélérer les transformations en combinant excellence opérationnelle, curiosité et audace. Nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs du luxe, du retail, de l’énergie, du transport, du tourisme, de la banque ou encore de l’assurance — partout où la technologie rencontre l’humain.

Nous aimons la tech quand elle connecte et libère les potentiels. Nos consultant·e·s ne se contentent pas de conseiller : ils construisent, testent, mettent en production, mesurent, ajustent et recommencent. Avec nos clients, nous faisons partie du jeu, du début à la fin.

Notre organisation repose sur une culture de la confiance, de l’apprentissage et de la collaboration. Nous avons conçu un cadre unique qui accompagne chaque eXalté·e à chaque étape de sa carrière, avec des rôles clairs, des communautés actives et des rituels qui renforcent le collectif.

Nos eXaltemps trimestriels, notre eXalt Academy et nos projets internes sont autant d’occasions d’apprendre, de partager et de grandir ensemble.

Aujourd’hui présents en France, au Canada, aux États-Unis, au Royaume-Uni, en Belgique, en Espagne, au Portugal et à Monaco, nous sommes portés par un engagement fort et une énergie contagieuse.

Parce qu’apprendre est notre discipline, agir notre obsession et réussir ensemble notre plus belle victoire.

Pulse. Make. Learn.

Trois mots qui rythment notre quotidien. Et peut-être bientôt le tien?

Title: Data Analist / BI Specialist
HTML:
Als Data Analist / BI Specialist zorg jij ervoor dat organisaties hun data omzetten in waardevolle inzichten. Je analyseert complexe datasets, vertaalt deze naar heldere rapportages en dashboards en adviseert stakeholders over datagedreven beslissingen. Met moderne BI-tools zoals Power BI, Tableau of Qlik maak je informatie toegankelijk en begrijpelijk. Daarmee help je onze klanten – zoals de Belastingdienst, Gemeente Den Haag, Centraal Justitieel Incassobureau en VGZ – om hun beleid en processen te verbeteren en toekomstgericht te sturen.


Waarom past deze vacature bij jou?

Je hebt een passie voor data en ziet het als jouw missie om cijfers en informatie te vertalen naar verhalen die impact maken. Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en kunt schakelen tussen business en techniek. Je vindt het leuk om samen te werken met collega’s en stakeholders en voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar data centraal staat.


Wat kan je van ons verwachten?

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS krijg je de kans om te werken aan uitdagende en innovatieve data- en BI-projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties. Wij investeren in jouw ontwikkeling en bieden naast een inspirerende werkomgeving:

  • Een vast dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 6.000, bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding;
  • Opdrachtkeuzevrijheid: Jij bepaalt in overleg waar je aan werkt, met de begeleiding van een personal coach;
  • Per jaar € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast ook nog eens 5-10 dagen studietijd;
  • Kennissessies met vakgenoten en inhoudelijke events;
  • Minimaal 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen op te bouwen of te verkopen;
  • Sociale events zoals sportdagen, weekend weg en gezellige borrels;
  • Een vestiging bij jou in de buurt.


Persoonlijke ontwikkeling

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS geloven we dat leren de sleutel is tot succes. Learn, create and make it work is niet alleen onze slogan, maar zit in ons DNA. Daarom investeren we continu in jouw groei. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen tot bijvoorbeeld Senior Data Analist, BI Architect of Data Platform Specialist. Je wordt begeleid door ervaren collega’s, krijgt toegang tot kennisplatforms en blijft altijd scherp op de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied.


CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar onder andere leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Daarbij benadrukken wij dat gelijke kansen voor iedereen een belangrijk uitgangspunt zijn in onze selectie.


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo bachelor of wo‑opleiding in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Business Analytics of vergelijkbaar;
  • Minimaal 4 jaar aantoonbare ervaring in een Agile omgeving met het analyseren en interpreteren van data en het vertalen van inzichten naar concrete adviezen;
  • Vaardig in het ontwerpen van dashboards en visualisaties die inzichten helder presenteren met tools zoals PowerBi, Qlik of Tableau;
  • Sterke kennis van en ervaring met SQL en/of Databricks voor analyseren van grote datasets;
  • Kennis van actuele ontwikkelingen op het gebied van data-analyse, data-ethiek en relevante wet- en regelgeving;
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;
  • AI-affiniteit is een pré.


Waarom CIMSOLUTIONS?

  • 15 keer Top Employer!
  • Uitstekend salaris;
  • Vrije keuze leaseauto;
  • € 5000,- opleidingsbudget;
  • Aantrekkelijke bonussen;
  • Veel sociale evenementen;
  • Uitdagende projecten;
  • Gevarieerde opdrachten;
  • Gerenommeerde klanten.

Title: DATA ANALYST
Description:
About

Joko is an AI shopping app that helps millions of users save time and money when shopping online or in-store. With Juno, our shopping assistant, they can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds.

What sets Joko’s AI apart is how well it knows its users. Its shopping recommendations feel personal from day one and get sharper the more they use it. It draws on unique assets to deliver the best experience: one of the largest product catalogs in the world, and unique shopping data no one else has to personalize every recommendation.

Users can also track the price of their favorite products and earn cash back almost everywhere. All in one free app.

Joko is a tech company founded in Paris. Their team of 120+ talents is international and spread across Paris, Barcelona, and New York, with some working remotely.

As a certified B Corporation, they are committed to making a difference for the communities they serve, including the 6 million consumers already using Joko to save money every day at over 10,000 merchants.

After reaching profitability in their core market, they are expanding internationally with a primary focus on the US.

It’s still day 1 at Joko; come build the future of shopping with us.

Job Description

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

🧚🏻 Our Data team

The Data team at Joko is turning mountains of data into actionable insights for all the teams! The Data team is part of our Operations department led by our COO, and our mission is to empower the company to make informed decisions.

More Specifically, The Team's Responsibilities Are


State-of-the-art analytics & data science: We want to be at the forefront of analytics and data science by building top-notch analyses and tools. Our goal is to allow teams to leverage powerful insights from advanced reporting and predictive models.
AI-driven autonomy for stakeholders: We are doubling down on the combination of AI and data to unlock a new level of autonomy for our stakeholders, seamlessly bridging data insights with the AI tools we use, built on secure and trustworthy foundations.
Spread the data culture: At Joko, we have a strong engineering and tech culture across all teams. We work hand-in-hand with our stakeholders, providing support and training on data tools, and building close relationships to ensure our solutions align perfectly with their operational needs and evolve with them over time.


🎯 What you will do

As a Data Analyst, you will have a cross-functional role and collaborate closely with teams to understand our data and develop insights.


Advanced analytics & data science: You will explore and analyze data to uncover trends, patterns, and potential issues that will support decision-making processes across all teams. You will also contribute to data science initiatives by building predictive models and applying statistics to generate deeper insights and drive measurable business impact.
Reporting and Data Visualization: You will design and create dashboards and data visualizations that empower stakeholders to explore data autonomously. Leveraging AI tools to move faster, your focus will be on what matters most: defining the right metrics, surfacing meaningful insights, and ensuring data is understood and acted upon across the company.
AI and data integration: You will actively contribute to bridging our data with the AI tools we use, ensuring insights are integrated and maintained over time.
Stakeholder collaboration: You will work hand-in-hand with stakeholders to understand their needs, collect their feedback, and evangelize data usage to help them make smarter choices and become more autonomous over time.
Continuous Learning and Improvement: As "never stop learning" is one of our values, you will grow along the way and keep up with the latest analytical methods, AI developments, and tools in our data stack.


👀 Who we're looking for


Experience: You have 2+ years of professional experience in data analysis (relevant internships can count). We hire across different seniority levels, so we encourage you to apply even if you are more experienced.
Interest in AI: You are genuinely curious about AI and its applications, and eager to leverage it in your day-to-day work to move faster and create more impact.
Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you are willing to get better every day to reach excellence.
Problem-solving & Analytical skills: You love solving complex problems and analyzing data.
Coding knowledge: Mastering SQL and Python is not mandatory, as you can still learn when joining, but it's a plus.
Business acumen: You can understand the needs of your business stakeholders and get the big picture of how the business is running.
Communication: You know how to present your conclusions clearly and concisely (written and oral).
Education: You have graduated from a top-tier business or engineering school.
Languages: You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.


💎 Our perks

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The Data team at Shine

Our Data team is organised into three complementary pillars: Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Analytics.

The Analytics pillar is itself organised into three teams, supporting different parts of the organisation and working closely with Product and Business teams.

You will join the team led by Ludivine, our Data Analytics Manager, and work on a wide range of topics, including product usage and adoption, performance steering, and understanding our customers and their activities.

You will work directly with Product and Business teams across several European markets, turning their challenges into analyses, metrics and decision-making tools that enable better decisions.

Your role as a Senior Data Analyst

What's in it for you?


Direct impact on decision-making: your work will directly influence how Product and Business teams make decisions around adoption, performance and growth across different markets, with strong visibility among senior leadership.
True end-to-end ownership: you will own your topics from understanding and framing the initial need through analysis, solution development and presentation of the results.
A cross-functional business scope: you will work on a variety of challenges across ERP, Payroll and Commerce, spanning several European markets.
Direct stakeholder collaboration: you will work directly with Product and Business teams as well as local leaders to understand their challenges and build the right analytical solutions together.
An environment to build and shape: you will contribute to structuring the KPIs, definitions, data models and decision-making tools required across the different business areas.
A modern Analytics stack: you will work primarily with SQL, dbt and Omni, partnering with Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering teams on data platform and infrastructure topics.
An international environment: you will collaborate with teams across several European countries.
A hybrid work policy: enjoy a balanced mix of remote work and office collaboration.


Your Responsibilities Will Include


Business Understanding & Problem Framing: work directly with stakeholders to understand their challenges, clarify their needs and translate them into relevant analytical questions.
End-to-End Analytics Ownership: own Analytics projects from the initial need through to the presentation of results, including framing, identifying the required data and stakeholders, conducting the analysis, building the deliverable and presenting your conclusions.
Analysis & Recommendations: explore and analyse data to identify trends, understand behaviours and usage patterns, investigate discrepancies or unexpected results, and turn analyses into actionable conclusions for Product and Business teams.
KPI Definition & Governance: help define, document and maintain reliable, consistent and shared business KPIs and definitions.
Dashboards & Decision-Making Tools: design and deliver actionable dashboards in Omni, enabling Product and Business teams to monitor their KPIs, understand their activities and steer performance.
Data Modelling: build robust and scalable data models using SQL and dbt to support recurring and ad hoc analysis and reporting needs.
Stakeholder Management: manage relationships directly with Product and Business teams, challenge requests when necessary, and communicate clearly about progress, findings, risks and blockers.
Data Collaboration: work closely with other Analysts as well as Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering teams, share knowledge and contribute to building common Analytics practices.


📍 Job located in Paris or Berlin with possibility of two remote working days per week.

About You


Experience: you have solid experience in Data Analytics and have already owned analytical topics independently. Demonstrated autonomy and ownership matter more than an exact number of years of experience.
Technical Excellence: you have excellent SQL skills and solid experience with dbt, including modelling, testing and documentation.
Business Intelligence: you have strong experience with BI and Data Visualisation tools. Hands-on experience with Omni will be particularly valued.
Analytical & Critical Thinking: you know how to structure a problem, challenge data and definitions, investigate unexpected results and draw relevant conclusions.
Business Understanding: you can quickly understand a new business domain, ask the right questions and translate business challenges into analytical approaches.
Ownership & Autonomy: you are able to take ownership of a topic end-to-end and move it forward independently, while knowing when to involve the right people.
Stakeholder Management: you are comfortable working directly with Product and Business stakeholders, understanding their expectations and constructively challenging their requests.
Communication: you can synthesise complex analyses and clearly communicate your conclusions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Collaboration: you enjoy working as part of a team, sharing knowledge and contributing to collective success.
Data Stack: familiarity with Snowflake is a plus. More advanced data platform and infrastructure topics are supported by our Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering teams.
Languages: fluent French and the ability to work professionally in English in an international environment.


Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

Our recruitment process

1️⃣ Screening Call: Initial screening call with a TA-partner

2️⃣ Manager Interview (60’): Discussion with Ludivine (Hiring Manager)

3️⃣ Case Study Presentation (60’): Evaluation of your methodology, problem-structuring, and impact mindset.

4️⃣ Logical & Personality Assessment (30–45’): Followed by meeting a few team members + Discussion with the VP of Data & Analytics regarding collaboration and strategic vision.

Our Data team is organised into three complementary pillars: Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Analytics.

The Analytics pillar is itself organised into three teams, supporting different parts of the organisation and working closely with Product and Business teams.

You will join the team led by Ludivine, our Data Analytics Manager, and work on a wide range of topics, including product usage and adoption, performance steering, and understanding our customers and their activities.

You will work directly with Product and Business teams across several European markets, turning their challenges into analyses, metrics and decision-making tools that enable better decisions.

Your role as a Senior Data Analyst

What's in it for you?

  • Direct impact on decision-making: your work will directly influence how Product and Business teams make decisions around adoption, performance and growth across different markets, with strong visibility among senior leadership.
  • True end-to-end ownership: you will own your topics from understanding and framing the initial need through analysis, solution development and presentation of the results.
  • A cross-functional business scope: you will work on a variety of challenges across ERP, Payroll and Commerce, spanning several European markets.
  • Direct stakeholder collaboration: you will work directly with Product and Business teams as well as local leaders to understand their challenges and build the right analytical solutions together.
  • An environment to build and shape: you will contribute to structuring the KPIs, definitions, data models and decision-making tools required across the different business areas.
  • A modern Analytics stack: you will work primarily with SQL, dbt and Omni, partnering with Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering teams on data platform and infrastructure topics.
  • An international environment: you will collaborate with teams across several European countries.
  • A hybrid work policy: enjoy a balanced mix of remote work and office collaboration.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

  • Business Understanding & Problem Framing: work directly with stakeholders to understand their challenges, clarify their needs and translate them into relevant analytical questions.
  • End-to-End Analytics Ownership: own Analytics projects from the initial need through to the presentation of results, including framing, identifying the required data and stakeholders, conducting the analysis, building the deliverable and presenting your conclusions.
  • Analysis & Recommendations: explore and analyse data to identify trends, understand behaviours and usage patterns, investigate discrepancies or unexpected results, and turn analyses into actionable conclusions for Product and Business teams.
  • KPI Definition & Governance: help define, document and maintain reliable, consistent and shared business KPIs and definitions.
  • Dashboards & Decision-Making Tools: design and deliver actionable dashboards in Omni, enabling Product and Business teams to monitor their KPIs, understand their activities and steer performance.
  • Data Modelling: build robust and scalable data models using SQL and dbt to support recurring and ad hoc analysis and reporting needs.
  • Stakeholder Management: manage relationships directly with Product and Business teams, challenge requests when necessary, and communicate clearly about progress, findings, risks and blockers.
  • Data Collaboration: work closely with other Analysts as well as Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering teams, share knowledge and contribute to building common Analytics practices.

📍 Job located in Paris or Berlin with possibility of two remote working days per week.

About You

  • Experience: you have solid experience in Data Analytics and have already owned analytical topics independently. Demonstrated autonomy and ownership matter more than an exact number of years of experience.
  • Technical Excellence: you have excellent SQL skills and solid experience with dbt, including modelling, testing and documentation.
  • Business Intelligence: you have strong experience with BI and Data Visualisation tools. Hands-on experience with Omni will be particularly valued.
  • Analytical & Critical Thinking: you know how to structure a problem, challenge data and definitions, investigate unexpected results and draw relevant conclusions.
  • Business Understanding: you can quickly understand a new business domain, ask the right questions and translate business challenges into analytical approaches.
  • Ownership & Autonomy: you are able to take ownership of a topic end-to-end and move it forward independently, while knowing when to involve the right people.
  • Stakeholder Management: you are comfortable working directly with Product and Business stakeholders, understanding their expectations and constructively challenging their requests.
  • Communication: you can synthesise complex analyses and clearly communicate your conclusions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaboration: you enjoy working as part of a team, sharing knowledge and contributing to collective success.
  • Data Stack: familiarity with Snowflake is a plus. More advanced data platform and infrastructure topics are supported by our Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering teams.
  • Languages: fluent French and the ability to work professionally in English in an international environment.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

Our recruitment process

1️⃣ Screening Call: Initial screening call with a TA-partner

2️⃣ Manager Interview (60’): Discussion with Ludivine (Hiring Manager)

3️⃣ Case Study Presentation (60’): Evaluation of your methodology, problem-structuring, and impact mindset.

4️⃣ Logical & Personality Assessment (30–45’): Followed by meeting a few team members + Discussion with the VP of Data & Analytics regarding collaboration and strategic vision.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

MSX International es un líder global en servicios para el sector de automoción, presente en más de 80 países. Desde nuestra sede en Barcelona trabajamos con diferentes fabricantes internacionales para ofrecer soluciones innovadoras que impulsan la eficiencia, la calidad y el rendimiento de sus operaciones.

Si buscas un entorno dinámico, analítico, internacional y orientado a la mejora continua, este es tu sitio.

Como Analista de Datos, serás responsable de gestionar, analizar y transformar datos clave relacionados con proyectos del sector automoción. Tu misión será convertir grandes volúmenes de datos en insights claros y accionables que apoyen la toma de decisiones, la optimización de procesos y el rendimiento general del negocio.

Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares internos en informes y dashboards
Presentar análisis, conclusiones e información relevante a equipos internos y dirección
Asegurar la precisión, consistencia y calidad de los datos analizados
Proponer mejoras continuas en procesos, metodologías y flujos de análisis


Requisitos

Habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar con equipos diversos
Enfoque resolutivo para problemas complejos
Capacidad para gestionar prioridades y trabajar con plazos ajustados
Dominio de Tableau, Power BI y Excel
Conocimientos de sistemas de gestión de datos, minería de datos, procesos ETL y reporting automatizado
Competencias en análisis estadístico y modelos de rendimiento
Experiencia con herramientas de automatización (RPA) es un plus
Conocimiento de Microsoft Dynamics (deseable)


Formación


Grado en Ingeniería, Economía, Estadística, Matemáticas o formación equivalente


Experiencia


Experiencia previa demostrable como Analista de Datos


Idiomas


Español nativo
Inglés B2 (escrito y hablado)

Puesto permanente con contrato indefinido desde el primer día.
Política de teletrabajo de hasta el 50% de la jornada mensual tras el periodo de adaptación.
Formar parte de un gran equipo de profesionales en una compañía internacional consolidada.
Obtener una visión global del sector automoción, interactuando con clientes, proveedores, consultores y concesionarios.
Salario: 23.000 euros brutos anuales.
Acceso a MSX Bazaar, el portal de compras colectivas con grandes descuentos para empleados.
Posibilidad de adherirte al Plan de Retribución Flexible (seguro médico, tarjeta transporte, tarjeta restaurante, formación...).
23 días laborables de vacaciones al año según convenio y 3 días por año completo trabajado.
Incentivos adicionales por programas de recomendación interna, formadores internos, detección de nuevas oportunidades de negocio, etc.

Title: Senior Data Analist Kruidvat
Description:
Dit ga je doen

In de rol van Senior Data Analist bij AS Watson ben je onderdeel van het Decision Analytics‑team binnen Data, Insights & Analytics voor onze merken Kruidvat en Trekpleister. Samen met andere collega's uit het analytics team (Data Engineer, Data Scientist) werk je aan uiteenlopende projecten en analyses die meerdere businessdomeinen raken, van commercie tot HR en supply chain tot winkels.

Als grootste Health en Beauty retailer in de Benelux hebben we een schat aan data die we kunnen gebruiken. Elke week worden we bezocht door 4 MILJOEN klanten in onze ruim 1500 winkels én webshops. Zowel in de Benelux als internationaal hebben we de focus op data analytics. Dit zie je onder andere terug in de centrale rol van onze afdeling en investeringen in moderne data en Cloud technologieën. Met jouw analytische blik vertaal je als Senior Data Analist complexe vraagstukken naar heldere inzichten en data‑producten die het datagedreven werken in onze online en offlineorganisatie versterken, of het nu gaat om klantgedrag, voorraadstromen, winkelperformance of operationele efficiëntie. Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar patronen in data en wil je met jouw analyses echte impact maken in een grote retailorganisatie?

Wat ga je doen als Data Analist bij AS Watson?


Je ondersteunt verschillende business- en klantteams met analyses en dataproducten die processen, klantreizen en operationele performance verbeteren.
Je vertaalt de (interne) klantvragen naar technische requirements of een helder analysevraagstuk.
Je voert zelfstandig (ad hoc) statistische analyses uit en brengt complexe inzichten terug tot heldere, begrijpelijke kernpunten.
Je doet concrete, praktische aanbevelingen aan stakeholders en ondersteunt teams actief bij datagedreven besluitvorming.
Je stimuleert en borgt de adoptie van nieuwe dataproducten binnen de organisatie.


Dit krijg je ervoor terug


Een snelle omgeving waarin je veel kunt leren. En werkplezier door verantwoordelijkheid, vrijheid en de ruimte om jezelf te ontplooien. 
Best belangrijk: een goed salaris! Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring start je tussen de € 4.580,- en € 6.500,- bruto per maand bij een 40-urige werkweek. Plus personeelskorting bij Kruidvat, Trekpleister en ICI PARIS XL! 
24 vakantiedagen en een aantrekkelijke ATV-regeling met 19,5 dagen op fulltime basis. Liever meer vrije tijd of extra geld? Koop of verkoop vakantiedagen of laat je ATV (deels) uitbetalen.
Volop ontwikkelings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden met onze eigen AS Watson Academy. Bij AS Watson sta je nooit stil.
Goede thuiswerkmogelijkheden. Hybride werken is bij ons heel gewoon en gaat altijd in goed overleg.

Opererai in un contesto collaborativo e strutturato, orientato alla qualità e all'innovazione, dove il tuo contributo sarà valorizzato attraverso un percorso di crescita professionale.

Buona conoscenza di Looker Studio per la visualizzazione del dato

Un'elevata attitudine al lavoro in team
Doti di precisione e flessibilità mentale
Capacità proattiva nella gestione delle problematiche professionali

Title: Medior Data Analist (fluent Dutch required)
Description:
Werk jij graag met data en wil je samen met ons bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Data Analyse bij DataGrow?




Elke dag is anders




Een dag als Data Analist bij DataGrow

Op een doordeweekse dag werk je samen met de klant. Je begint met een blik op de belangrijkste dashboards en rapportages: kloppen de cijfers, vallen er afwijkingen op en welke ontwikkelingen vragen om extra aandacht? Een opvallende verandering in de resultaten onderzoek je later die ochtend verder.




Daarna sluit je aan bij een overleg met collega’s en stakeholders uit de business. Samen verhelderen jullie de informatiebehoefte en vertaal je deze naar passende analyses en heldere KPI’s. Je denkt mee over definities en zorgt ervoor dat iedereen de cijfers op dezelfde manier begrijpt.




’s Middags schrijf je SQL-query’s, controleer je de datakwaliteit en werk je verder aan een dashboard in Power BI. Je onderzoekt wat er gebeurt en welke factoren daarbij een rol spelen, en vertaalt de uitkomsten naar begrijpelijke inzichten en praktische aanbevelingen voor de klant.




Tussendoor stem je met een data engineer af over een nieuwe databron en bekijk je samen met een collega een dashboard voordat het wordt gepubliceerd. Op vrijdag ontmoet je je collega’s op kantoor, deel je inzichten uit de week en wissel je kennis en ideeën uit tijdens de wekelijkse AI-sessie. Daarna sluiten jullie de week informeel af.

Bij DataGrow sta je nooit stil. Hier krijg je de kennis, tijd en ruimte om te ontwikkelen.




Waarom DataGrow

DataGrow is een Great Place To Grow (GPTG). Een bedrijf waar klanten klant willen zijn, en waar medewerkers met plezier naar hun werk komen en uitgedaagd worden.




Blijf vooraan in je vak.

Wekelijkse AI-sessies: Power BI MCP, Claude Code, en de nieuwste tools en technieken.

Wij betalen relevante opleidingen volledig.

Budget om te experimenteren met de nieuwste AI-tools.




Maatschappelijk impactvol werk

Projecten bij vitale en kritieke organisaties, waar je werk echt impact heeft.

Geen dashboard of ETL-pipeline die niemand gebruikt.




Autonomie & Flexibiliteit

Heb je een goed idee? Je krijgt ruimte en budget om er mee aan de slag te gaan.

Geen bureaucratie, korte lijnen en directe invloed. Initiatief wordt gewaardeerd, niet vertraagd.

Hybride werken, flexibel je werk indelen – wij werken resultaatgedreven.




Op een rij

Wat wij bieden

Een bruto jaarsalaris tussen € 64.800 en € 95.760, afhankelijk van je ervaring en wat je meebrengt.
25 vakantiedagen per jaar met de optie om bij te kopen. In overleg is het mogelijk om twee christelijke vakantiedagen te ruilen met twee andere feestdagen die voor jou belangrijk zijn, zonder dat je daar een vrije dag voor hoeft op te nemen.
Volledige reiskostenvergoeding.
Alle hardware die je nodig hebt.




Even voorstellen




Wie ben jij

Je hebt een paar jaar ervaring als Data Analist en je bent toe aan een plek waar je meer eigen richting mag pakken. Verder herken je je hierin:

Je hebt een afgeronde HBO of WO opleiding.
Je hebt 2+ jaar ervaring als Data Analist.
Je hebt ervaring met datavisualisatietools zoals Power BI, Tableau of Qlik.
Kennis en ervaring met SQL.
Kennis en ervaring met Python is een pré.




Twijfel je of je precies aan het rijtje voldoet? Voel je ook dan welkom om te solliciteren! We kijken niet alleen naar vinkjes, maar vooral naar hoe je denkt, wat je meebrengt en hoe jouw perspectief kan bijdragen aan ons team. We waarderen verschillende achtergronden, ervaringen en manieren van werken.




Voldoe ik niet aan alle eisen, kan ik dan solliciteren?




Jazeker! Bij DataGrow kijken we graag samen naar je ervaringen om te bepalen of er alsnog een match is. We kijken niet alleen naar vinkjes, maar vooral naar hoe je denkt, wat je meebrengt en hoe jouw perspectief kan bijdragen aan ons team. We waarderen verschillende achtergronden, ervaringen en manieren van werken.




Neem vooral contact op met Karan als je even kort wilt sparren!




In 5 stappen naar een prachtige samenwerking




Het Sollicitatieproces




Solliciteer

Je solliciteert eenvoudig via onze website of door te mailen naar recruitment@datagrow.nl.




Kennismaking

Een korte telefonische kennismaking met Karan.




Verdiepingsgesprek

Een verdiepend gesprek met een van de partners, David of Sergey, over je ervaring, je ambities en onze cultuur.




Teamgesprek

Je ontmoet een aantal collega’s uit je mogelijke toekomstige team.




Aanbod

Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan doen we je met plezier een aanbod!




We maken graag kennis




Interesse?

Gebruik het formulier om te solliciteren bij DataGrow.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About BizAway

Here at BizAway, we Deliver the Future of Travel. 😎

We are a solid international company with strong ambitions and great expertise. With a focus on sustainability 🌱, on a daily basis we support companies enabling them to improve their travel management through our constantly evolving services and solutions, always characterized by our tech attitude and smart and innovative processes. 🚀

We know that success comes from People and deserves to be recognized.👫Proactivity and

Reliability, Kind collaboration, and communication are the core values of our Solution Culture.

If you like challenges and would love to be part of one of the fastest-growing B2B scale-ups, then BizAway is the company you have been looking for. 🤩

We are looking for

We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic Senior Data Analyst (m/w/d) , who desires to contribute to the growth and success of our Data & Analytics Team.

Your role in BizAway


You tackle complex business problems end to end, translating ambiguous questions into analysis, and analysis into recommendations the business can act on.
You deliver data products rather than one-off reports, reusable models and tools that keep delivering value over time.
You own our semantic layer, the metric definitions, business logic and data models that make sure there is one trusted answer to any business question, for people and for AI.
You own the implementation and evolution of our self-service analytics tools, so internal stakeholders can answer their own recurring questions.
You learn all aspects of the travel industry covering Finance, Product, Sales and Operations perspective, and engage with Business stakeholders to define KPIs, including how data is captured, shared and leveraged across departments.


Your Basic Qualifications


Data analysis, presentation, and visualization experience
Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence senior non-technical stakeholders
Ability to work autonomously with high ambiguity, alone or in a team as required
Advanced SQL, Python and strong data modeling fundamentals
Experience defining and maintaining shared metric definitions across an organisation
Demonstrated experience with Product Analytics tools (eg: Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo, Google Analytics)
Demonstrated experience with BI Data Visualization tools (Qlik preferred)
Master degree in Statistics, Engineering, Economics or a related field is preferred
Previously worked in a Tech Company
English proficiency (written and spoken level B2)


We are also interested in


Understanding of AI/ML concepts
Experience making data available to LLMs or AI agents
Previous experience in the travel industry or similar sectors


Our offer

📄 Contract type: Permanent

🕓 Working hours: Full-time – 40h/week, from Monday to Friday

🏢 Hybrid setting, flexible working policy, and great offices in Europe

💰 Salary: Attractive compensation, including equity in the company

💼 Equity in the company (stock options plan)

✈️ A seat on a scale-up with skyrocketing growth

📈 Development of your entrepreneurial spirit, having the chance to implement real-impact business decision

🌍Multicultural and international team

🙌Collaborative and smart environment to work and learn

🍻Free coffee to kick-start your day and free beers to celebrate together

BizAway avoids any discrimination based on age, gender, sexual orientation, health status, nationality, political opinions, and religious beliefs in all decisions affecting personnel selection.

Title: Data Analyst BI confirmé (H/F)
Description:
Depuis sa création, KLANIK s'est donnée pour mission de conjuguer expertise technologique et authenticité.

Ce pari audacieux, né à Marseille en 2011, en France, s'est transformé en une aventure internationale qui compte aujourd'hui plus de 800 collaborateurs, des implantations dans 10 pays et des filiales innovantes. Nous rejoignons en 2026 le groupe ALTEN, acteur mondial de l'ingénierie et des services numériques.

Notre rôle : recruter les meilleurs talents & les connecter à nos clients pour les accompagner dans leurs projets digitaux. KLANIK est une société de conseil en informatique structurée autour de 5 pôles d'expertises : Data & IA, DevOps Cloud Infra, Cybersécurité, Software, Produit Agilité Pilotage.

Nos 800 talents ont des profils variés : tech (nos pôles d'expertises), opérationnels (fonctions commerciales et recrutement) et support.

Au‑delà des métiers, KLANIK cultive un modèle profondément humain, qui dépasse les frontières : de la Belgique à la Colombie, nos valeurs résonnent. Une culture fondée sur le partage, l'exigence et la bienveillance - un collectif où chacun peut trouver sa place. En témoignent nos filiales :

Klanik Esport : club Esport & agence de gamification;

Korner : incubateur de startups tech;

Kampus : organisme de formation certifié Qualiopi

l'Act'In Klanik, rôles qui permettent à nos collaborateurs de faire vivre leurs passions au-delà de leurs missions.

Notre culture est résumée par cette phrase, souvent apposée sous notre logo : Human-Made Technology. La tech oui, mais une tech humaine, qui diffuse un modèle où l'authenticité de chacun est la priorité.

KLANIK, en tant que société à mission, croit en la force de la diversité et de l'inclusion. Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d'origine, d'âge ou de genre, et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force qui contribue à notre succès.

Le Poste

Rejoignez un acteur majeur du secteur de la banque et contribuez à des projets à fort impact !

Vous avez envie de rejoindre une ESN moderne, avec un business model participatif, tournée vers l'humain et la formation de ses collaborateurs ?

Alors nous avons besoin de vous pour répondre aux différents besoins de nos clients !

Si vous faites le pari de nous rejoindre, vous évoluerez chez différents clients au fil de votre expérience chez Klanik.

Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Data d'un de nos clients dans le secteur bancaire , nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst BI pour intervenir auprès d'une ou plusieurs équipes produit .

Vous rejoindrez un environnement Data structuré, au sein duquel vous contribuerez directement à la valorisation des données, à la production d'analyses et de tableaux de bord, ainsi qu'à l'accompagnement des métiers dans leurs problématiques décisionnelles.

Vous évoluerez dans un contexte Agile, en étroite collaboration avec les Product Owners, Business Analysts, équipes de développement et interlocuteurs métiers.

L'environnement technique s'articule notamment autour de SQL, MicroStrategy et Teradata.

Vos principales missions

En tant que Data Analyst BI, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :


Collaborer avec les Business Analysts afin de comprendre les besoins métiers et les traduire en indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) pertinents.
Explorer, analyser et valoriser les données disponibles afin de produire des analyses descriptives, reporting et tableaux de bord BI.
Concevoir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord MicroStrategy, en veillant à leur pertinence fonctionnelle et à leur qualité.
Requêter et extraire les données via des scripts SQL, à des fins d'analyse ou pour répondre à des besoins opérationnels.
Conduire des analyses Data en lien direct avec les problématiques et enjeux métiers.
Présenter les résultats des analyses auprès d'un public métier varié, animer des réunions et faciliter la compréhension des données.
Interpréter les résultats et formuler des insights et recommandations business auprès des parties prenantes.
Accompagner les métiers dans l'application des principes de gouvernance et de protection de la donnée : Data Management, Data Privacy, conformité, etc.
Documenter les analyses, méthodologies et bonnes pratiques ainsi que les guides utilisateurs des tableaux de bord.
Assurer la maintenance et l'amélioration continue des livrables existants : évolution des rapports, optimisation des dashboards et amélioration des processus analytiques.
Être force de proposition sur les solutions permettant d'améliorer la qualité, la pertinence et l'efficacité des analyses BI.


Déroulement Des Entretiens

Chez Klanik, nous souhaitons apporter la meilleure expérience candidat possible. Ainsi, nous privilégions les processus de recrutements les plus courts possibles, et encadrés par des valeurs de partage, de bienveillance et d'exigence.

Vous serez amené à échanger tout au long du processus avec :


Nos HR Partner
Nos Validateurs Techniques
Nos Business Managers


Profil

Formation et expérience


Formation supérieure Bac +3 minimum en informatique ou domaine équivalent.
5 ans d'expérience minimum sur un poste équivalent
Expérience significative dans le secteur bancaire


Compétences techniques indispensables


Maîtrise des requêtes et de l'extraction de données pour les besoins d'analyse
Expertise indispensable en SQL.
Maîtrise des environnements de bases de données SQL
Expertise sur un outil de Data Visualisation / Business Intelligence
Une expertise sur Power BI ou Tableau peut également être considérée


Qualités attendues


Excellente communication & pédagogie
Esprit d'équipe
Esprit critique : savoir challenger le besoin métier et proposer des solutions adaptées
Autonomie & adaptabilité

Title: DATA ANALYST
Description:
About

Joko is an AI shopping app that helps millions of users save time and money when shopping online or in-store. With Juno, our shopping assistant, they can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds.

What sets Joko’s AI apart is how well it knows its users. Its shopping recommendations feel personal from day one and get sharper the more they use it. It draws on unique assets to deliver the best experience: one of the largest product catalogs in the world, and unique shopping data no one else has to personalize every recommendation.

Users can also track the price of their favorite products and earn cash back almost everywhere. All in one free app.

Joko is a tech company founded in Paris. Their team of 120+ talents is international and spread across Paris, Barcelona, and New York, with some working remotely.

As a certified B Corporation, they are committed to making a difference for the communities they serve, including the 6 million consumers already using Joko to save money every day at over 10,000 merchants.

After reaching profitability in their core market, they are expanding internationally with a primary focus on the US.

It’s still day 1 at Joko; come build the future of shopping with us.

Job Description

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

🧚🏻 Our Data team

The Data team at Joko is turning mountains of data into actionable insights for all the teams! The Data team is part of our Operations department led by our COO, and our mission is to empower the company to make informed decisions.

More Specifically, The Team's Responsibilities Are


State-of-the-art analytics & data science: We want to be at the forefront of analytics and data science by building top-notch analyses and tools. Our goal is to allow teams to leverage powerful insights from advanced reporting and predictive models.
AI-driven autonomy for stakeholders: We are doubling down on the combination of AI and data to unlock a new level of autonomy for our stakeholders, seamlessly bridging data insights with the AI tools we use, built on secure and trustworthy foundations.
Spread the data culture: At Joko, we have a strong engineering and tech culture across all teams. We work hand-in-hand with our stakeholders, providing support and training on data tools, and building close relationships to ensure our solutions align perfectly with their operational needs and evolve with them over time.


🎯 What you will do

As a Data Analyst, you will have a cross-functional role and collaborate closely with teams to understand our data and develop insights.


Advanced analytics & data science: You will explore and analyze data to uncover trends, patterns, and potential issues that will support decision-making processes across all teams. You will also contribute to data science initiatives by building predictive models and applying statistics to generate deeper insights and drive measurable business impact.
Reporting and Data Visualization: You will design and create dashboards and data visualizations that empower stakeholders to explore data autonomously. Leveraging AI tools to move faster, your focus will be on what matters most: defining the right metrics, surfacing meaningful insights, and ensuring data is understood and acted upon across the company.
AI and data integration: You will actively contribute to bridging our data with the AI tools we use, ensuring insights are integrated and maintained over time.
Stakeholder collaboration: You will work hand-in-hand with stakeholders to understand their needs, collect their feedback, and evangelize data usage to help them make smarter choices and become more autonomous over time.
Continuous Learning and Improvement: As "never stop learning" is one of our values, you will grow along the way and keep up with the latest analytical methods, AI developments, and tools in our data stack.


👀 Who we're looking for


Experience: You have 2+ years of professional experience in data analysis (relevant internships can count). We hire across different seniority levels, so we encourage you to apply even if you are more experienced.
Interest in AI: You are genuinely curious about AI and its applications, and eager to leverage it in your day-to-day work to move faster and create more impact.
Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you are willing to get better every day to reach excellence.
Problem-solving & Analytical skills: You love solving complex problems and analyzing data.
Coding knowledge: Mastering SQL and Python is not mandatory, as you can still learn when joining, but it's a plus.
Business acumen: You can understand the needs of your business stakeholders and get the big picture of how the business is running.
Communication: You know how to present your conclusions clearly and concisely (written and oral).
Education: You have graduated from a top-tier business or engineering school.
Languages: You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.


💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:


Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.
Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.


On Top Of That, We Offer Plenty Of Perks


💸 Top-market compensation
📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build
🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills
🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings
💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription
🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent
…and much more, check the full list here!


🤝 Our hiring process


Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.
Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).
Step 2 – Role-specific assessments
For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).
For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).
Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.
References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Additional Information


Contract Type: Full-Time
Location: Paris, Barcelona
Possible full remote
Salary: between 48000€ and 84000€ / year
