From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

🧚🏻 Our Data team

The Data team at Joko is turning mountains of data into actionable insights for all the teams! The Data team is part of our Operations department led by our COO, and our mission is to empower the company to make informed decisions.

More Specifically, The Team's Responsibilities Are

  • State-of-the-art analytics & data science: We want to be at the forefront of analytics and data science by building top-notch analyses and tools. Our goal is to allow teams to leverage powerful insights from advanced reporting and predictive models.
  • AI-driven autonomy for stakeholders: We are doubling down on the combination of AI and data to unlock a new level of autonomy for our stakeholders, seamlessly bridging data insights with the AI tools we use, built on secure and trustworthy foundations.
  • Spread the data culture: At Joko, we have a strong engineering and tech culture across all teams. We work hand-in-hand with our stakeholders, providing support and training on data tools, and building close relationships to ensure our solutions align perfectly with their operational needs and evolve with them over time.

🎯 What you will do

As a Data Analyst, you will have a cross-functional role and collaborate closely with teams to understand our data and develop insights.

  • Advanced analytics & data science: You will explore and analyze data to uncover trends, patterns, and potential issues that will support decision-making processes across all teams. You will also contribute to data science initiatives by building predictive models and applying statistics to generate deeper insights and drive measurable business impact.
  • Reporting and Data Visualization: You will design and create dashboards and data visualizations that empower stakeholders to explore data autonomously. Leveraging AI tools to move faster, your focus will be on what matters most: defining the right metrics, surfacing meaningful insights, and ensuring data is understood and acted upon across the company.
  • AI and data integration: You will actively contribute to bridging our data with the AI tools we use, ensuring insights are integrated and maintained over time.
  • Stakeholder collaboration: You will work hand-in-hand with stakeholders to understand their needs, collect their feedback, and evangelize data usage to help them make smarter choices and become more autonomous over time.
  • Continuous Learning and Improvement: As "never stop learning" is one of our values, you will grow along the way and keep up with the latest analytical methods, AI developments, and tools in our data stack.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 2+ years of professional experience in data analysis (relevant internships can count). We hire across different seniority levels, so we encourage you to apply even if you are more experienced.
  • Interest in AI: You are genuinely curious about AI and its applications, and eager to leverage it in your day-to-day work to move faster and create more impact.
  • Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you are willing to get better every day to reach excellence.
  • Problem-solving & Analytical skills: You love solving complex problems and analyzing data.
  • Coding knowledge: Mastering SQL and Python is not mandatory, as you can still learn when joining, but it's a plus.
  • Business acumen: You can understand the needs of your business stakeholders and get the big picture of how the business is running.
  • Communication: You know how to present your conclusions clearly and concisely (written and oral).
  • Education: You have graduated from a top-tier business or engineering school.
  • Languages: You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.
  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On Top Of That, We Offer Plenty Of Perks

  • 💸 Top-market compensation
  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build
  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills
  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings
  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription
  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent
  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  • Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.
  • Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).
  • Step 2 – Role-specific assessments
    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).
    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).
  • Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.
  • References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.
☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Additional Information

  • Contract Type: Full-Time
  • Location: Paris, Barcelona
  • Possible full remote
  • Salary: between 48000€ and 84000€ / year

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The Data team at Shine

Our Data team is organised into three complementary pillars: Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Analytics.

The Analytics pillar is itself organised into three teams, supporting different parts of the organisation and working closely with Product and Business teams.

You will join the team led by Ludivine, our Data Analytics Manager, and work on a wide range of topics, including product usage and adoption, performance steering, and understanding our customers and their activities.

You will work directly with Product and Business teams across several European markets, turning their challenges into analyses, metrics and decision-making tools that enable better decisions.

Your role as a Senior Data Analyst

What's in it for you?


Direct impact on decision-making: your work will directly influence how Product and Business teams make decisions around adoption, performance and growth across different markets, with strong visibility among senior leadership.
True end-to-end ownership: you will own your topics from understanding and framing the initial need through analysis, solution development and presentation of the results.
A cross-functional business scope: you will work on a variety of challenges across ERP, Payroll and Commerce, spanning several European markets.
Direct stakeholder collaboration: you will work directly with Product and Business teams as well as local leaders to understand their challenges and build the right analytical solutions together.
An environment to build and shape: you will contribute to structuring the KPIs, definitions, data models and decision-making tools required across the different business areas.
A modern Analytics stack: you will work primarily with SQL, dbt and Omni, partnering with Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering teams on data platform and infrastructure topics.
An international environment: you will collaborate with teams across several European countries.
A hybrid work policy: enjoy a balanced mix of remote work and office collaboration.


Your Responsibilities Will Include


Business Understanding & Problem Framing: work directly with stakeholders to understand their challenges, clarify their needs and translate them into relevant analytical questions.
End-to-End Analytics Ownership: own Analytics projects from the initial need through to the presentation of results, including framing, identifying the required data and stakeholders, conducting the analysis, building the deliverable and presenting your conclusions.
Analysis & Recommendations: explore and analyse data to identify trends, understand behaviours and usage patterns, investigate discrepancies or unexpected results, and turn analyses into actionable conclusions for Product and Business teams.
KPI Definition & Governance: help define, document and maintain reliable, consistent and shared business KPIs and definitions.
Dashboards & Decision-Making Tools: design and deliver actionable dashboards in Omni, enabling Product and Business teams to monitor their KPIs, understand their activities and steer performance.
Data Modelling: build robust and scalable data models using SQL and dbt to support recurring and ad hoc analysis and reporting needs.
Stakeholder Management: manage relationships directly with Product and Business teams, challenge requests when necessary, and communicate clearly about progress, findings, risks and blockers.
Data Collaboration: work closely with other Analysts as well as Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering teams, share knowledge and contribute to building common Analytics practices.


📍 Job located in Paris or Berlin with possibility of two remote working days per week.

About You


Experience: you have solid experience in Data Analytics and have already owned analytical topics independently. Demonstrated autonomy and ownership matter more than an exact number of years of experience.
Technical Excellence: you have excellent SQL skills and solid experience with dbt, including modelling, testing and documentation.
Business Intelligence: you have strong experience with BI and Data Visualisation tools. Hands-on experience with Omni will be particularly valued.
Analytical & Critical Thinking: you know how to structure a problem, challenge data and definitions, investigate unexpected results and draw relevant conclusions.
Business Understanding: you can quickly understand a new business domain, ask the right questions and translate business challenges into analytical approaches.
Ownership & Autonomy: you are able to take ownership of a topic end-to-end and move it forward independently, while knowing when to involve the right people.
Stakeholder Management: you are comfortable working directly with Product and Business stakeholders, understanding their expectations and constructively challenging their requests.
Communication: you can synthesise complex analyses and clearly communicate your conclusions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Collaboration: you enjoy working as part of a team, sharing knowledge and contributing to collective success.
Data Stack: familiarity with Snowflake is a plus. More advanced data platform and infrastructure topics are supported by our Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering teams.
Languages: fluent French and the ability to work professionally in English in an international environment.


Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

Our recruitment process

1️⃣ Screening Call: Initial screening call with a TA-partner

2️⃣ Manager Interview (60’): Discussion with Ludivine (Hiring Manager)

3️⃣ Case Study Presentation (60’): Evaluation of your methodology, problem-structuring, and impact mindset.

4️⃣ Logical & Personality Assessment (30–45’): Followed by meeting a few team members + Discussion with the VP of Data & Analytics regarding collaboration and strategic vision.

MSX International es un líder global en servicios para el sector de automoción, presente en más de 80 países. Si buscas un entorno dinámico, analítico, internacional y orientado a la mejora continua, este es tu sitio.

Como Analista de Datos, serás responsable de gestionar, analizar y transformar datos clave relacionados con proyectos del sector automoción. Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares internos en informes y dashboards
Presentar análisis, conclusiones e información relevante a equipos internos y dirección
Asegurar la precisión, consistencia y calidad de los datos analizados
Proponer mejoras continuas en procesos, metodologías y flujos de análisis

Habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar con equipos diversos
Enfoque resolutivo para problemas complejos
Capacidad para gestionar prioridades y trabajar con plazos ajustados
Dominio de Tableau, Power BI y Excel
Conocimientos de sistemas de gestión de datos, minería de datos, procesos ETL y reporting automatizado
Competencias en análisis estadístico y modelos de rendimiento
Experiencia con herramientas de automatización (RPA) es un plus
Conocimiento de Microsoft Dynamics (deseable)


Formación


Grado en Ingeniería, Economía, Estadística, Matemáticas o formación equivalente


Experiencia


Experiencia previa demostrable como Analista de Datos


Idiomas


Español nativo
Inglés B2 (escrito y hablado)

Puesto permanente con contrato indefinido desde el primer día.
Política de teletrabajo de hasta el 50% de la jornada mensual tras el periodo de adaptación.
Formar parte de un gran equipo de profesionales en una compañía internacional consolidada.
Obtener una visión global del sector automoción, interactuando con clientes, proveedores, consultores y concesionarios.

Posibilidad de adherirte al Plan de Retribución Flexible (seguro médico, tarjeta transporte, tarjeta restaurante, formación...).
23 días laborables de vacaciones al año según convenio y 3 días por año completo trabajado.

Title: Senior Data Analist Kruidvat
Description:
Dit ga je doen

In de rol van Senior Data Analist bij AS Watson ben je onderdeel van het Decision Analytics‑team binnen Data, Insights & Analytics voor onze merken Kruidvat en Trekpleister. Samen met andere collega's uit het analytics team (Data Engineer, Data Scientist) werk je aan uiteenlopende projecten en analyses die meerdere businessdomeinen raken, van commercie tot HR en supply chain tot winkels.

Als grootste Health en Beauty retailer in de Benelux hebben we een schat aan data die we kunnen gebruiken. Elke week worden we bezocht door 4 MILJOEN klanten in onze ruim 1500 winkels én webshops. Zowel in de Benelux als internationaal hebben we de focus op data analytics. Dit zie je onder andere terug in de centrale rol van onze afdeling en investeringen in moderne data en Cloud technologieën. Met jouw analytische blik vertaal je als Senior Data Analist complexe vraagstukken naar heldere inzichten en data‑producten die het datagedreven werken in onze online en offlineorganisatie versterken, of het nu gaat om klantgedrag, voorraadstromen, winkelperformance of operationele efficiëntie. Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar patronen in data en wil je met jouw analyses echte impact maken in een grote retailorganisatie?

Wat ga je doen als Data Analist bij AS Watson?


Je ondersteunt verschillende business- en klantteams met analyses en dataproducten die processen, klantreizen en operationele performance verbeteren.
Je vertaalt de (interne) klantvragen naar technische requirements of een helder analysevraagstuk.
Je voert zelfstandig (ad hoc) statistische analyses uit en brengt complexe inzichten terug tot heldere, begrijpelijke kernpunten.
Je doet concrete, praktische aanbevelingen aan stakeholders en ondersteunt teams actief bij datagedreven besluitvorming.
Je stimuleert en borgt de adoptie van nieuwe dataproducten binnen de organisatie.


Dit krijg je ervoor terug


Een snelle omgeving waarin je veel kunt leren. En werkplezier door verantwoordelijkheid, vrijheid en de ruimte om jezelf te ontplooien. 
Best belangrijk: een goed salaris! Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring start je tussen de € 4.580,- en € 6.500,- bruto per maand bij een 40-urige werkweek. Plus personeelskorting bij Kruidvat, Trekpleister en ICI PARIS XL! 
24 vakantiedagen en een aantrekkelijke ATV-regeling met 19,5 dagen op fulltime basis. Liever meer vrije tijd of extra geld? Koop of verkoop vakantiedagen of laat je ATV (deels) uitbetalen.
Volop ontwikkelings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden met onze eigen AS Watson Academy. Bij AS Watson sta je nooit stil.
Goede thuiswerkmogelijkheden. Hybride werken is bij ons heel gewoon en gaat altijd in goed overleg.

Met jouw analytische blik vertaal je als Senior Data Analist complexe vraagstukken naar heldere inzichten en data‑producten die het datagedreven werken in onze online en offlineorganisatie versterken, of het nu gaat om klantgedrag, voorraadstromen, winkelperformance of operationele efficiëntie. Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar patronen in data en wil je met jouw analyses echte impact maken in een grote retailorganisatie?

  • Je ondersteunt verschillende business- en klantteams met analyses en dataproducten die processen, klantreizen en operationele performance verbeteren.

  • Je voert zelfstandig (ad hoc) statistische analyses uit en brengt complexe inzichten terug tot heldere, begrijpelijke kernpunten.
  • Je doet concrete, praktische aanbevelingen aan stakeholders en ondersteunt teams actief bij datagedreven besluitvorming.
  • Je stimuleert en borgt de adoptie van nieuwe dataproducten binnen de organisatie.

  • Best belangrijk: een goed salaris! Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring start je tussen de € 4.580,- en € 6.500,- bruto per maand bij een 40-urige werkweek. Plus personeelskorting bij Kruidvat, Trekpleister en ICI PARIS XL! 
  • 24 vakantiedagen en een aantrekkelijke ATV-regeling met 19,5 dagen op fulltime basis. Liever meer vrije tijd of extra geld? Koop of verkoop vakantiedagen of laat je ATV (deels) uitbetalen.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Coop Sverige – Together we make food-Sweden sustainable

At Coop, data plays an increasingly important role in how we understand our customers, improve our operations and make better decisions. With over 4 million members and data across stores, logistics and digital channels, we have both the scale and the opportunity to create real impact. To add to this, our data platform runs on an architecture suitable for providing agentic analytics!

Within our AI & Business Intelligence organization, we have built a modern analytics platform that we are proud of – and we are now looking for a Senior Data Analyst to help us turn even more of that data into action.

Om Tjänsten

You will join our Analytics team within AI & Business Intelligence, working closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and stakeholders across Coop.

As a Data Analyst, you sit at the intersection of technology and business. The role is not only about answering questions with data, but understanding the problem behind the question, challenging assumptions and determining what we should actually do with the insight.

You will have considerable freedom in how you approach problems. We believe in building reusable, scalable solutions in code rather than repeatedly solving the same problem manually.

What You Will Do


Translate business challenges into analytical questions, solutions and recommendations aid all of Coop in decision making
Work with large datasets across customer behaviour, sales, assortment, logistics and digital channels and develop scalable and reusable solutions with any too you see fitting the purpose.
Build analytical agents, dashboards, ad hoc analyses or any other data product that democratizes our data.
Challenge existing questions and ways of working – moving from “can you analyse this?” towards “this is what we should do.”


Who are you?

We believe you enjoy operating at the intersection of data, technology and business. You are curious enough to dig into the details, but can also step back and understand the bigger picture.

You don't see an analysis as finished when the numbers are correct – you want to understand what they mean and what action they should lead to. You are comfortable taking ownership even when the path forward is not completely defined.

We believe that you


Have experience turning business needs into analytical questions and solutions.
Are comfortable programming in SQL and Python, with experience of PySpark or similar technologies and have experience working with version control, such as Git.
Have strong business understanding and can connect analytical findings to concrete actions and can communicate this effectively with any audience.
Understand fundamental statistical methods and when different analytical approaches are appropriate.


It’s meritorious if you


Have experience from a modern cloud-based data platform or Lakehouse environment.
Have worked with providing agentic analysis, analytics engineering, BI tools or code-first analytical workflows.
Have worked in a scale-up, technology company, consultancy or another environment where broad ownership is expected.
Have experience from retail, e-commerce or another data-intensive consumer business.


About Us

The grocery trade is a stable, long-term industry, and Coop’s offering is essential to the transition toward a greener, more sustainable future. You’ll join a culture defined by humility, initiative and strong values, where we take joint responsibility and genuinely want to help each other succeed. Our office in Solna Business Park offers a modern work environment with great transport links, a fantastic staff restaurant, and the option of hybrid work in agreement with your manager. At Coop, we work for our 4.2 million members, making us by far the largest cooperation in Sweden.

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Hiring Manager Emil Nilsson (Emil.Nilsson@coop.se) or the recruiter Andreas Nilsson (andreas.nilsson2@coop.se)

Welcome with your application!

Werk jij graag met data en wil je samen met ons bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Data Analyse bij DataGrow?




Elke dag is anders




Een dag als Data Analist bij DataGrow

Op een doordeweekse dag werk je samen met de klant. Je begint met een blik op de belangrijkste dashboards en rapportages: kloppen de cijfers, vallen er afwijkingen op en welke ontwikkelingen vragen om extra aandacht? Een opvallende verandering in de resultaten onderzoek je later die ochtend verder.




Daarna sluit je aan bij een overleg met collega’s en stakeholders uit de business. Samen verhelderen jullie de informatiebehoefte en vertaal je deze naar passende analyses en heldere KPI’s. Je denkt mee over definities en zorgt ervoor dat iedereen de cijfers op dezelfde manier begrijpt.




’s Middags schrijf je SQL-query’s, controleer je de datakwaliteit en werk je verder aan een dashboard in Power BI. Je onderzoekt wat er gebeurt en welke factoren daarbij een rol spelen, en vertaalt de uitkomsten naar begrijpelijke inzichten en praktische aanbevelingen voor de klant.




Tussendoor stem je met een data engineer af over een nieuwe databron en bekijk je samen met een collega een dashboard voordat het wordt gepubliceerd. Op vrijdag ontmoet je je collega’s op kantoor, deel je inzichten uit de week en wissel je kennis en ideeën uit tijdens de wekelijkse AI-sessie. Daarna sluiten jullie de week informeel af.

Bij DataGrow sta je nooit stil. Hier krijg je de kennis, tijd en ruimte om te ontwikkelen.




Waarom DataGrow

DataGrow is een Great Place To Grow (GPTG). Een bedrijf waar klanten klant willen zijn, en waar medewerkers met plezier naar hun werk komen en uitgedaagd worden.




Blijf vooraan in je vak.

Wekelijkse AI-sessies: Power BI MCP, Claude Code, en de nieuwste tools en technieken.

Wij betalen relevante opleidingen volledig.

Budget om te experimenteren met de nieuwste AI-tools.




Maatschappelijk impactvol werk

Projecten bij vitale en kritieke organisaties, waar je werk echt impact heeft.

Geen dashboard of ETL-pipeline die niemand gebruikt.




Autonomie & Flexibiliteit

Heb je een goed idee? Je krijgt ruimte en budget om er mee aan de slag te gaan.

Geen bureaucratie, korte lijnen en directe invloed. Initiatief wordt gewaardeerd, niet vertraagd.

Hybride werken, flexibel je werk indelen – wij werken resultaatgedreven.

Wat wij bieden

Een bruto jaarsalaris tussen € 64.800 en € 95.760, afhankelijk van je ervaring en wat je meebrengt.
25 vakantiedagen per jaar met de optie om bij te kopen. In overleg is het mogelijk om twee christelijke vakantiedagen te ruilen met twee andere feestdagen die voor jou belangrijk zijn, zonder dat je daar een vrije dag voor hoeft op te nemen.
Volledige reiskostenvergoeding.
Alle hardware die je nodig hebt.




Even voorstellen

Je hebt een paar jaar ervaring als Data Analist en je bent toe aan een plek waar je meer eigen richting mag pakken. Verder herken je je hierin:

Je hebt een afgeronde HBO of WO opleiding.
Je hebt 2+ jaar ervaring als Data Analist.
Je hebt ervaring met datavisualisatietools zoals Power BI, Tableau of Qlik.
Kennis en ervaring met SQL.

We kijken niet alleen naar vinkjes, maar vooral naar hoe je denkt, wat je meebrengt en hoe jouw perspectief kan bijdragen aan ons team. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Tiqets is an award-winning tech scale-up headquartered in the Netherlands. We are hiring a Senior Data Analyst to join our mission to bring the world more ways to culture!




Who we are

We are revolutionizing the way people buy tickets to unforgettable experiences at the best destinations all over the world. Our technology makes planning easy for thousands of travelers to find all the experiences they don't want to miss during their trip (museums, zoos, theme parks, and more), so they can book all their tickets in one place. We are an international company committed to making culture accessible to our customers and our employees. We embed diversity, equity, and inclusion into our company fiber organically. These values are promoted from the inside out and we strive to represent and honor differences in gender, race, religion, and sexual orientation in our company culture, our content, and our product.




Our values

We are remarkable: Have fun, be creative and celebrate great moments!
We are accessible: Communicate honestly and support each other
We are adaptable: Learn, adapt, and pivot. That's who we are!




Working at Tiqets

The Analytics Team is the core of data-informed decision-making at Tiqets. We support teams across the company in becoming truly data-driven, turning raw information into the decisive actions that fuel our growth. As a Data Analyst, you will lead the end-to-end analytics lifecycle for your domain. You’ll partner with engineers to define data requirements, architect the core warehousing layers in dbt, and transform complex datasets into high-impact Looker dashboards. This is a high-visibility role where you'll own everything from the initial data request to the final insight.




What you will do




You’ll be a strategic partner to Product Owners, Developers, and the Business Teams. You will:

Solve Diverse Problems: Tackle challenges ranging from Supply Acquisition and User Journey Analysis to A/B Testing and Partner Optimization.
Influence the Roadmap: By identifying trends in our KPI’s, you’ll decide with Product Owners & Business Owners on what to test and do next.
Build for Scale: Bridge the gap between engineering and the business to ensure our data infrastructure and processes are robust.




If you are passionate about Data, enjoy working on challenging business problems in a fast-moving environment, and believe in the importance of teamwork, then this could be the right opening for you.




Responsibilities




Design and implement data models with SQL in DBT
Build explores and dashboards in Looker to allow others at the company to ask the right data questions
Deep dive into large business datasets to uncover valuable insights that can be turned into actionable hypotheses
Work with Product Managers, Developers, Marketeers, and Commercial Specialists to determine and measure the right metrics in their respective domains
Keep a close eye on the ever-changing data challenges at Tiqets, and collaborate closely with Strategic Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and other Data Analysts on the team to solve them
Educate and empower others at the company to be more self-reliant for their data needs
Mentor others in the team with technical guidance
Collaborate on the architectural evolution of the Tiqets data model and reporting framework




What you will bring




Experience with hands-on designing and implementing data models with SQL in DBT
Technical or mathematical education at a Bachelor's or Master's level
3+ years of experience in Data Analyst roles
Strong SQL skills; Experience working with a modern Data Warehouse like Redshift, Snowflake, or Databricks
Experience building reports on BI tools like Looker or Tableau.
Excellent oral and written communication skills; Ability to clearly explain concepts and actionable insights
Capacity to thrive in a startup/scale-up environment, adapt quickly, work independently, and take ownership of your work
Nice to have: prior experience in e-commerce with a background in hypothesis-driven A/B Testing
Currently based in the Netherlands




For this role, we have a salary range from €4,000 to €5,000 per month. Your professional background and experience will determine your specific placement within the range.




What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 5-7 weeks to complete, but it may fluctuate depending on the role.




Get in touch!

Please send your application via the form for this vacancy. We can’t wait to hear from you!Are you representing an agency? Thank you for your interest in our job offer. However, we are handling the recruitment process internally and do not require external assistance at this time.

Self-motivated, organised, and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.

Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight


Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency


Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics


Data Management & Quality


Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities


Continuous Improvement & Growth


Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence


Position Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, please contact HR.

Compensation And Benefits

Employees are entitled to compensation commensurate with skill and experience. The exact compensation will vary based on skills, experience, location, and other factors permitted by law. The expected compensation ranges for this position in various states and jurisdictions are as follows:

Full-time employees receive benefits including: medical and dental coverage; life insurance; short-term and long-term disability insurance; pre-tax flexible spending account for certain medical and dependent care expenses; an employee assistance program; Paid Time Off; paid holidays; participation in a retirement plan program after meeting eligibility requirements; and more.

Title: Healthcare Data Analyst -Joslin Diabetes Center
Description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

The Healthcare Data Analyst will be responsible for acquisition, analysis, interpretation, and reporting of sensitive data to support quality and performance measurement and track improvement efforts. They must be able to work independently and collaboratively to locate and validate data, identify data requirements, and communicate data specifications to team members and leaders. They must be able to develop reporting/analytic solutions, but also be able to draw meaningful conclusions and make recommendations for actions.

Responsibilities

Job Description:


Responsible for acquiring, validating, and querying data from data repositories and then using available tools to create dashboards, reports, and effectively synthesizing the data for the end user.
Works with members across teams to define problems and clarify objectives; determines data needs and assists in designing collection tools and reports. Evaluates data and reports to assess if reporting meets end user requirements.
Develops executive level presentations including key observations of statistical, financial and qualitative information. Provides consulting support in developing strategic recommendations to aid decision making by senior management.
Stays abreast of healthcare trends and market development as context for analyses, and becomes proficient with the health system's decision support and other systems.
Collaborates with Information Systems and enterprise data analytics team(s) to obtain and maintain sources and mapping tables.
Ensures data integrity and data quality, regularly reviews data for accuracy, identifies trends, and communicates changes.
Other duties as assigned.


Requirements


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Allied Health or related required. Master's degree in Public Health, Finance, Epidemiology, Biostatistics or equivalent preferred.
2-5 years related work experience.
Strong experience in data management and analytic tools and techniques; Strong experience in report writing, analytics, visualizations, dashboard creation; Strong experience demonstrating analytical, financial, qualitative and quantitative skills.
Advanced technical computer skills as required for technical support specific to functional area and related systems.


Pay Range

$72,800.00 USD - $93,600.00 USD

The pay range listed for this position is the annual base salary range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at this time. Actual compensation is determined based on several factors, that may include seniority, education, training, relevant experience, relevant certifications, geography of work location, job responsibilities, or other applicable factors permissible by law.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
WHO IS GUIDEHEALTH?

Guidehealth is a data-powered, performance-driven healthcare company dedicated to operational excellence. Our goal is to make great healthcare affordable, improve the health of patients, and restore the fulfillment of practicing medicine for providers. Driven by empathy and powered by AI and predictive analytics, Guidehealth leverages remotely-embedded Healthguides™ and a centralized Managed Service Organization to build stronger connections with patients and providers. Physician-led, Guidehealth empowers our partners to deliver high-quality healthcare focused on outcomes and value inside and outside the exam room for all patients. 

As a growing and innovative organization, we operate with a high degree of agility. Employees are expected to adapt to evolving business needs, step in to support cross-functional initiatives, and contribute beyond traditional role boundaries when needed. This collaborative and flexible mindset is essential to our success. We encourage cross-training, ongoing development, and a commitment to learning across all areas of the business—ensuring we continue to grow and you continue to thrive as a high-performing, mission-driven team.

Join us as we put healthcare on a better path!!

Job Description

As Senior Data Analyst, you will play a critical role in Guidehealth's mission to improve healthcare for all by supporting the data needs of our clinical, operational, and leadership teams and the clients we serve. You will gather requirements for reports and analyses, then determine the best approach to meet them. You will have access to a wide array of data sources, from traditional healthcare systems to AI-enabled tools, to build incisive analyses that stand up to scrutiny. You will present your work to internal and external audiences to drive better decision making. And your contributions to Guidehealth's data-driven clinical programs have the potential to positively impact the lives of every individual we serve.

Please note: Guidehealth is unable to provide sponsorship of any work visa, now or in the future. Thank you.

What You'll Be Doing


Handling a wide-ranging portfolio of analytic needs across internal teams and external clients, from quick-turn questions to sustained, multi-month engagements.
Working with healthcare data, including claims, eligibility/enrollment, clinical, and supplemental sources, to produce reliable, well-documented analytic datasets.
Designing, building, and delivering analyses that answer real business and clinical questions, from initial scoping through final presentation.
Owning custom client builds end-to-end: setting expectations, defining scope, developing, iterating based on feedback, and maintaining the deliverable over its lifespan.
Developing analyses supporting value-based care programs, including quality measure performance, risk adjustment and risk score accuracy, and utilization and cost-of-care trends.
Supporting a range of activities for assigned clients, serving as a reliable analytic point of contact and building trust through responsiveness and follow-through.
Validating results and investigating anomalies, treating unexpected findings as something to explore and explain rather than smooth over.
Balancing competing priorities across accounts and internal initiatives, setting realistic expectations on scope and timeline and communicating proactively when either needs to shift.
Communicating findings to technical and non-technical audiences through written summaries, live presentations, and clear visualizations that lead with the insight rather than the method.
Documenting methodology, assumptions, and known data limitations so work is reproducible, defensible, and transferable to another analyst.


Qualifications

What you'll need for success


Bachelor's degree plus at least three years of professional experience in data analytics, or a master's degree with independent research experience.
Evidence of strong problem-solving instincts: curiosity about why the numbers look the way they do, and persistence in chasing down the answer.
Demonstrated experience performing analytics on healthcare data, with working knowledge of standard healthcare code sets and data structures (e.g., ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, DRG, NDC, revenue codes, place of service, claim file layouts).
Strong SQL skills, including the ability to work with large, imperfect datasets and to write queries others can read and maintain.
Proficiency in at least one analytic or statistical tool beyond SQL (e.g., Python, R).
Experience building data visualizations and dashboards in a modern BI tool (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Quicksight).
Track record of delivering work that survives past handoff, built and documented to be maintained, iterated on, and supported over time.
Excellent written and verbal communication, including experience presenting analytic results directly to stakeholders or clients.
Composure and professionalism in demanding situations, including evolving requirements, compressed timelines, and difficult conversations.


What We'd Love For You To Have


Direct experience with value-based care arrangements such as shared savings, capitation, bundled payments, or ACOs.
Experience using the AWS and/or Arcadia Analytics ecosystems.
Hands-on work with quality measure specifications and reporting (HEDIS, eCQMs, MIPS, Stars, state Medicaid measure sets).
Familiarity with risk adjustment methodologies (CMS-HCC, HHS-HCC, CDPS, or similar) and their analytic implications.
Experience with utilization and cost metrics such as admits/1,000, ED visits/1,000, readmission rates, PMPM, and total cost of care.
Exposure to interoperability and data exchange standards (HL7, FHIR, X12 837/834/835, CCDA).
Clinical, health policy, payer, or provider operations background.


Additional Information

The base pay for this role is $90,000.00 to $100,000.00 based upon experience and skills.

Title: Senior Health Data Analyst - Compass
Description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As the Senior Health Data Analyst on the Compass Patient Team for Veeva Compass, you’ll focus on the health data in our Compass Patient data product.

Veeva Compass is our suite of data products, with Compass Patient including prescription and medical claims record-level data to support more broad de-identified patient analytics for commercial use cases, like patient journey, market landscape, provider engagement, and more.

You’ll own health data investigations and improvements as part of our Product team. You’ll focus on three key areas:


Data Support - investigate internal and external questions and requests to understand data trends and behavior within customer-defined cohorts and across the network.
Data Quality - Define and track quality metrics in your target domain in dashboards, identify improvement opportunities, and work cross-functionally to document and share learnings.
Data Network Improvements - Collaboratively launch new features to continue to enhance our data in your target expertise area. You’ll focus on investigating, defining and testing productizable improvements that work at scale across billions of records.


This is a great opportunity for someone who is passionate about data and excited about working alongside Product Managers, Customer Success Managers, Engineers, and QA to implement improvements to continue to enrich our data and drive product excellence.

What You’ll Do


Own the investigation and resolution of data observations and data questions driven by internal and external stakeholders
Understand our product pipeline and impact to data to identify improvements
Build standard templates and practices to streamline data quality in your target domains
Own key analytics projects in the data and feature roadmaps
Design new data analytics and data quality features & capabilities, including features such as match, merge, dedupe logic, value enrichment and reference mappings
Establish quality metrics and build dashboards to drive continuous improvement of our data products for key areas such as merging, payer data, lab, prescribers, etc.


Requirements


4+ years of experience analyzing prescription data and medical claims data
Advanced SQL skills; able to query and manipulate relational databases
Knowledge of Industry Standard billing codes such as ICD, CPT/HCPCS, NDC
Experience documenting and presenting analytics results with stakeholders
Experience defining KPIs and building dashboards to measure success


Nice to Have


Experience in Python
Experience with the BI tool Sigma
Experience in commercial life science use cases
Experience in enterprise products


Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.


Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits


Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program


Compensation


Base pay: $80,000 - $125,000
The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.


Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

Title: Lead Data Analyst - Marketing and Customer Experience
Description:
Do you want to be a part of the clean energy movement? Are you passionate about improving our environment for this generation and those to follow? Are you ready to take on new challenges and collaborate with a future-focused team leading the way into new markets? Join Nexamp! 

This is where you can learn from industry leaders and become one yourself. It's fast-paced, mission-based work that challenges the status quo. Be on the team that's changing the world. 

What we’re looking for: 

We're looking for a Lead Data Analyst to craft insightful and compelling data stories, empower business owners across Nexamp to make more effective data-driven decisions, and help build our self-service data platform. As one of the nation’s largest and longest tenured solar and storage owner operators – and one of the few that is fully vertically integrated – our data is a differentiator in the market and a catalyst for future growth. You’ll be solving uniquely challenging data problems, alongside a strong team, and for a company in which the business model and mission are inseparably intertwined: our solar farms save customers money, help the planet, and are profitable for Nexamp and its investors. 

You will be hybrid out of our Boston office. You will report to the Director, Product Management - Data.

What you’ll do:  

Independently gather requirements for, prioritize, deliver, maintain, and continuously improve reusable data models, dashboards, analyses, A/B tests, and other data assets. Act as the product manager and implementer for your domain-specific marketing and customer experience team's data offerings - including a customer acquisition and retention forecast. Implement work using advanced SQL and BI tool skills.
Become the subject matter expert for data in your business areas. Identify opportunities for impact, proactively surface insights, support decision-making, and contribute to and influence business strategy and initiatives. Serve as your business stakeholders’ right hand. Support other business areas opportunistically.
Create and maintain comprehensive data documentation and communicate updates to your stakeholders. Write user stories or tickets for data engineering, validate data mapping, conduct QA, and implement data quality monitoring.
Monitor the usage of data assets, increase data literacy, and promote self-service through BI tools among stakeholders. Provide training, guidance, and support as needed.
Work within a centralized data team using agile methodologies. Collaborate with peer analysts through overlapping work, priority shifting, and code reviews to broaden your Nexamp knowledge.
Partner with the data architect, engineers, scientists, and analysts to shape the vision and roadmap for Nexamp’s data platform. Define and track annual OKRs to measure your impact. 

What you’ll bring:

7+ years of experience as a data analyst serving business owners and collaborating with data engineers (experience in the energy/construction industry is a plus, but not required)
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field would be preferred; advanced degree is a plus.
Advanced in SQL and BI tool administration and usage (experience with Databricks and Sigma are a plus, but not required)
Strong track record of independently solving problems.
Commitment to Nexamp's mission and have a passion for solving tomorrow's climate crisis today.
Demonstrated experience in effectively communicating information, ideas, and perspectives with people inside and beyond your organization.   
Experience in showcasing initiative to make improvements to current work, processes, products, and services across the organization. We value accountability and an ownership mentality. 
Ability to ask appropriate questions, analyze data, identify the root causes of problems, and present creative solutions. 
Expertise in building strong internal and external relationships with customers and stakeholders, instilling trust and loyalty across the industry. 
Eagerness to develop a fundamental understanding of how Nexamp operates and then apply that knowledge effectively to inform business decisions.

If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, but see yourself contributing, please apply.

At Nexamp, our mission is to build the future of energy so it is clean, simple, and accessible for all. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. By encouraging a culture where ideas and decisions come from all people, we believe it will help us grow, innovate, and be a part of environmental and social change.

You’ll love working here because:  

Not only will you get to take part in meaningful work and have the chance to change the world alongside innovative, dedicated, and motivated peers, but you will also have access to all the benefits that Nexamp offers! This includes our competitive compensation package; a 401(k) employer-match; health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one; flexible paid time off and holiday PTO; commuter benefits, and cell phone reimbursement. We have headquarters in Boston, MA and Chicago, IL, in addition to growing offices nationwide. We provide healthy snacks, coffee, service days and other volunteer opportunities, company outings, and more!  

Compensation

The reasonably estimated salary for this role at Nexamp ranges from $110,000 - $130,000. In addition to base salary, the competitive compensation package may include, depending on the role, participation in an incentive program linked to performance (for example, annual bonus programs based on individual and company performance, non-annual sales incentive plans, or other non-annual incentive plans). Additionally, you may be eligible to participate in the Company’s stock option plan. Actual base salary may vary based upon, but is not limited to, skills and qualifications, internal equity, performance, and geographic location. 

Nexamp's People team manages all aspects of recruitment and hiring within our organization. We want to inform third-party recruiters, staffing firms, and related agencies that Nexamp does not accept unsolicited resumes. Resumes will only be considered from these entities if a signed agreement is in place and the People team explicitly authorizes external recruiting assistance for a specific position. Any unsolicited resumes received will be deemed the property of Nexamp. We want to emphasize that Nexamp is not liable for any fees associated with unsolicited resumes.

Full-time remote work
Competitive salaries
Excellent benefits

Proficient in designing, developing, and automating queries, dashboards, and ad hoc reports that support strategic decision-making.

Quick to adopt new systems, tools, and analytic approaches, consistently staying ahead of industry trends and best practices.

Title: Business Analytics Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years.

What We Do

The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

Role Overview

CarGurus is seeking a Business Analytics Analyst to join the Business Analytics & Reporting team. This team is responsible for the analytical rigor behind reporting, forecasting, and financial modeling that enable day-to-day and strategic decisions. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious and an exceptional critical thinker; they can live in the data, understanding the logic and processes that generate it as well as detecting signals, diagnosing problems, proposing solutions, and predicting future behavior. They can then use their mastery to synthesize and convey important information to other parties and offer thoughtful ways in which things can be improved.

The Business Analytics Team has a wide remit at CarGurus. You’ll work with many departments, gaining a broad exposure to the operation of the business, and be asked to connect the dots between them. Your rich understanding, technical skills, and thought partnership will make you a highly sought-after contributor for a wide variety of stakeholders, including senior leaders.

What You'll Do


With the assistance of AI tools, conduct exploratory data analysis across disparate data sources to understand the performance of the business and identify potential opportunities and/or risks.
Be an active contributor in discussions with decision-makers, using cognitive empathy to understand their vantage point and incentives before using this understanding to structure and frame downstream work and resulting findings.
Use data to identify, validate, and uncover causal relationships of important business mechanisms.
Implement new metrics to evaluate business performance and/or experiments and build reports and dashboards to monitor and understand them.
Be a voice and advocate to use data to improve the quality of our decision-making.


What You'll Bring


BS or BA in computer science, mathematics, statistics, analytics, or economics, with equivalent analytical work experience or a MS degree in a relevant field of study.
2+ years of professional experience focused on analysis and reporting, including the use of data visualization tools, to influence understanding and decision-making.
Ability to understand systems and business goals to help modernize and innovate on present data structures and models.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, using hypothesis-driven analysis to solve questions and give guidance.
Fluent in SQL and an analytical tool; experience with Git, Python, and LLMs is a plus.
Some experience with data modeling and ETL concepts.
Proficient at working with data ambiguity to derive meaningful insights.
Excellent verbal, interpersonal, and written communication skills.
Able to manage multiple projects effectively, set expectations with partners, and complete projects on time.


The displayed range represents the expected annual base salary / On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this position. On-Target Earnings (OTE) is inclusive of base salary and on-target commission earnings, which applies exclusively to sales roles.

Individual pay within this range is determined by work location and other factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Position Pay Range

$76,000—$96,000 USD

Working at CarGurus

We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work-life balance and individual well-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives.

CarGurus may require in-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate.

We welcome all

CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That’s why we hope you’ll apply even if you don’t check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Title: Data Analyst – Pharma & Life Sciences

Company: Aaratech Inc.

Employment Type: Full-Time, W2 (deployed to client projects)

Experience: 2–4 years

Compensation: $70,000 – $80,000 per year

Work Mode: On-Site / Hybrid

Work Authorization

At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Why This Role?

Pharma analytics sits at the intersection of science and commercial strategy — and it pays for precision. Master syndicated data, real-world evidence, and market-access analytics in one of the few niches where domain knowledge alone can double your market value.

Job Summary

Aaratech Inc. is seeking a Data Analyst – Pharma & Life Sciences to turn commercial, clinical, and real-world data into insight. You will build brand and field-force reporting, work with industry-standard syndicated datasets, and deliver analysis that supports launch performance, market access, and compliant decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Gather, clean, and analyze pharma commercial datasets — prescription (Rx), medical/pharmacy claims, and sales data — using SQL and Python.
Design and maintain dashboards in Power BI or Tableau for brand performance, market share, and field-force effectiveness.
Work with syndicated data sources such as IQVIA, Symphony Health, and Komodo Health.
Support real-world evidence (RWE), patient-journey, and payer/market-access analytics.
Handle clinical or regulated data with GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 awareness, maintaining data integrity and traceability.
Ensure data quality and compliance across reporting platforms.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to commercial and medical-affairs stakeholders.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, or a related field.
2–4 years of experience as a Data Analyst, preferably in pharma, biotech, or life sciences.
Strong, hands-on SQL skills — complex joins, window functions, CTEs, and query optimization.
Proficiency with Power BI or Tableau, plus advanced Microsoft Excel (Power Query, pivot tables, advanced formulas).
Hands-on experience with pharmaceutical, clinical, or healthcare claims data.
Strong analytical, data-storytelling, and stakeholder-communication skills.

Analytics & querying: SQL (Oracle, SQL Server, Snowflake), Python (pandas, NumPy), SAS.

Description:

We automate the contracting process for legal, finance, and HR teams, helping them save time, cut costs, and improve business outcomes. For more information, visit linksquares.com.

About the team: Join our Revenue Operations organization, the central engine of our Revenue Team that sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, sales execution, and AI innovation. We are a detail-oriented and financially driven team dedicated to driving long-term value and growth by transforming internal processes into strategic advantages. We prioritize a "learn and get better" mentality, where you will not only execute proven processes but actively help refine them for the next generation of LinkSquares' growth.

About the role: As the Senior GTM Data Analyst, you will shape how we understand and optimize our growth engine by owning the analytical truth layer across the entire revenue organization. In this high-impact role, you will function as an internal revenue economist and independent partner to the GTM executives, answering three critical questions: What is happening? Why is it happening? What should we do about it?

You’ll join a collaborative team where you have the autonomy to evolve an existing foundation while building new, scalable data models, KPI architectures, and executive reporting systems that directly influence strategic decisions. Sitting at the intersection of revenue analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, and strategic decision support, this is an ideal role for a strategic thinker who enjoys the balance of technical depth, commercial judgment, and hands-on execution.

Responsibilities:

Serve as an independent analytical partner to GTM leadership, analyzing performance across the full customer lifecycle (pipeline creation, conversion, bookings, retention, expansion, and churn) to surface emerging trends, quantify business impact, and recommend strategic actions.
KPI Architecture & Dashboards: Own the Revenue organization's KPI architecture, metric definitions, and calculation logic across Sales, CX, Marketing, Product, and Finance. Rationalize reporting, reduce dashboard sprawl, and create trusted, scalable reporting.
Planning & Scenario Analytics: Develop models that support revenue planning, pipeline coverage, conversion, velocity, push/slip, and productivity analysis. Model upside/downside scenarios and leading indicators of risk to improve organizational predictability.
Executive & Board Support: Own the analytical development of recurring executive and Board reporting, ensuring outputs are grounded in reconciled metrics, consistent business logic, and clear, decision-ready frameworks.
Data Modeling & Architecture: Own, build, and optimize durable transformation and semantic models across the modern data stack for core GTM concepts (accounts, pipeline, bookings, ARR, retention, expansion, churn, and customer lifecycle) while ensuring data quality and lineage.
Analytics Innovation & AI: Leverage AI tools and automation to accelerate analytical workflows, investigation, documentation, quality assurance, and insight generation while establishing responsible AI governance and patterns.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Product, and Finance to challenge assumptions, guide roadmap prioritization, and act as a trusted advisor on major GTM decisions.

Requirements:

B2B SaaS Experience: 6+ years supporting a B2B SaaS or recurring-revenue business, with deep fluency in SaaS/GTM economics, unit economics, and full customer lifecycle analysis across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Experience.
Technical & Modeling Depth: Advanced proficiency in SQL, Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Looker (or comparable BI tool), Git, semantic-layer design, ETL/ELT concepts, and data quality monitoring, alongside strong familiarity with Salesforce and GTM data structures.
AI Integration: Demonstrated proficiency using AI tools to accelerate analytical workflows, documentation, automation, and insight generation, with a strong ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs against governed data.
Analytical & Commercial Mindset: Experience building and governing enterprise KPI frameworks, pipeline/forecasting models, and executive/Board reporting with the ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable commercial insights.
Collaborative Leadership: A track record of working across departments (Operations, Finance, Sales, CX, Product) to align on metric definitions, establish single-source-of-truth frameworks, and drive consensus.
Adaptability & Rigor: High standard of intellectual independence and curiosity, with the ability to bring clear recommendations—not just data—in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

This role may include additional forms of compensation such as a bonus. LinkSquares takes into consideration a number of factors when determining an employee’s starting salary, including work location, job-related skills, and relevant education, experience and training. The recruiter assigned to this role will share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.

Candidates are eligible to participate in the company’s benefit programs. LinkSquares’ benefits include but are not limited to medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k retirement plan with a company match, equity awards (a new hire grant, along with opportunities for additional awards throughout your tenure), flexible paid time off, generous parental leave, life and disability insurances and more.

LinkSquares is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on any legally protected characteristics.
