Title: Senior Product Data Analyst, Dealer
Description:
Who We Are

At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years.

What We Do

The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to join our Dealer team which tackles a complex data environment, building out core assets, running experiments, and many more unstructured analytics tasks to support the growth of the dealer product suite.

Our Product Data Analytics org as a whole supports our Product and Engineering teams, providing the final word on all analytics for CarGurus’ user and dealer experiences. We are looking for thoughtful, curious, internally driven candidates who can dive into complex data and draw novel, insightful conclusions.

What You’ll Do


Conduct exploratory empirical analyses using SQL and Python that bridge disparate data sources (e.g. website usage, subscription records, inventory volumes, etc.). to quantify product performance, user behavior, and/or market trends. Distill unstructured “big data” around product performance, user behavior and/or market insights into actionable outcomes.
Creatively compress sweeping, high-level exploratory requests into specific calculations that address your stakeholders’ underlying needs. Relentlessly dig into the data, taking initiative to consult with other individuals and teams as you judge necessary. Go beyond the letter of the initial assignment, to hammer out any anomalies or self-direct your inquiry into other relevant issues.
Advocate and participate in brainstorming/planning sessions for specific, data-driven product innovations that help further high-level company strategy, primarily in partnership with the Product/Engineering teams.
Avoid passivity in the face of flawed proposals; tactfully and persuasively push back against potential missteps.
Craft, audit and improve metrics that define business success, condensing abstract or loosely-defined concepts down to concrete calculations.
Experiment with new kinds of visualizations, build intuitive dashboards and other visual monitoring tools to guide daily decision-making by senior stakeholders and the company at large. Re-work underlying code to appropriately structure visualization inputs.
Communicate and present complex quantitative findings in easily digestible terms to company leadership, homing in on key takeaways. Concretely and informatively respond to any probing, on-the-spot follow-up questions from senior decision-makers.
Conceive of new data assets and build automated transformations (via DBT, LookML, etc.) to bring them to fruition.
Partner with Data Engineering teams to advance core data modeling/architecture (e.g. user clickstream logging), by optimizing, integrating, and distilling large raw datasets and metadata.
Draw upon prior experience with expansive, unrefined datasets to fix modeling bottlenecks in quick, scalable, outside-of-the-box ways.
Use Claude Code and agentic workflows to automate, accelerate, and escalate the sophistication of your analyses.
Be comfortable escalating and automating your analyses using R/Python scripting.


What You’ll Bring


4+ years of experience in analytics, ideally involving complex modeling, quantitative analysis and applied statistics 2+ years of experience communicating the high-impact results of analyses to leadership teams to influence strategy
Hands-on experience leveraging GenAI to optimize workflows and agentic coding platforms like Claude Code (preferred) or Cursor
Expert fluency in SQL. A strong background with either R or Python is highly desirable.
Second-nature understanding of core statistical concepts (regression, significance testing, omitted variable bias, independence/dependence, etc.)
Willingness to step outside your role and independently come up with novel ideas for the business.
Willingness to challenge others’ ideas and advocate for your own.
Strong project planning skills, with experience building roadmaps, estimating required resources, and flagging inter-dependencies with other teams/projects.
Preferred tools/programs: Snowflake, Snowplow, dbt, Claude Code or Cursor, Looker/Omni, Jira, Salesforce, Google/MS suite


The displayed range represents the expected annual base salary / On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this position. On-Target Earnings (OTE) is inclusive of base salary and on-target commission earnings, which applies exclusively to sales roles.

Individual pay within this range is determined by work location and other factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Position Pay Range

$120,000—$151,000 USD

Working at CarGurus

We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work-life balance and individual well-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives.

CarGurus may require in-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate.

We welcome all

CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That’s why we hope you’ll apply even if you don’t check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus.

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 2 years of professional experience.

Strong understanding of data modeling and ETL processes.
Excellent attention to detail, organization, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Experience developing ETL processes using Python.
Experience developing and publishing dashboards in Power BI Service.
Experience developing or integrating AI-powered tools, chatbots, or API-based solutions.
Working knowledge of Power Automate and other Microsoft 365 tools.
Experience working with Power BI Service and AWS Redshift.

Title: Sr Analyst BI & Insights
Description:
Senior Analyst, BI & Insights

Reporting, Analytics & Development | Work location: Framingham

Staples is business to business. You’re what binds us together.

Our Customer Success organization is looking for a strategic analytics partner who can move beyond traditional reporting to identify opportunities, surface operational risks, clarify performance trends, and help leaders turn data into action. In this role, you will shape what should be measured, explain why it matters, and provide insights that strengthen organizational effectiveness.

Our world class sales and sales support teams work directly with businesses of all sizes to offer products and services to meet our customers’ unique needs. We are committed to understanding our customers and use best-in-class sales tools and technology to find the best solutions. We’re constantly discovering new ways to reach our goals, taking time to develop our skills and investing in our career growth, so we can enjoy lucrative opportunities and grow our careers both within and beyond sales.

The Reporting, Analytics & Development (RAD) team partners with Customer Success leaders to establish meaningful performance measures and deliver reporting solutions that support operational planning and informed decision-making. The team combines business consulting, analytics, KPI strategy, data governance, and visualization expertise to create clear and actionable performance narratives.

The Senior Analyst, BI & Insights serves as a strategic analytics partner to Customer Success leadership. Working with limited direction, this role proactively identifies business opportunities, operational risks, performance trends, and performance gaps; develops KPI recommendations; and helps leaders answer questions they may not yet know to ask. The Senior Analyst translates complex business objectives into measurable outcomes, executive-ready insights, and clear recommendations that drive action. This individual contributor role does not have direct people management responsibilities.

What you’ll be doing:


Identify emerging trends, risks, opportunities, and performance gaps across Customer Success functions.
Conduct deep-dive analyses, root cause analyses, and trend investigations to uncover actionable business insights.
Define KPI frameworks, metric definitions, business rules, calculations, governance standards, and ownership.
Facilitate discovery sessions and translate business questions into measurable outcomes.
Develop executive insight summaries, performance narratives, presentations, and recommendations for leadership.
Define dashboard objectives, audiences, measures, wireframes, mockups, and visualization requirements.
Partner with RAD visualization colleagues to design, build, enhance, and maintain Power BI dashboards, scorecards, and visualizations.
Identify leading indicators, thresholds, exception-reporting requirements, and proactive alerting strategies.
Validate that reporting solutions clearly communicate trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
Recommend new performance measures, dashboard enhancements, and monitoring approaches when existing metrics are inadequate.
Provide analytical guidance, consulting, and subject-matter expertise to leaders, stakeholders, and RAD partners.
What you bring to the table:
Strong analytical, problem-solving, consulting, and business process analysis skills.
The ability to translate complex data into clear business narratives and actionable recommendations for non-technical audiences.
The ability to work directly with senior leaders and influence decision-making through data-driven insights.
Knowledge of KPI strategy, performance measurement, data visualization, and data governance.
Independent judgment in determining analytical approaches, priorities, and recommendations.
The ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams, including when stakeholders have competing objectives.


What’s needed- Basic Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Finance, Statistics, Economics, or equivalent work experience.
3+ years of experience supporting analytics, strategy, business intelligence, operations, or consulting functions; defining KPIs; working with senior leaders; and translating business objectives into analytical solutions.
Experience with AI-enabled analytical solutions.
Advanced knowledge of Power BI and dashboard design principles.
Experience with SQL and analytical data exploration.
Experience developing KPI frameworks and performance measurement strategies.
Knowledge of data visualization best practices, Microsoft Excel, data governance concepts, and business process analysis.


What’s needed- Preferred Qualifications:


Experience with Snowflake.
Experience with Salesforce Analytics.
Experience with Power Automate.
Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques.
Understanding of predictive analytics concepts.


We Offer:


Inclusive culture with associate-led Business Resource Groups
22 days of PTO and Holiday Schedule (7 observed paid holidays + 1 floating holiday)
Online and Retail Discounts, Company Match 401(k), Physical and Mental Health Wellness programs, and more!


The salary range represents the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. The specific base pay may be influenced by a variety of factors to include the candidate's experience, skill set, education, geography, business considerations, and internal equity. In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for bonuses, or other forms of variable compensation.

Title: Claims Analyst
Description:
The Claims Analyst will be responsible for supporting the effective management of claims portfolios through data analysis, forecasting, and reporting, providing insights into claim trends and financial performance to inform decision-making in line with Group Claims processes.




Responsibilities

Analyze claims data across managed portfolios to identify trends, patterns, and key drivers of loss performance
Support claims forecasting activities, including projections of loss development, reserves, and financial outcomes
Prepare and maintain regular management reporting on claims performance, key metrics, and emerging trends
Partner with Claims, Finance, Actuary, IT, and Operations teams to validate data accuracy and ensure consistency across reporting outputs
Monitor and analyze variances between actuals and forecasts, providing insights and recommendations to support decision-making
Develop and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and data models to improve visibility into claims performance
Support the identification and remediation of unreconciled data, reporting, and systems-related gaps impacting claims analytics and forecasting capabilities
Contribute to initiatives aimed at improving consistency and standardization across claims processes, including controls, KPIs, and governance practices
Provide analytical support for portfolio reviews, including evaluation of resource needs, alignment with forecasted claims outcomes, and overview of portfolio performance
Assist in tracking and prioritizing operational and reporting improvements to enhance readiness, scalability, and overall claims performance
Ensure data integrity and compliance with internal controls, reporting standards, and Group Claims policies
Work with external stakeholders to fulfill any claims related requests, including loss runs, data calls and other time-sensitive matters
Support ad hoc analysis requests related to claims performance, portfolio trends, and emerging risks




Requirements

2–6+ years of relevant experience in insurance, claims analytics, or financial/data analysis
Experience working with large data sets, including reporting, trend analysis, and performance monitoring
Strong analytical capability and problem-solving skills, including experience with data modeling, forecasting, and variance analysis
Advanced Excel Skills (e.g., Pivot Tables and Lookup Formulas) proficiency with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL ,SAP, or similar analytics platforms) and PowerPoint skills strongly desired
Solid understanding of insurance and/or reinsurance business models, with exposure to claims operations preferred
Strong business writing and reporting skills, with the ability to present insights clearly and concisely
Demonstrated attention to detail and a high level of data accuracy
Ability to translate data into actionable insights to support business decision-making
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across all levels of the Claims, Finance, IT, and Operations teams
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
High level of motivation and creativity to identify and develop new strategies and approaches to problems, creating efficiencies in existing and new processes
Must be legally authorized to work in USA.
Limited travel may be required.

Title: Environmental Data Analyst - EOH Group

ERG is a research and consulting firm that provides a wide range of support to federal, state, and commercial clients. ERG offers multidisciplinary teams with nationally recognized skills in engineering, science, economics, public health, informational technology, and communications. We hire people with the best minds and then provide them with a vibrant and flexible environment in which to develop their careers. The qualified individual must be highly motivated with the skills to prioritize, perform, and communicate effectively in a fast-paced environment. 




ERG’s Environmental and Occupational Health Group has an immediate opening for an early career professional to join our multi-disciplinary team. This individual will support a range of environmental and sustainability-related projects, including a clean energy grant program. The qualified individual must be highly motivated with the skills to prioritize, perform, and communicate effectively in a fast-paced environment. Responsibilities include managing large datasets, working with applicants to meet grant program requirements, using grant management software and related database applications to support client needs, and interfacing directly with clients.




 




Ideal candidates will have direct experience developing and supporting data visualization tools; conducting independent research and data analysis; and providing client services. 




Job Description:


Review clean energy grant applications for eligibility and completeness


Process payment requests and interface with applicants throughout the grant process


Identify and categorize potential application errors and communicate them to applicants and clients


Help develop and maintain a public-facing government data dashboard


Analyze, collect, and organize data to support greenhouse gas, energy, and water reduction projects, benchmarking, and reporting


Research and develop briefing materials on sustainability topics, including decarbonization and building and fleet electrification


Provide additional data analysis and technical communications support on environmental, sustainability, and public health topics







Qualifications and Skills:


Bachelor’s degree in environmental science or a related field


Minimum of one year of experience working with environmental or sustainability-related data


Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other data management tools preferred


Experience with data visualization software, such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik Sense


Familiarity with energy efficiency improvements, water conservation measures, and greenhouse gas emissions inventories


Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, including experience drafting technical reports and presenting findings


Experience working with and managing large, complex datasets


Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary team


Strong interpersonal skills with a customer service focus


Ability to take initiative, stay organized, and manage multiple tasks










ERG offers competitive salaries and excellent benefits, including health and dental insurance, life insurance, long-term disability, educational benefits, FSAs, a generous 401k plan, profit sharing, an EAP, 11-20 paid vacation days per year, 10 paid holidays per year, 56 hours or more of sick leave (based on the state you work in) per year (pro-rated for part-time) and more. The salary range for all positions depends on the years and type of experience. 

  

ERG is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable EEOC regulations. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual preference, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

However, any candidate extended a job offer might be asked to meet in person with an ERG employee before providing confidential personal information associated with new employment. 

  

If you’re a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access ERG’s online application process as a result of your disability. To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources via email at Resumes-Lex@erg.com or call (781) 674-7293. 

  

ERG fosters a friendly, flexible work environment. ERGers are dedicated to serving clients who are committed to making the world a better place. We promote and recognize principles of fairness and respect in the work we do, the partnerships we foster, and the culture we value both within and outside of our organization.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst to support grants management operations and reporting across Beth Israel Lahey Health (BILH). The Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst will serve as a liaison between grants management stakeholders, technical teams, and system business analysts ensuring the accuracy and integrity of data within the grants management system and related applications. This role will manage data elements, system interactions, and reporting requirements while developing dashboards, management reports, and analytics for leadership and other stakeholders. The position will define and oversee the reporting pipeline for the various grants operations groups, including the selection, validation, and integration of data elements from the grants management system into the enterprise data warehouse to support consistent reporting and analytics. The role will collaborate closely with Grants Administration, Finance, Compliance, Information Systems, and other ancillary groups to support informed decision-making, process improvement, and the effective use of grants management and compliance data. Successful candidates will have demonstrated experience with enterprise data lake queries (like SnowFlake), familiarily with ELT processes, report and dashboard design, and ad hoc reporting using SQL tools and PowerBI.

Leverages software applications to design solutions, performs detailed data mapping and analysis and reviews all data for accuracy and reasonableness prior to distribution. Produces business, research or clinical intelligence.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:


Manages one or more complex data projects. Utilizes hospital systems and database applications to update and analyze data. Prepares and distributes various reports to key stakeholders. Meets with departmental leadership to review reports or requests for data.
Maintains integrity and quality of data and assures data conformity meets operational requirements and goals. Acts as a central resource and integral member of data collection team. Assists in planning, establishing and monitoring criteria for data collection. Trains department staff on data acquisition methods. Extracts data from multiple sources. Audits and resolves all issues.
Ensures application access is in compliance with all regulatory and medical center practices. Acts as gatekeeper for application. Sets and defines user access and determines level of access. Reports all security risks to the application.
Collaborates with IS to obtain and maintain applications used for data collection and reporting. Recommends tools, upgrades and alternatives. Assists in the development of application security and back-up plans. Coordinates interface solution with multiple applications.
Designs and develops reporting and analysis tools. Interprets data and refines analysis. Prepares and presents comprehensive reports. Develops forms, tables and other data tools in the applications that capture, report and consolidate data. Provides application data collection, analytics and reporting expertise. Completes analytics in a timely and efficient manner.
Prepares weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports/dashboards and/or data submissions department.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Allied Health, or related field.
3-5 years related work experience required.
1-3 years of multiple application maintenance with relational databases.
Advanced technical computer skills as required for technical support specific to functional area and related systems.


Preferred Qualifications


Application Certification for one of the applications used in the department.


Competencies

Written Communications:

Ability to summarize and communicate in English moderately complex information in varied written formats to internal and external customers.

Oral Communications

Ability to comprehend and communicate complex verbal information in English to medical center staff, patients, families and external customers.

Knowledge

Ability to demonstrate in-depth knowledge of concepts, practices and policies with the ability to use them in complex varied situations.

Teamwork

Ability to act as a team leader for small projects or work groups, creating a collaborative and respectful team environment and improving workflows. Results may impact the operations of one or more departments.

Customer Service

Ability to provide a high level of customer service to patients, visitors, staff and external customers in a professional, service-oriented, respectful manner using skills in active listening and problem solving. Ability to remain calm in stressful situations.

Physical Nature Of The Job

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally in carrying, lifting, pushing, pulling objects. Sitting most of the time, with walking and standing required only occasionally.

Pay Range

$74,880.00 USD - $124,800.00 USD

The pay range listed for this position is the annual base salary range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at this time. Actual compensation is determined based on several factors, that may include seniority, education, training, relevant experience, relevant certifications, geography of work location, job responsibilities, or other applicable factors permissible by law.

More than 35,000 people working together. Nurses, doctors, technicians, therapists, researchers, teachers and more, making a difference in patients' lives. Your skill and compassion can make us even stronger.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Gupta Media was founded over 25 years ago on the idea that advertising could create huge leverage in our clients' businesses. Our work initially focused on the entertainment industry, specifically live events and recorded music (SXSW, Sony Music, Universal Music, and Disney Music Group are all clients). We have grown to include global brands (Amazon, Sophia Learning, Fender), major sports franchises (Florida Panthers, Washington Commanders, Cleveland Cavaliers, Women’s Tennis Association), as well as public sector institutions (City of Boston, Massachusetts Office of Travel and Tourism).




We are on the hunt for a talented Data Analyst I to join our Strategy & Analytics team to assist with reporting, tracking, data analysis, advertising strategy, and visualization needs. In this role, you will work internally to assist paid media analysts with reporting requests and externally to provide clients with insights into their advertising campaigns.




The ideal candidate is inherently resourceful. We need someone who enjoys the "instruction manual" level of detail and views a technical hurdle as a problem to be solved rather than a roadblock. When you encounter a gap in your knowledge, you have the drive to research, test, and figure out the answer. We want someone who doesn't just want to run reports, but wants to build a better, faster version of them.




Who You Are:

You have no problem tearing apart complex problems and living inside spreadsheets, data sets, or documentation to find the answer to any question
You bring a strong technical toolkit, including SQL, Excel, Google Data Studio/Data Visualization, and enjoy working with SQL on a day-to-day basis
You are technically curious and resourceful. You have a natural ability to navigate and understand technical documentation—whether it’s for an API, a piece of software, or a new platform—and use it to troubleshoot or build new solutions. Experience with Marketing APIs, BigQuery, Snowflake, ETL tools (Rivery, Supermetrics), or Python is a significant plus
You communicate with clarity. You can take the deep-dive technical work you do under the hood and explain the logic, the solution, and the results to a non-technical audience without losing the meaning
You have a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and a minimum of 1 year of experience working with complex datasets, preferably in a fast-paced environment. Experience with marketing data or paid advertising is a plus




What You’ll Do:

Analytics & Visualization: You will design and maintain customized dashboards that transform thousands of lines of data into clear, visual stories. You’ll be responsible for translating complex performance media metrics into digestible, client-ready reports via Google Sheets, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Media Strategy: You will learn our clients’ businesses inside and out to align their media strategy with overarching business goals. You’ll identify advertising trends across projects to help guide media buying decisions and optimize spend.
Data Integrity: You will collaborate across teams to ensure our tracking and measurement frameworks are scalable, accurate, and best-in-class, acting as a bridge between raw data and strategy.
Strategic Consulting: You will use your understanding of concepts like LTV, ROAS, and Incremental Revenue to lead discussions with clients, gaining trust and shareholder buy-in on media strategy and results.




Work Environment

Gupta Media is an office-first organization.




Our Commitment

At Gupta Media, we work hard every day to be better at all that we do — and that includes fostering a diverse and inclusive community that encourages and respects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and ideas.




Compensation

At Gupta Media, base salary is one component of our total compensation and benefits package. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000 - $85,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan, which is based on the company's performance.




We offer a competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, and pet insurance; Flexible and Dependent Care Savings Accounts; a 401(k) with up to 5% Safe Harbor contributions; paid time off; paid family leave; commuting and wellness stipends; and opportunities for professional development and career growth.




Candidates must be authorized to work in the US.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Leader Bank is looking for exceptionally dedicated team members to join one of the region’s fastest growing community banks and mortgage lenders. At the time of its founding in 2002, Leader Bank had one branch office, $6.5 million in assets and 7 team members. Since then, the Bank has become one of the most successful banks in Massachusetts with more than $5 billion in assets, 450+ team members, 7 branch offices, and annual mortgage originations of over $2 billion.

Exemplary products and an innovative spirit have driven Leader Bank’s rapid growth over the years, and our team members embrace these values. Our mission is to obsess over our clients, make them feel valued, and maintain long-term relationships with them by constantly enhancing our products and processes to always improve our client experience. For our team members, Leader Bank prioritizes competitive compensation and benefits, a healthy work-life balance, and an environment that fosters diversity and inclusion.

Summary

At Leader Bank, we recognize that data is an opportunity to create better experiences, smarter decisions, and value for our clients. As a BI Analyst, you enable stakeholders to make data-driven decisions and turn insights into action through automation.

The BI Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the Bank's enterprise reporting and analytics platform. This role bridges business reporting and data engineering by creating trusted data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and analytics solutions that empower data-driven decision-making across the organization.

The successful candidate will have deep experience with Snowflake, Retool/Power BI, Python, JavaScript, SQL, and modern data technologies. This individual will partner with business stakeholders, product teams, and technology teams to transform raw data into trusted, actionable insights while establishing scalable reporting and governance practices.

Responsibilities


Data Modeling & Analytics
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise data models, semantic layers, and analytics-ready datasets in Snowflake.
Build and maintain data dictionaries, KPI definitions, and business metrics to ensure consistency across reporting platforms.
Develop scalable reporting architectures that support operational, analytical, and executive reporting needs.
Optimize data structures, queries, and warehouse performance for BI workloads.
Reporting & Visualization
Create and maintain dashboards, workflows and self-service reporting solutions using Retool, and other BI tools.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business questions into actionable analytics.
Develop executive-level dashboards and operational reporting that provide meaningful business insights.
Ensure data visualizations are intuitive, accurate, and aligned with organizational goals.
Data Engineering & Automation
Develop and maintain ELT/ETL processes for structured and semi-structured data.
Build automated data validation, quality monitoring, and reconciliation processes.
Utilize Python, SQL, and JavaScript to automate reporting, data transformations, and analytics workflows.
Collaborate with Data Engineers to enhance data ingestion, transformation, and governance frameworks.
Governance & Quality
Establish and maintain data quality standards, validation rules, and monitoring processes.
Define and enforce data governance best practices, metadata management, and documentation standards.
Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
Promote adoption of trusted data sources and standardized reporting practices.
Collaboration
Work closely with business leaders, product managers, analysts, and engineering teams.
Participate in Agile planning, estimation, and solution design activities.
Provide guidance on analytics best practices, dashboard design, and data storytelling.

Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related disciplines.
3+ years of hands-on experience with Snowflake or other relational databases.
3+ years of experience building dashboards and analytics solutions using Power BI/Tableau/Retool or similar BI platforms.
Strong SQL expertise including performance optimization, dimensional modeling, and data warehouse design.
Strong Python programming experience for analytics, automation, and data processing.
Experience with JavaScript for dashboard customization, application development, and automation.
Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.
Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, and data quality principles.
Experience working with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with dbt, Matillion or similar modern data stack technologies.
Experience working in banking, financial services, fintech, or regulated industries.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS.
Knowledge of API development and integrations.
Experience leveraging AI and machine learning tools to improve analytics and reporting.
Snowflake, Power BI, or cloud certifications.

Title: Investment Data Analyst
Description:
At MFS, you will find a culture that supports you in doing what you do best. Our employees work together to reach better outcomes, favoring the strongest idea over the strongest individual. We put people first and demonstrate care and compassion for our community and each other. Because what we do matters – to us as valued professionals and to the millions of people and institutions who rely on us to help them build more secure and prosperous futures.

THE ROLE

For a leading and rapidly growing asset management firm, the Data Management team drives accountability for, and stewardship of, data as a strategic business asset. The team brings together technical practices, workflows, cultural norms, and architectural patterns to enable rapid innovation and trusted data. Leveraging deep data expertise, the team supports effective issue resolution, improved data quality, reliable data pipelines, and transparent measurement and monitoring. Title: Principal People Data Analyst
Description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

Reporting to: SVP of People Operations

Location: Boston, MA office (hybrid)

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal People Data Analytics Analyst to lead advanced people analytics and workforce insights, with Workday serving as the backbone of our people data ecosystem.

This role will be responsible for turning Workday data into strategic insights that inform workforce planning, talent management, organizational effectiveness, employee retention, compensation, and broader People strategy. In this role, you will partner closely with the People Leadership Team, HR Technology, Finance, business leaders, and other stakeholders to ensure that Workday data is trusted, well-governed, accessible, and translated into meaningful business intelligence.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in People Analytics and Workday data with strong analytical, technical, and consulting capabilities. This individual will operate as a subject-matter expert, establish analytical standards and best practices, and serve as a strategic advisor to senior leaders.

Key Responsibilities


Serve as a subject-matter expert for Workday people data, including the underlying data structures, business processes, organizational hierarchies, worker data, job and position data, compensation, recruiting, talent, and other adjacent technologies.
Use Workday as the primary source and foundation for enterprise people analytics, ensuring that workforce insights are grounded in consistent and trusted data.
Develop and maintain sophisticated analytical datasets, metrics, dashboards, and reporting solutions leveraging Workday data.
Partner with HR Technology and HRIS teams to understand and optimize Workday configuration, data structures, integrations, and reporting capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve Workday data quality, consistency, completeness, and usability for analytics.
Establish standardized definitions and methodologies for critical workforce metrics, using Workday as the system of record wherever appropriate.
Evaluate data flows between Workday and downstream data warehouses, business intelligence platforms, and other enterprise systems.


People Analytics & Strategic Insights


Lead high-impact analytics initiatives addressing complex workforce and business questions.
Analyze workforce data to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities across the employee lifecycle.
Develop predictive and advanced analytics to support workforce planning, retention, talent management, organizational effectiveness, and employee experience.
Connect people metrics to business outcomes to help leaders understand the organizational implications of workforce trends.
Develop executive-level dashboards and data solutions that provide clear, actionable visibility into the workforce.
Translate complex analytical findings into compelling recommendations for senior People leaders and executives.


Strategic Partnership


Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior People leaders, HR Business Partners, Finance, and business executives.
Partner with HR Technology, HRIS, Compensation, Talent, Recruiting, Finance, and other teams to develop integrated workforce insights.
Proactively identify important workforce trends and analytical opportunities rather than relying solely on reporting requests.
Influence strategic decisions through data-driven recommendations and clear executive storytelling.
Lead analytical projects from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, and implementation.


Data Governance & Analytics Architecture


Help establish and maintain a trusted People data foundation centered on Workday.
Define and document enterprise people metrics, data definitions, calculation methodologies, and reporting standards.
Partner with HR Technology and Data teams to establish appropriate data governance, lineage, quality controls, and access practices.
Identify gaps between Workday data and other enterprise data sources and develop approaches for reconciling and integrating information.
Promote responsible use of employee data, including appropriate privacy, confidentiality, security, and access controls.
Help shape the evolution of the People Analytics data architecture and technology roadmap.


Technical & Analytical Leadership


Leverage Workday reporting and analytics capabilities, including Workday Report Writer, calculated fields, composite reports, dashboards, and other relevant Workday reporting technologies.
Develop visualizations and analytical products using tools such as Visier, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Evaluate opportunities to use predictive analytics, machine learning, experimentation, and other advanced methodologies to improve workforce decision-making.
Mentor analysts and provide analytical and technical guidance across the People Analytics organization.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Human Resources, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
8+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Deep experience working with Workday as a primary source of people data, including strong understanding of its data model, reporting capabilities, business processes, and organizational structures.
Strong understanding of workforce metrics, HR processes, and the employee lifecycle.
Experience translating Workday data into executive dashboards, analytical models, and strategic insights.
Experience with Workday reporting technologies such as Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, and/or advanced reporting capabilities.
Experience working with downstream data warehouses, BI platforms, or enterprise data environments connected to Workday.
Strong statistical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to executive and non-technical audiences.
Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders.
High degree of discretion and understanding of employee data privacy, confidentiality, and governance.


Preferred Qualifications


Workday certification or significant hands-on Workday reporting experience.
Experience with Workday Prism Analytics or other Workday analytics capabilities.
Experience with Workday integrations and downstream data pipelines.
Experience integrating Workday data with Finance, Finance Planning, Recruiting, Talent, Compensation, or other enterprise systems.
Experience with predictive workforce analytics, attrition modeling, workforce planning, or organizational network analysis.
Experience establishing enterprise People Analytics data governance and metric frameworks.
Experience in a complex, global, or rapidly scaling organization.


What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means creating a trusted, Workday-centered people data foundation that enables leaders to make faster, more informed workforce decisions.

The Principal People Analytics Analyst will ensure that Workday data is not simply reported—it is understood, connected, analyzed, and translated into strategic insight. Leaders should be able to trust the underlying data, understand what the metrics mean, and confidently use the resulting insights to make decisions about people, talent, organization, and business performance.

Core Competencies


Workday & People Data Expertise
Advanced People Analytics
Strategic Thinking
Data Architecture & Governance
Statistical & Quantitative Analysis
Executive Data Storytelling
Business Acumen
Stakeholder Influence
Data Visualization
Problem Solving
Innovation
Collaboration & Mentorship
Judgment & Discretion

We strive to continuously improve our business.

Picture Yourself At Pega

As a Senior BI Analyst you will be a trusted business partner for Pega’s global consulting organization and key member of the Operations team. You will collaborate with the management team to design, build, and maintain the Power BI reporting suite covering consultant utilization, headcount, and profitability-related metrics. You will also lead and collaborate on projects pursuing company-wide strategic objectives. You will own the data governance and provide oversight of all business processes and systems that support these metrics. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive productivity and efficiency of our business systems and reporting capabilities. What You'll Do At Pega


Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards and semantic models that give Consulting leadership a single source of truth
Manage and communicate P&L analytics in Power BI including revenue, expenses, margin, utilization, headcount, for all Pega Consulting to drive profitability
Automate monthly and ad hoc financial reporting through Power BI datasets, scheduled refreshes, and paginated reports
Be a key member in the budget, planning & forecasting process
Design, develop, and deliver reporting using Excel, Power BI, HANA, and other in-house systems to provide proactive analysis and insights to the business leadership

Fluent in Power BI — you think in data models, DAX measures, and clean, executive-ready visual design

Description:
Description

It's a data-driven world. Be part of a rotational development program that harnesses the power of data and cutting-edge technology to analyze performance trends, identify opportunities, and keep Liberty Mutual moving forward.

 

The Details

Do you love telling stories with data? Are you looking to jump into the broad world of analytics? Are you looking to jumpstart your career with a global Fortune 100 company?

Here’s a fantastic opportunity to hone your strategic, technical, and analytical skills while learning the ins and outs of the fast-paced insurance industry.

The Analyst Development Program (ADP) helps aspiring graduates (like you!) develop a broad knowledge base through a curated training curriculum, an established mentorship program, and rotational assignments tailored to your developmental goals. Through both collaborative and independent work, you will begin your career ready to make an impact with your foundation of business acumen, analytical toolbelt, and professional skills all with the support of your instant network in our vast analyst community.

Qualifications

What you’ve got:


You have 0-2 years of related professional experience. 
You hold, or will be completing, a Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Business, MIS, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related discipline.
A strong academic record with a cumulative 3.0 GPA preferred.
You possess strong analytical and quantitative skills that fuel your passion for identifying and investigating patterns and trends. 
You possess strong interpersonal, communication, organizational, and leadership skills.
You have experience with, or a strong desire to learn, technical tools and platforms, including Microsoft Excel; data and analytics technologies such as SQL, Python, R, SAS, and Snowflake; data visualization tools such as Power BI; and emerging AI tools and techniques used to support data analysis and business insights.
You must have permanent work authorization in the United States.


We encourage interested candidates to apply promptly, as the role may be unposted once we’ve received a sufficient number of candidates. We conduct interviews and extend offers on a rolling basis.

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

 

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Title: Senior Analyst, Commercial Analytics (Digital Commerce)
Description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life.

WHOOP is hiring a Senior Analyst to join the Commercial Analytics team and serve as a key analytics partner to our Digital Commerce business. In this role, you will own analysis and reporting across our direct-to-consumer and marketplace channels, translating data into insights that inform pricing, promotions, merchandising, and product strategy. You will help us understand what drives bookings, conversion, and margin across our digital storefronts and partner closely with Marketing Analytics to connect acquisition and traffic trends to downstream commercial performance.

Responsibilities


Serve as a key analytics partner to the Digital Commerce team, analyzing performance across direct-to-consumer and marketplace channels to identify opportunities that drive bookings, conversion, and margin growth.
Own analysis of digital pricing and promotions, including incrementality, cannibalization, discount depth, and pull-forward, to inform promotional strategy and investment decisions.
Analyze funnel and conversion performance, merchandising, product mix, attach rate, and average order value to understand the drivers of digital commerce performance and identify opportunities for growth.
Own marketplace performance analysis, evaluating channel economics, assortment, pricing, and customer behavior across marketplaces and our direct-to-consumer business.
Build scalable reporting and analytical tools that give Digital Commerce leadership visibility into channel performance, partnering with Analytics Engineering to ensure data is accurate, consistent, and trusted.
Support commercial planning and forecasting by developing Digital Commerce inputs and channel-level drivers, and partner with Marketing Analytics to connect acquisition and traffic trends to downstream commercial outcomes.


Qualifications


4+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related discipline, ideally within e-commerce, direct-to-consumer, marketplace, subscription, or consumer products businesses.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale transactional and behavioral data, with the ability to independently move from a business question to analysis, insight, and recommendation.
Demonstrated experience building reporting and analytical tools that enable stakeholders to understand performance and make informed business decisions.
Strong business acumen and experience partnering with e-commerce, commercial, merchandising, or other business stakeholders, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear recommendations and actions.
Experience with digital commerce analytics, including funnel and conversion analysis, pricing and promotional measurement, merchandising, product mix, or marketplace performance.
Familiarity with experimentation and incrementality measurement, digital analytics or clickstream data, and business intelligence tools such as Sigma is a plus.
Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.


This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $120,000 - $155,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

Title: Sr. Marketing Analyst
Description:
About Us

Founded in 1992 in Dover, NH, Planet Fitness is one of the largest and fastest-growing franchisors and operators of fitness centers in the world by number of members and locations. As of March 31, 2026, Planet Fitness had approximately 21.5 million members and 2,909 clubs in all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Canada, Panama, Mexico, Australia and Spain. The Company’s mission is to enhance people’s lives by providing a high-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non-intimidating environment, which we call the Judgement Free Zone®. Approximately 90% of Planet Fitness clubs are owned and operated by independent business owners.

At Planet Fitness, our unique mission has always been to enhance people’s lives by providing a high-quality fitness experience in a welcoming, non-intimidating environment. And we’re proud of the amazing Planet Fitness team that supports our clubs and team members. They are comprised of dynamic, dedicated, and talented individuals who represent our values of integrity, transparency, passion, respect, and excellence (while having fun!) in everything they do.

Joining the PF family means being part of a company that cares about bettering the health and wellbeing of our communities. It means being a part of a supportive, engaging workforce with an inclusive culture that values diversity and creates an environment where everyone can feel they belong. It means encouraging professional growth and development. It means making true, lasting connections with your co-workers with celebrations, team building activities and engaging corporate events! It means creating a positive impact in our local communities through our Judgement Free Generation® philanthropic initiative. It means being part of a brand that you can be proud of!

For the past 30 years, we’ve helped millions of people in their fitness journey and revolutionized the industry along the way. And we’re just getting started!




Overview

Reporting to the Director, Marketing Analytics & Data Science, the Senior Marketing Analyst is responsible for supporting marketing strategy and business decision-making through data analysis, performance measurement, experimentation, and reporting.

This role partners with Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Technology to evaluate marketing performance, measure campaign effectiveness, and deliver actionable insights that drive member growth, engagement, and marketing effectiveness.

The Senior Marketing Analyst will analyze marketing and member performance, develop insights that drive strategic marketing decisions, build/support dashboards and KPI reporting, design and support experimentation and measurement initiatives, and provide senior leaders with clear insights through skilled data-driven story telling.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities, marketing business acumen, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for translating complex data into compelling, actionable insights and strategies.

This role follows a hybrid schedule and requires regular, in-person work at our Boston, MA or Hampton, NH office. Our hybrid model is M/T/W in office and TH/F are optional work-from-home. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of one of these locations. Fully remote work is not available for this role.




Responsibilities

Marketing Analytics & Performance Measurement

Analyzes marketing performance across acquisition, retention, digital channels, campaigns, and member engagement initiatives
Drives measurement of marketing initiatives through KPI development, reporting, trend analysis, and performance insights
Develops analytical recommendations that identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes
Supports testing and measurement initiatives including campaign analysis, segmentation, and performance evaluations
Develops and maintains dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and analytical tools that provide visibility into marketing performance
Monitors key performance indicators, identify trends, and communicate insights to business stakeholders
Ensures data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting and analysis.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Co-owns the design, development, and execution of marketing insights and measurement strategy with Marketing Team counterparts
Partners with Strategy, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams to support business initiatives through data analysis
Translates analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences
Supports ad hoc analyses and business requests related to marketing performance, member growth, and strategic initiatives.




Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
3+ years of experience in marketing analytics, customer analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, marketing science, or a related analytical discipline
Demonstrated experience partnering with Marketing and business leaders to deliver analytics, reporting, and actionable recommendations that influence strategic and operational decisions
Experience analyzing marketing performance across acquisition, retention, digital marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, campaign effectiveness, and customer engagement
Strong understanding of marketing measurement methodologies, including attribution, A/B testing, incrementality, customer segmentation, and marketing ROI
Experience developing executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, reporting solutions, and self-service analytics that improve visibility into business performance
Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize large, complex datasets into clear business insights and recommendations
Proficiency with SQL and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar reporting platforms
Experience working with modern analytics and marketing platforms such as Snowflake, Google Analytics 4, Adobe Analytics, CRM platforms, or similar technologies
Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, evaluate business performance, and recommend data-driven solutions
Extremely detail-oriented, efficient, and organized with an exceptional ability to establish priorities and objectives
Excellent presentation and written and oral communication skills along with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization
Able to establish and maintain effective, collaborative work relationships with diverse individuals, internally and externally
Dedicated learner with a natural curiosity for consistent growth
Cooperative team player with an upbeat, positive, “can-do” attitude!

Perks

Planet Fitness cares about you and your well-being. We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees which includes the core medical, dental, vision, life and disability as well as supplemental accident, hospital and critical illness coverage options. In addition, we are proud to offer eligible employees a generous time off program (including volunteer time), childcare reimbursement, paid parental leave, pet care reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, free Black Card membership, learning and development programs and a whole host of engagement activities. We offer a 401(k) Plan with safe harbor employer matching and an employee stock purchase plan. This role is also eligible to participate in an annual corporate bonus incentive program based on company financial and personal performance.

The salary for MA-based and NH-based employees hired into this role will be aligned with the range below. This is a good faith estimate, and the amount of base salary will correspond with a candidate’s professional experience, qualifications and internal equity.

Annual Base Salary Range: $110,000-$135,000




Note to Applicants: We have been made aware of an increasing number of hiring fraud schemes across numerous platforms. Planet Fitness never requires advance payments of any kind for computer equipment or any other purpose at the start of employment. Any request for you to provide payment information during the application process is part of a fraud scheme. Further, we recommend that you do not provide sensitive personal information (SSN, DOB, driver’s license number) as part of the initial application process.

  • Partners with Strategy, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams to support business initiatives through data analysis

Qualifications

Title: Senior Informaticist Process Insights
Description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Informaticist works in the Process Insights team to analyze and provide quantitative insights from our AI Process Insights tools. They may coordinate with other analytics, IT and business areas across the organization to ensure work is completed with insights from knowledge SMEs. The Senior Informaticist work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

Program Summary

The Simplification Center of Excellence (CoE) is building a new enterprise capability that helps teams create simpler, more effective, and more human‑centered solutions for associates, members, patients, and providers. Joining this team means contributing directly to how the organization understands work today and builds better experiences for the future.

The CoE develops shared tools, methods, and guidance that support teams from discovery through delivery—bringing together process insight, research, ideation, rapid prototyping, and impact assessment to improve both speed and quality of outcomes. By establishing these capabilities, the team enables more informed decisions, stronger solution design, and greater confidence in what gets built and delivered.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Informaticist to serve as a data and analytics expert within our process intelligence/mining program, working alongside a Program Manager. In this role you will contribute deep analytical expertise, translating complex process and operational data into clear, actionable insights that drive decision-making, prioritization, and continuous improvement.

You will leverage AI process mining tools such as Skan AI, and enterprise data sources to interpret how work is performed, identify meaningful patterns, and help define the metrics that matter most. Using tools such as Power BI and advanced visualization techniques, you will design, build, and continuously refine dashboards and infographics that make insights intuitive, compelling, and immediately usable by leaders and delivery teams. Your ability to combine quantitative analysis with strong visual storytelling will ensure data is not only accurate, but actionable.

Use Your Skills To Make An Impact

Key Responsibilities


Define and support the data strategy for each program that is onboarding to a task mining initiative.
Assess data readiness; identify source systems, event logs, and required data feeds for each program.
Interpret process, operational, and engagement data generated through task mining and related data sources to support insight generation for a single operational engagement.
Design, build, and maintain dashboards using Power BI, translating complex data into clear, intuitive views tailored to the needs of the pod and operational team.
Work collaboratively with the Program Manager and operational partners to define, refine, and monitor key metrics and KPIs that reflect engagement goals and performance.
Apply creativity and visual storytelling techniques to experiment with infographics and alternative data visualizations, making insights easier to understand and act upon.
Analyze trends, patterns, and variances in data to surface opportunities, risks, and emerging signals relevant to the engagement.
Iterate on dashboards and visuals based on user feedback, changing engagement needs, and evolving questions, ensuring outputs remain relevant and actionable.
Clearly communicate analytical findings through concise narratives and visuals that support discussion, decision-making, and next steps within the pod.


Core Skills & Attributes


Data Interpretation & Analytical Thinking


Strong ability to interpret complex process and operational data, identify patterns and trends, and translate findings into meaningful insights aligned to engagement goals.


Dashboard Design & Data Visualization


Proven experience designing and modifying dashboards in Power BI, with an emphasis on clarity, usability, and visual storytelling rather than static reporting.


Creative Use of Infographics


High level of creativity in experimenting with infographics and alternative visual formats to make data intuitive, engaging, and action‑oriented.


Metrics & KPI Development


Experience working with stakeholders to define, refine, and monitor key metrics and KPIs that support operational understanding and performance tracking.


Stakeholder Collaboration


Comfortable working closely with Program Managers and operational partners within a pod model, adapting analyses and outputs based on evolving questions and feedback.


Communication & Data Storytelling


Ability to communicate insights clearly through concise narratives and visuals, tailoring messages to operational audiences with varying levels of data fluency.


Attention to Detail & Data Rigor


Careful, methodical approach to data validation, consistency, and accuracy, balanced with the ability to move quickly in an engagement‑based environment.


Adaptability & Learning Mindset


Thrives in a dynamic engagement setting, quickly learning new domains, adjusting analytical approaches, and iterating on outputs as needs evolve.

Experience


5+ years of experience in data analytics, informatics, business intelligence, or a related analytical discipline, with a focus on operational or process‑oriented data.
Hands‑on experience designing, building, and maintaining dashboards in Power BI, including the ability to modify and iterate on existing dashboards as engagement needs evolve.
Experience working with process, workflow, or engagement data (e.g., operational metrics, performance data, or AI‑generated process insights) to support analysis and decision‑making.
Demonstrated experience defining, refining, and analyzing key metrics and KPIs in partnership with operational or delivery teams.
Proven ability to use data visualization, infographics, and visual storytelling techniques to make insights clear, compelling, and actionable for non‑technical audiences.
Experience working in a collaborative, pod‑based or cross‑functional team model, partnering closely with program, product, or operational stakeholders.
Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor, balancing analytical rigor with flexibility, creativity, and responsiveness in an engagement‑driven environment.


Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.

Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

40
